title: koordinerende planlægger til afdeling for praktisk bistand
description:
Carelink Pleje Aalborg søger koordinerende planlægger

Vil du have en central rolle i hverdagsdriften i en privat hjemmepleje – og samtidig understøtte den daglige ledelse gennem struktur, overblik og stabil drift?

Hos Carelink Pleje søger vi en koordinerende- og planlægningsansvarlig medarbejder, som kan tage ansvar for den daglige planlægning og koordinering i vores afdeling for praktisk bistand i tæt samarbejde med afdelingens 2 øvrige medarbejder.

Stillingen er en nøglefunktion i organisationen og et vigtigt led i at sikre kvalitet, kontinuitet og trivsel for både borgere og medarbejdere.

Vagtplanlægning og koordinering

  • du skal udarbejde konkrete vagtplaner inden for de rammer og principper, som virksomheden har fastlagt og med udgangspunkt i 3F gældende overenskomst.

  • Håndtere daglige ændringer, herunder sygemeldinger og akutte justeringer. Herunder at man i samarbejde med øvrige nøglepersoner skal modtage sygemeldinger på telefonen.

  • Være første kontaktpunkt for medarbejdere ved ændringer i vagter

  • Sikre overblik over bemanding, kontinuitet og stabil drift

Dag-til-dag disponering

  • Justere ruter og opgaver i løbet af dagen ved sygdom, forsinkelser eller aflysninger

  • Koordinere indsatsen, så borgerne får den rette hjælp på rette tidspunkt

  • Have løbende kontakt med medarbejdere i vagten ved behov for justeringer

  • Være tilgængelig på telefonen og besvare henvendelser fra medarbejdere, visitationen, borgere og deres pårørende.

Ruteplanlægning og systemunderstøttelse

  • Daglig ruteoptimering og justering i planlægningssystemer

  • Opdatere ruter ved ændrede visiteringer

  • Arbejde aktivt i Cleanmanager og Cura , sikre korrekt anvendelse af systemerne i planlægningen

Understøttelse af den daglige ledelse

  • Understøtte afdelingslederen i den daglige ledelse gennem:

  • Overblik over drift, bemanding og udfordringer

  • Tidlig opsamling på mønstre (fx gentagne sygemeldinger, pres på ruter, ustabilitet)

  • Bidrage med input til forbedring af arbejdsgange, planlægning og kontinuitet

  • Være en stabil og tydelig samarbejdspartner for både ledelse og medarbejdere i hverdagen

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra hjemmepleje, planlægning eller koordination

  • Er uddannet SSA , sygeplejerske eller terapeut

  • Har praktisk erfaring med Cura.

  • Trives med struktur, overblik og mange samtidige opgaver

  • Er tydelig, rolig og respektfuld i din kommunikation – også når hverdagen er presset

  • Har forståelse for sammenhængen mellem drift, faglighed og medarbejdertrivsel og er indstillet på at arbejde under helhedspleje konceptet.

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt inden for klare rammer og i tæt samarbejde med ledelsen

  • Villig til at varetage opgaver i perioder, som ligger udenfor jobfunktionsbeskrivelsen.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En tydeligt afgrænset rolle med ansvar og mandat

  • Tæt og dagligt samarbejde med en øvrige administrativ personale

  • Mulighed for uddannelse, kursus og udvikling

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • En arbejdsplads med fokus på kvalitet, kontinuitet og ordentlighed

  • Mulighed for at få reel indflydelse på struktur og hverdagsdrift

  • Stillingen er på 30-37 timer.

  • Skal indgå i en turnus ordning af intern bagvagts telefon samt sygetelefon.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Driftschef Birthe Rex på tlf. 98 180199 alle hverdage mellem kl. 10.00-14.00.

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og indkalder til samtaler. Vi forbeholder os retten til at lukke opslaget, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Stillingen ønskes besat hurtigst muligt, men senest d 1/12-26.

title: Helsingør Børneasyl søger en fleksibel timelønnet
description:
Helsingør Børneasyl søger en fleksibel timelønnet

Har du hjertet på rette sted, lyst til at være sammen med børn og mod på at blive en del af et lille børnehus med masser af historie og personlighed? Så er det måske dig, vi søger!

Bag den grønne port i Helsingørs gågade ligger vores lille private børnehave med 27 børn og fem medarbejdere, herunder vores leder. Vi holder til i et skævt bindingsværkshus med mere end 190 års historie, en hyggelig legeplads, bålfad og vildtvoksende gemmesteder. Her er der plads til leg, fantasi, nærvær og fællesskab – og vi elsker at være ude i al slags vejr.

Hos os er det nære børneliv i fokus. Vi vægter relationer, leg og nærvær højt.

Hvem søger vi?

Vi søger en engageret og omsorgsfuld timelønnet medarbejder, der har lyst til at blive en fast del af vores hverdag. Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring med børn og lyst til at arbejde pædagogisk.

Vi leder efter dig, der:

·        er nærværende, omsorgsfuld og god til at skabe relationer til børn

·        deltager aktivt i børnenes leg og hverdag

·        møder børn med respekt, nysgerrighed og blik for deres perspektiver

·        kan tage initiativ og indgå i husets rammer og rutiner

·        er mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsbevidst

·        kan træde til med kort varsel og tage både åbne- og lukkevagter

Hos os får du

·        en arbejdsplads med historie, charme og personlighed

·        27 skønne børn og en hverdag fyldt med leg og oplevelser

·        engagerede kollegaer, der vægter samarbejde og faglighed

·        mulighed for at få erfaring med pædagogisk arbejde

·        mulighed for at blive en tryg og genkendelig voksen i børnenes hverdag

Praktisk information

Vi søger en timelønnet medarbejder. Vi forventer, at du er fleksibel og har mulighed for at træde til med kort varsel ved sygdom og andre akut opståede situationer. Ved i forvejen planlagt fravær blandt personalet, vil arbejdstiderne være fastlagt på forhånd, så du i god tid ved hvornår du skal arbejde.

Du skal kunne arbejde inden for hele børnehavens åbningstid og varetage både åbne- og lukkevagter.

Åbningstider: mandag–torsdag kl. 6.30–17.00 og fredag kl. 6.30–16.15.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår følger gældende overenskomst og aftaler. Der indhentes børneattest inden ansættelse.

Har du lyst til at blive en del af Børneasylet?

Send os en kort ansøgning, hvor du fortæller lidt om dig selv, din erfaring med børn, og hvorfor du kunne tænke dig at arbejde hos os. Vi holder samtaler løbende og glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Er du mester i at kontakte nye kunder i DACH og kan du udføre værdibaseret salg?
description:

Du bliver en del af vores salgsteam, og din primære opgave bliver, at opsøge og skabe relationer og salg til kundeemner i DACH.

Under ansættelsen lægger vi vægt på din erfaring med de nævnte opgaver, systemer og eventuel erfaring fra rengøringsbranchen, men vigtigst af alt er, at du elsker at tale med nye mennesker og forfølge dine salgsmål for at skabe resultater.

Om virksomheden

Fra vores kontor i Odense driver vi CleanManager, en innovativ softwarevirksomhed med et klart mål: at optimere drift og effektivitet inden for rengøringsbranchen. Vi har i dag mere end 15.000 brugere på vores software og er markedsledende i Danmark. Vi er også godt på vej ind på markederne i Tyskland og Storbritannien. Vi er i øjeblikket 24 medarbejdere, der samarbejder på tværs af teams – dog med undtagelse af når vandrepokalen i bordfodbold eller backgammon er på spil. Se mere på www.cleanmanager.dk.

CleanManager er en del af zvoove, Europas førende leverandør af software- og AI-løsninger til vikarbureauer, rengøringsbranchen og sikkerhedstjenester. zvoove digitaliserer og optimerer arbejdsgange for mere end 8.000 kunder og håndterer årligt administrationen af over 3 millioner medarbejdere, 21 mia. euro i løn og 3 millioner ansøgninger. Med 1000 medarbejdere fordelt på 24 lokationer i Europa og Latinamerika er zvoove med til at styrke konkurrenceevnen i hele servicebranchen.


Arbejdstid og løn

Fuldtidsstilling.

Arbejdstiden er 37 timer pr. uge og løn aftales ud fra kvalifikationer.

title: TRAPPEVASKER
description:

Vi søger en ansvarsbevidst og praktisk anlagt vicevært/trappevasker til løbende vedligeholdelse og forefaldende arbejde på vores ejendomme.

Arbejdsopgaverne er alsidige, og dagene kan derfor se forskellige ud. Du bliver den person, der hjælper med at holde ejendommene pæne, rene og velfungerende.

Dine arbejdsopgaver kan blandt andet være:

  • Trappevask og almindelig rengøring af fællesarealer

  • Udskiftning af lyskilder og andre mindre reparationer

  • Snerydning og glatførebekæmpelse

  • Praktiske vedligeholdelsesopgaver på ejendommene

  • Tilsyn med bygninger og fællesarealerne

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Har kørekort B

  • Er selvstændig, stabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • Har hænderne godt skruet på og kan løse mindre praktiske opgaver på egen hånd

  • Har sans for orden og kan se, hvad der trænger til at blive gjort

Det er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har en håndværksmæssig uddannelse eller tidligere erfaring med viceværtarbejde, ejendomsservice, håndværk eller lignende.

Vi søger kort sagt en person, der trives med en varieret arbejdsdag, tager ansvar for sine opgaver og har lyst til at være med til at holde vores ejendomme i god stand.

title: Social og Sundheds assistent søges til dagvagt
description:
Social og Sundheds assistent søges til dagvagt i Carelink Pleje Aalborg

Vi søger lige nu en Social og Sundhedsassistent i vores private hjemmepleje afdeling i Aalborg. Du trives med helhedspleje og kan se sig selv som en vigtig medspiller ift ældreloven. Carelink Pleje Aalborg varetager privat hjemmepleje i hele kommunen. Som Social og Sundhedsassistent skal du indgå i den daglige pleje af vores borgere, du skal være samarbejdspartner og yde støtte til dine kolleger. Vi opruster for at kunne varetage sundhedslovsydelser og levere helhedspleje på et højt fagligt niveau, derfor er der brug for dig.

Der vil blive taget udgangspunkt i dine ønsker, så arbejdsliv og privatliv balancere. Du kan forvente at arbejde weekend hver 4. weekend og i dagvagt.

Vi har brug for fagligt dygtige kolleger, for at sikre den fortsatte tværfaglige dialog og i implementering af den nye ældrelov og sundhedsreform.

Du kan forvente en arbejdsplads med rig mulighed for faglig udvikling. Du forventes at kunne arbejde selvstændigt og besidde et godt overblik, med forståelse for at arbejde ud fra gældende instrukser og arbejdsgange.

Tænk på en arbejdsdag, hvor du bruger størstedelen af din tid på at skabe tryghed og livskvalitet for borgere i deres eget hjem. Her hjælper du med daglige behov og opbygger relationer, der gør en positiv forskel i deres liv. Du brænder for sammenhængende dokumentation, kvalitetssikring og har kendskab til både journal og medicin audit. ydelser, så oplæring og vejledning er kompetencer du besidder. Lyder det som noget for dig? Hvis ja, så læs videre – måske er du Carelink Plejes nye kollega.

Hvorfor vælge Carelink Pleje som din nye arbejdsplads?

  1. Du træder ind i en vigtig rolle, hvor du bidrager til at skabe tryghed og omsorg i borgernes hverdag. Hos Carelink Pleje får du mulighed for at sætte dit præg på den lokale hjemmepleje og den måde, vi skaber livskvalitet for mennesker.

  2. Du kommer tæt på de borgere, vi hjælper. Med din faglige ekspertise og omsorg kan du gøre en mærkbar forskel i deres liv. Sammen med borgerne finder du løsninger, der passer til deres individuelle behov og ønsker.

  3. En fleksibel arbejdsplads, hvor vi forstår, at livet skal hænge sammen. Har du brug for en løsning, der matcher din hverdag, finder vi ud af det sammen. Vores værdier er initiativ, omtanke, fællesskab og nr. 1 i service – det gør os til en arbejdsplads, der tager hensyn til dig som menneske.

For at være en succes i stillingen er det vigtigt:

  1. At du er uddannet social og sundhedsassistent

  2. At du har kendskab til cura, er en klar fordel, men ikke et krav

  3. At du kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også trives i et fællesskab, hvor vi løfter i flok og leverer service på højeste niveau

  4. Hos Carelink Pleje er vores mission klar: "Vi skaber rammerne for livskvalitet og et værdigt liv" – og vi søger en medarbejder, der brænder for at bidrage til dette hver dag

title: ASIYE GROUP ApS søger nye kollegaer: Koordinator/Chauffør & Chauffør (Kørekort B) / ASIYE GROUP ApS is hiring: Coordinator/Driver & Driver (Driver's License B)
description:
ASIYE GROUP ApS søger nye kollegaer: Koordinator/Chauffør & Chauffør (Kørekort B)

ASIYE GROUP ApS oplever fortsat vækst, og vi udvider nu vores team. Vi søger to engagerede, ansvarsfulde og stabile profiler til vores transport- og logistikdrift: En struktureret koordinator (med aktiv kørsel) og en professionel chauffør. Begge stillinger kræver almindeligt kørekort (Kategori B), samt at du behersker tyrkisk og engelsk.

Vi tilbyder en dynamisk hverdag i en virksomhed i udvikling, hvor kvalitet og højt serviceniveau er i højsædet. Læs mere om de to stillinger nedenfor og angiv i din ansøgning, hvilken rolle du søger.

PROFIL 1: Teamkoordinator & Chauffør (Hybridstilling)

Som vores nye koordinator bliver du omdrejningspunktet for den daglige drift. Du får ansvaret for at planlægge arbejdet for vores chauffører, men du er også en aktiv del af flåden og træder selv til bag rattet.

Dine primære opgaver:

  • Planlægning og koordinering: Daglig ruteplanlægning og opgavestyring for selskabets ansatte chauffører.

  • Kvalitetssikring i marken: Køre periodisk med chaufførerne for at evaluere, vejlede og sikre vores høje kvalitetsstandarder.

  • Aktiv kørsel: Selvom du har administrative opgaver, fungerer du også som aktiv chauffør (Kørekort B) i det daglige og i travle perioder.

  • Administrative opgaver: Håndtering af ad-hoc administrative opgaver relateret til driften.

  • Sparring og support: Fungere som primær kontaktperson, guide og motivator for chaufførteamet.

Vores forventninger til dig:

  • Sprogkundskaber: Du skal kunne kommunikere flydende på tyrkisk og engelsk i både skrift og tale af hensyn til vores interne koordinering og samarbejdspartnere.

  • Erfaring med logistik, koordinering eller teamledelse (erfaring fra transportbranchen er en stor fordel).

  • Struktureret, løsningsorienteret og i stand til at bevare overblikket i pressede situationer.

  • Gyldigt kørekort (B) og erfaring som aktiv, rutineret bilist.

PROFIL 2: Chauffør (Kørekort B)

Vi søger en stabil og serviceminded chauffør, der vil være virksomhedens ansigt udadtil over for vores kunder. Du bliver en vigtig del af vores daglige leveringsteam.

Dine primære opgaver:

  • Transport og levering: Sikker og effektiv afvikling af de planlagte ruter i selskabets biler (Kategori B).

  • Kundeservice: Sikre at varer/ydelser leveres til tiden og altid med et højt serviceniveau og et smil.

  • Kvalitetsbevidst arbejde: Sørge for at køretøjet holdes pænt, og at gældende retningslinjer for transporten overholdes.

  • Samarbejde: Tæt dialog med koordinatoren og resten af teamet for at optimere hverdagen.

Vores forventninger til dig:

  • Sprogkundskaber: Du kan tale og forstå enten tyrkisk eller engelsk på et fornuftigt niveau (og gerne begge dele).

  • Gyldigt kørekort (B) og solid erfaring med kørsel i varebil eller lignende.

  • Mødestabil, fleksibel og ansvarsfuld omkring dine arbejdstider og opgaver.

  • Præsentabel, høflig og serviceminded over for kunder og kollegaer.

Hvad tilbyder ASIYE GROUP ApS?

  • En stabil arbejdsplads med gode, engagerede kollegaer.

  • Gode og professionelle rammer for udførelsen af dit arbejde.

  • Mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling (særligt i koordinatorrollen).

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Er du vores nye koordinator eller chauffør? Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til zekeriya-eker@hotmail.com. Marker venligst din ansøgning med enten "Ansøgning: Koordinator" eller "Ansøgning: Chauffør".

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og besætter stillingerne, så snart de rette kandidater er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingerne, er du velkommen til at kontakte os via ovenstående e-mail, hvorefter vi vil vende tilbage til dig.

 

ASIYE GROUP ApS is hiring: Coordinator/Driver & Driver (Driver's License B)

ASIYE GROUP ApS continues to grow, and we are now expanding our team. We are seeking two dedicated, responsible, and reliable profiles for our transport and logistics operations: A structured coordinator (with active driving) and a professional driver. Both positions require a standard driver's license (Category B), as well as proficiency in Turkish and English.

We offer a dynamic everyday work environment in a developing company where quality and high service levels are paramount. Read more about the two positions below and please specify in your application which role you are applying for.

PROFILE 1: Team Coordinator & Driver (Hybrid Position)

As our new coordinator, you will be the core of our daily operations. You will be responsible for planning the work schedule for our drivers, but you will also be an active part of the fleet and step behind the wheel yourself.

Your primary tasks:

  • Planning and coordination: Daily route planning and task management for the company's employed drivers.

  • Quality assurance in the field: Periodically driving with the drivers to evaluate, guide, and ensure our high-quality standards.

  • Active driving: Even though you have administrative tasks, you will also act as an active driver (License B) on a daily basis and during busy periods.

  • Administrative tasks: Handling ad-hoc administrative tasks related to operations.

  • Sparring and support: Acting as the primary contact person, guide, and motivator for the driver team.

Our expectations for you:

  • Language skills: You must be able to communicate fluently in Turkish and English (both written and spoken) for our internal coordination and business partners.

  • Experience in logistics, coordination, or team leadership (experience in the transport industry is a major advantage).

  • Structured, solution-oriented, and able to maintain an overview in high-pressure situations.

  • Valid driver's license (B) and experience as an active, experienced driver.

PROFILE 2: Driver (Driver's License B)

We are looking for a reliable and service-minded driver who will be the face of the company to our customers. You will become an important part of our daily delivery team.

Your primary tasks:

  • Transport and delivery: Safe and efficient execution of planned routes in the company's vehicles (Category B).

  • Customer service: Ensuring that goods/services are delivered on time and always with a high service level and a smile.

  • Quality-conscious work: Making sure the vehicle is kept clean and tidy, and that applicable regulations for transport are followed.

  • Collaboration: Close dialogue with the coordinator and the rest of the team to optimize the daily workflow.

Our expectations for you:

  • Language skills: You can speak and understand either Turkish or English at a reasonable level (and preferably both).

  • Valid driver's license (B) and solid experience driving vans or similar vehicles.

  • Punctual, flexible, and responsible regarding your working hours and tasks.

  • Presentable, polite, and service-minded towards customers and colleagues.

What does ASIYE GROUP ApS offer?

  • A stable workplace with good, dedicated colleagues.

  • A professional environment for executing your daily tasks.

  • Opportunities for personal and professional growth (especially in the coordinator role).

  • Salary based on qualifications.

Application and contact

Are you our new coordinator or driver? Send your application and CV as soon as possible to zekeriya-eker@hotmail.com. Please mark your application with either "Application: Coordinator" or "Application: Driver".

We conduct interviews ongoingly and fill the positions as soon as the right candidates are found.

If you have any questions regarding the positions, feel free to contact us via the above email, and we will get back to you.

title: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg
description:
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen
• Can handle prep, mise en place and service in a structured way
• Have experience with à la carte service
• Care about quality, teamwork and consistency
• Thrive in a busy restaurant environment
• Can work independently and take responsibility during service

We offer:
• Full-time employment
• A fixed work schedule
• Weekend work is part of the position
• Salary of approximately DKK 20,000–35,000 gross per month, depending on qualifications and experience
• Five weeks of paid holiday
• Company apartment / accommodation available
• Help with relocation and settling in Denmark
• Possibility of support with moving costs and/or paid accommodation in the first month, by agreement
• Good working conditions in a structured and professional environment
• Staff meals
• Work clothing provided
• Staff discounts
• A stable, established restaurant with a proven concept and an organised kitchen
• The freedom to develop your own ideas and contribute to the menu
• A workplace where English can be used in daily communication

Location
The position is based in Kalundborg, Denmark, in the heart of the city's main pedestrian street. Kalundborg offers a local Danish atmosphere, a charming town centre and a good quality of life.

Language
English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Start date
As soon as possible / by agreement.

How to apply
Please send
• Your CV
• A short introduction about yourself
• Your earliest possible start date

For applications and questions, please contact:
Esbern Snare ApS
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar
Phone: +45 25 14 44 00
Email: job@esbern-snare.dk

We look forward to hearing from motivated chefs who want to become part of a strong, established kitchen team in Denmark.

Please note that you must already have the right to work in Denmark, either as an EU/EEA or Swiss citizen or by holding a valid Danish work permit that allows you to take this position.

title: Associate Professor in Public Health: Children and Young People
description:
At the National Institute of Public Health (NIPH), University of Southern Denmark (SDU), a position as Associate Professor in Public Health is hereby advertised with a focus on interdisciplinary, qualitative studies of children’s and young people’s health and well-being, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

About your future research environment  

The National Institute of Public Health (NIPH) is part of the University of Southern Denmark and is located in Copenhagen. As a national public health institute, we conduct research to improve public health in Denmark and Greenland. At the same time, we contribute internationally to the development of knowledge, theories and methods in the field of public health.

We offer an inspiring research environment in the heart of Copenhagen with skilled and dedicated colleagues from diverse research and educational backgrounds. Here, you will have the opportunity for academic exchange and further development of your own research areas, as well as participation in national and international networks. The position is anchored in the research group Health Promotion and Interventions, which conducts research on interventions addressing public health issues and works with methodological and theoretical challenges related to the design and evaluation of intervention and implementation studies. Our research concerns children, young people and families, as well as vulnerable and disadvantaged groups, and takes place in a range of settings, including daycare institutions, primary and lower secondary schools, upper secondary education, the healthcare system, municipal services, supermarkets and local communities.  
You will actively participate in the daily activities of the research group and work closely with other researchers at NIPH.  

The duties include research, teaching and dissemination within the institute’s areas of expertise, including:  
- Children’s and young people’s health, well-being and everyday life
- The significance of digital media for children’s and young people’s lives and health
- Health promotion and implementation research in daycare institutions, schools and upper secondary education
- Interdisciplinary, practice-oriented research and development projects, including process evaluation
- Advanced qualitative methods, including ethnography, interviews, focus groups and child-centred approaches
- Teaching and supervision at bachelor’s and master’s level, including qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and implementation
- Preparation of applications for external funding as well as project management and coordination
- Contributions to the further development of the research environment, including method development and research group activities
 
The following qualifications are highly valued:  
You have established yourself as a qualified researcher within qualitative methods, children’s and young people’s health, and intervention and implementation research, and you possess strong research and teaching qualifications at a high level. You have a relevant publication profile and extensive experience in disseminating research to researchers, practitioners, and other target groups. You have broad collaborative networks and experience in research collaboration with practitioners. As a person, you are dedicated and possess strong communication skills. You are able to build trusting relationships with students, colleagues, and external partners alike. As a teacher, you communicate up-to-date, relevant knowledge in an engaging, clear and understandable way, and as a supervisor you are skilled, inspiring, and supportive.  

Qualifications  
- A PhD degree in Public Health, Education, Sociology, Anthropology or a related field
- Experience with intervention and implementation research
- Documented experience in research on children’s and young people’s health
- A strong profile within qualitative research
- Experience in collaborating with practitioners, exchanging knowledge and disseminating research
- Experience in national and international research collaboration
- Documented teaching experience at university level and experience supervising students (e.g. bachelor’s or master's students)
- Proficiency in Danish and English at a high level, both orally and in writing
- Documented experience with scientific publications within relevant research areas
 

Further information regarding the position can be obtained from:  
Research Leader Susan Andersen,  mailto:suan@sdu.dk

Terms and conditions of employment  
Appointment as an Associate Professor is for a fixed term of three years, commencing on 15 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for associate professor as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation process
Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Please note that only shortlisted applicants will receive an assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 
Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee and the shortlisted applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns them. The committee may request additional information, and if so, it is the responsibility of the applicants to provide the necessary material. Interviews and tests may form part of the overall assessment carried out by the appointment committee.  
Based on information from the entire recruitment process, the Head of Institute will decide which applicant is offered the position. 

The application

Applicants are encouraged to read the information "How to apply" before applying. 

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • Motivated application

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Master’s degree and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (copy of original + verified English translation)

  • Teaching portfolio

  • Research plan, including an account of your own research and preferably a vision for future research 

  • A complete list of publications

  • Up to six of the most relevant publications. Please attach one PDF file per publication. In cases of co-authorship, a co-author declaration must be submitted as part of the PDF file.

  • Reference letters/references may also be included

  • A statement of other qualifications relevant to the position.

We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow merging and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘CV’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.

If you experience technical problems, please contact mailto:hcm-support@sdu.dk

Application deadline 18 November 2026 at 23.59 (CET) 

We recommend that as an international applicant, you take the time to visit Work in Denmark where you will find information and facts about moving to, working and living in Denmark, as well as the International Staff Office at SDU.  

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.  

About SDU  
The University of Southern Denmark was founded to create value for and together with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talented individuals. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities, which can only be achieved with the right people.  
The university’s researchers, teachers, students, managers, and technical-administrative staff constitute the foundation of our success.

title: Farmworker piggery
description:
Farmworker with interest for piggery

  • Interests in pigs and and eager to achive knowlegde about animal wellfare

  • Have practical skills – are able to see when technical issues need to be taken care of, and best is, if you know something about technical matters ( animal care is first job)

We offer:

  • A position with influence, where you can help shape your role.

  • A workplace with skilled colleagues and a focus on well-being – for both people and animals.

  • Housing and salary according to qualifications.

  • Schooling about medication and caring about pigs

  • Free acces to swimstadions and bowling (and other activities)

  • Non smoking workplace

  • All needed workclothes ( and we wash them too)

  • Good staff kitchen, with all cooking facilities incl. free coffee, tea and hot chocloate.

About you: Interested in pigfarming, hardworking, social and english speaking. Danish class available.

About us:
We are located in 6870 Ølgod, where we have run our family farm since 1947. Our goal is to create a great place to work, where the pigs thrive and where there is room for both family and leisure time. We could tell you much more, but we would rather meet you informally to give you an insight into our way of running a modern farm/sow herd.

We look forward to welcoming you.

International enviroment with workers from different countries.

International enviroment with workers from different countries.

Our farm is a family farm, which does not only means that the farm has been owned by same family in generations, but also that working in our farm is like to work in a big family. We value working together with responsibility for each and everyone, taking care of eachother, helping each other when things get difficult. But always with first priority of animal wellfare for our pigs

We are looking for someone to join our team, who are willing to do rutine work at our farm like washing with highpressure, feeding , cleaning. When you start working here, you need to take a "Medicine Course Diploma" involving: legislation, animal welfare, disease diagnosis, use of veterinarydrugs, injection techniques, euthanasia, castration of pigs, and post mortem examination. This is a diploma paid and arrranged by our company.

title: Production Worker - Nakskov (Day/night)
description:
Would you like to help ensure a more sustainable future? Vestas is currently looking for unskilled workers with experience in production work. We are looking for someone who wants to help ensure quality and prioritize safety and well-being in the workplace.
 
Being hired as a production worker at Vestas is not just about experience, it's about motivation, curiosity, and interest in learning new things. Through thorough training and instruction, we will provide you with all the tools to become skilled at making wind turbines.

The Nakskov factory produces blades for our offshore wind turbines; the factory is an epoxy workplace, so everyone must complete an epoxy course or have a certificate no older than 5 years.

This posting is for those who thrive on working 12-hour shifts, either day or night.
 
Responsibilities

  • Safety: At Vestas, safety is the first priority, which means you must prioritize your own and your colleagues' safety, both physically and mentally.

  • Quality: Our next priority is top-notch quality, so we expect you to take pride in producing a product that meets standards.

  • Production Plan: At Vestas, we also have some plans that need to be met to deliver on time. So, we expect an employee who is diligent and strives to meet deadlines without compromising safety or quality.


Qualifications

  • You are in good physical shape and accustomed to standing and walking throughout the workday.

  • It is advantageous if you have experience with 5S and Lean.

  • It is advantageous if you have experience with production work, but if you are willing to learn, we would like to hear from you.


Competencies

  • You are quality-conscious and focus on safety.

  • You contribute to creating a good atmosphere at work.

  • You don't mind changing tasks.

  • You have an interest in learning new things and are curious.



We Offer
A workplace with a focus on employees, their safety, and providing them with the tools to create quality in their work. We offer an attractive salary package with health insurance, dental insurance, and a canteen arrangement.
 
Additional Information

  • Workplace: Nakskov

  • Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

  • Reference check will occur after interviews. Please state in your application if you have a reference. 



Our commitment to a fair hiring.
 At Vestas, we evaluate all candidates solely based on their professional experience, education, and relevant skills. To support a fair recruitment process, we kindly ask that you remove any photos, dates of birth or graduation, gender pronouns, marital status, or other personal information not relevant to the role before submitting your CV/resume. Your CV/resume should focus on your professional and educational background, along with the necessary contact details (email and phone number). We train our hiring teams in inclusive evaluation and regularly review process outcomes to ensure fairness.

DEIB Statement
 At Vestas, we recognize the value of diversity, equity, and inclusion in driving innovation and success. We strongly encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply, particularly those who may hesitate due to their identity or feel they do not meet every criterion. As our CEO states, "Expertise and talent come in many forms, and a diverse workforce enhances our ability to think differently and solve the complex challenges of our industry". Your unique perspective is what will help us powering the solution for a sustainable, green energy future.

BEWARE – RECRUITMENT FRAUD
It has come to our attention that there are a number of fraudulent emails from people pretending to work for Vestas. Read more via this link, https://www.vestas.com/en/careers/our-recruitment-process
 
About Vestas
Vestas is the energy industry’s global partner on sustainable energy solutions. We are specialised in designing, manufacturing, installing, and servicing wind turbines, both onshore and offshore. Across the globe, we have installed more wind power than anyone else. We consider ourselves pioneers within the industry, as we continuously aim to design new solutions and technologies to create a more sustainable future for all of us. With more than 200 GW of wind power installed worldwide and 40+ years of experience in wind energy, we have an unmatched track record demonstrating our expertise within the field. With 39,000 employees globally, we are a diverse team united by a common goal: to power the solution – today, tomorrow, and far into the future. Vestas promotes a diverse workforce which embraces all social identities and is free of any discrimination. We commit to create and sustain an environment that acknowledges and harvests different experiences, skills, and perspectives. We also aim to give everyone equal access to opportunity. To learn more about our company and life at Vestas, we invite you to visit our website at www.vestas.com and follow us on our social media channels. We also encourage you to join our Talent Universe to receive notifications on new and relevant postings.

title: Assistant Professor in Materials for Power Electronics / Printed Electronics
description:
The cross-border region Denmark-Germany is a powerhouse in industrial electronics. The Centre for Industrial Electronics (CIE) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) was established by a strong partnership between industry, academia and regional authorities. CIE is located at the campus of SDU Sønderborg and surrounded by a vibrant industrial environment. CIE is part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Job description 

We are seeking an innovative and visionary Assistant Professor to join the Centre for Industrial Electronics in Sønderborg. The Centre currently has 40 staff, including full and associate professors, assistant professors, postdoctoral researchers, PhD students, and support staff. Funding has been secured to support to establish new research and test laboratories in key areas of industrial electronics. Our ambition is to deliver excellence in research, innovation, and education.

It is our vision that the Centre for Industrial Electronics at SDU will excel in areas of key relevance for companies in the region of Southern Denmark and beyond. 

Candidates are thus required to have a proven research records at least one of the following fields:

  • General power electronics and its reliability

  • Multimaterial additive manufacturing

  • Printed electronics

  • Polymer composites and nanocomposites for energy applications

  • Surface and interface engineering

  • Dielectric materials and capacitor technology

  • Materials for power electronics

  • Energy-device manufacturing

  • Sustainable and circular electronics

 

Qualifications

The candidates must have a PhD in Electrical Engineering/Materials science/Mechanical engineering, or a closely related discipline. 

We also expect:

  • An outstanding research and publication track record 

  • Experience with industrial collaboration

  • Research experience in multi-material additive manufacturing of functional polymer composites

  • Experience developing polymer nanocomposite dielectrics and thin-film capacitors

  • Knowledge of nanoparticle surface modification, dispersion, and interface engineering

  • Hands-on experience in materials processing, device fabrication, and electrical characterization

  • Ability to investigate relationships between material structure, manufacturing conditions, and electrical performance

  • Peer-reviewed publications in functional materials, additive manufacturing, or energy-device research

  • Experience collaborating across materials science and electrical engineering.

Further desirable qualifications:

  • Experience with bio-based, self-healing, or temperature-resistant capacitor materials

  • Knowledge of scalable thin-film fabrication, including layer-by-layer deposition or coating.

  • Experience translating research into industrial applications, particularly embedded heating, sensing, or battery-conditioning systems.

  • Experience preparing research proposals, securing research resources, and training students.

 

Contact and further information

For information about the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical engineering, which encompasses SDU Electrical Engineering please see https://www.sdu.dk/en/ime.

For specific information on section and centre, please visit www.sdu.dk/ee and www.sdu.dk/cie. 

You are also welcome to contact the Head of the CIE, Professor Thomas Ebel (ebel@sdu.dk,  +45 93 50 72 05) for further information. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

A panel will assess the qualification of the candidate for the described post based on the submitted material. 

The application should include:

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Motivated application. 

  • Ideas for research and development activities.

  • Account of significant contributions to innovation in Electrical Engineering and Industrial Engineering Electronics.

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position. 

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience, including account of experience in training students and outreach. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

  • References/reference letters may also be included.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and the position is open from start of 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Student Assistant in our Control Center - night shift position
description:
Nordic RCC is looking for candidates with a technical background and interest in the role as operator in our control center – is this something for you?

Do you like working by firm and well-defined procedures, yet alert to interfere in the process when needed? Are you open-minded and enjoy working in a diverse and international team? And are you eager to be part of something new and meaningful?

The position will mainly cover the operator position during the shift from 21.00 PM- 07.15 AM during both weekdays, weekends and holiday periods. The shifts, of individually 10.25 hours length, are distributed throughout the operator team. The schedule is planned and updated 3 times a year, securing at least a planned period of 4 months into the future. You can expect an average of around 70-80 working hours per month.

You will be working alone in the office during the shifts, with an on-call colleague standby to assist in any technical matters if needed.

If you can say yes to the above, then you may be just the person we are looking for.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green transition

Nordic RCC provides calculations and recommendations to the four Nordic Electricity Transmission System Operators (TSOs), Energinet, Fingrid, Statnett and Svenska Kraftnät. The main aim of the services is to ensure transparency and help the TSOs with operational planning to ensure continued security of supply with an increase of renewables in the system. In short: We play a small but important part of enabling the green transition.

You will join a team of young, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues of currently more than 20 nationalities, and at times work in virtual teams with expert colleagues from the Nordic TSOs and potentially from all of Europe.

We are not looking for a specific educational background, but an engineering or similar technical or data-scientific background is preferred.

Whether you are in your bachelor’s program, or master’s degree program, that is not critically important. What is more important is your profile as a whole and how you are assessed to fit within the Nordic RCC organization.   

Key responsibilities for the operator role will be:

  • Participating in the 24/7 control center shift roster: mainly covering the night hours 21.00 - 07.15.

  • The shift starts in the control center relieving a colleague operator from the evening shift. When time allows, and the processes for the evening have finalized successfully, you have an opportunity to enter an adjacent resting facility. During the shift, when alerted, your responsibility is to enter the control center within minutes, intervening in the operational challenge faced. Next morning at 07.00, the morning operator will relieve you from your shift responsibility.

  • Become an expert in executing the services provided from the 24/7 Nordic RCC control center.

  • Maintaining your qualifications and knowledge in the operator control systems, including through routinely joining parallel shift during office hours to train in all NRCC services under the guidance of operators.

  • Interface to the Nordic TSOs control centers.  

  • Cooperation with the TSOs securing the process of services.

  • Trouble shooting and fixing challenges in the services together with NRCC IT support.

  • KPI recording and reporting, weekly and monthly.

  • Aid the back-office operators in small tasks, such as visit approval to the core room.

Additional tasks and involvement

Depending on the flexibility and the competence of the candidate, together with the department needs, there will be an opportunity to be involved in other areas of responsibility. This way one will get a better understanding of the NRCC in general and meet fellow NRCC colleagues during normal business hours.

Other working areas, depending on department needs, can be:

  • Involvement in testing system updates and features to be introduced to the control center.

  • Quality assurance and updating operational procedures.

  • Quality assurance and data retrieval for operational reporting.

  • Provide analytical insights on operational planning scenarios.

You are open-minded, international mindset and excellence at working within structured patterns, at the same time the ability to maneuver within a huge spectrum of corner cases quickly, reliably, and independently.

You are structured and can appreciate a fast-paced environment from time to time. On a personal level you are open-minded, team-oriented and take responsibility.

Nordic RCC is an international office, so fluency in spoken and written English is required as well as a motivation for working in an international environment.

You will join a diverse and enthusiastic team in our office at Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. Nordic RCC is home to over twenty nationalities, with a healthy gender balance and a wide range of ages and backgrounds. We value curiosity, fellowship, respect, and transparency—and we hope you see yourself in these values. 

Your daily workplace will be in the NRCC control center at the office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than November 15th 2026.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.  

Note that as part of the recruitment process, the candidate must undergo a satisfactory background check. The position is also conditioned upon a national security clearance. Both will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.   Nordic RCC is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. 

If you have any questions, please contact Kenneth Nielsen, Head of Service Operations, KEN@nordic-rcc.net

title: Tenure track assistant professor/Associate professor positions in Veterinary medicine
employer: Technical Sciences - Institut for Husdyr- og Veter
description:
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences (ANIVET) is seeking three new staff members for teaching and research in veterinary medicine. The positions are available from 1 August 2027 or soon thereafter.

The educational activities for these positions are aimed at students in veterinary medicine at both the bachelor’s and master’s levels.

The veterinary medicine programme is organised into courses covering educationally relevant themes and integrates a range of disciplines, and this is done with the vision to create a professional engagement while ensuring scientific depth for the students of veterinary medicine.

ANIVET is part of the Faculty of Technical Sciences at Aarhus University. The department is located near Viborg (Campus AU Viborg – Research Centre Foulum) and encompasses five research units with approximately 200 dedicated employees of which 50% are scientific staff. The AU Viborg campus will gradually grow to a student population of 800 – 900. The positions will be integrated into the department’s existing scientific research units, in which scientists at all career stages work together with skilled technical staff such as laboratory technicians and data analysts.

The positions
  1. Clinical veterinary science – livestock
  2. Veterinary public health
  3. Veterinary pathology

If you wish to apply for more than one position, please apply for each position separately. Please read more down below in “How to apply”.

1. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Clinical veterinary science – livestock
We are seeking a candidate with a clinical background in veterinary science within production animals - Livestock.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is to:
  • Perform clinical veterinary science within production animals, with emphasis on individual or group-level animal diagnostics, clinical decision-making, and evidence-based treatment and prevention strategies.
  • Research in major production diseases in cattle and/or pigs of significant importance in Europe, including development of clinically applicable knowledge and tools supporting veterinary decision-making in practice.
  • Integrate clinical findings with herd-level data to improve disease prevention and health management in modern production systems.



Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the development and delivery of teaching in clinical veterinary science for production animals, with emphasis on case-based and hands-on learning.
  • Provide academic leadership within the clinical production animal field, including mentoring and coordination of junior teaching staff (e.g., assistant lecturers/teaching assistants).
  • Contribute to strengthening collaboration with the veterinary profession and industry stakeholders in Denmark.


Your profile
The preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary clinical science related to pig or cattle production
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it
  • Preferably experiences within obstetrics



2. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary Public Health
We are seeking a candidate with strong expertise in veterinary public health, including popu-lation-level animal health, food safety/meat inspection, and the role of veterinarians in society.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is to:
  • Conduct research within veterinary public health, including epidemiology, zoonoses, food safety/meat inspection, disease dynamics, risk assessment or animal welfare.
  • Contribute to interdisciplinary One Health research integrating animal, human and environmental health on population level.
  • Support evidence-based policy and advisory work for authorities.
  • Participate in externally funded research projects.


Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Develop and deliver teaching in Veterinary Public Health for example to apply case-based and problem-oriented teaching methods with focus on real-world scenarios in veterinary services.
  • Do research within monitoring of animal welfare issues across the EU.
  • Contribute to teaching across the veterinary curriculum where public health perspectives are relevant.

Your profile
The preferred candidate should demonstrate:
  • The ability to independently conduct research within veterinary public health preferably with an interdisciplinary research profile integrating biological, social and economic aspects in projects
  • Danish authorization as a veterinarian or can achieve it. Experience with Danish conditions is an advantage.
  • Preferably, experience with antimicrobial use at the population level.


3. Tenure track assistant professor or Associated Professor in Veterinary Pathology
We are seeking a candidate with a broad background in veterinary pathology, encompassing both gross and histopathological examinations for diagnostic purposes with a strong interest in developing and innovating teaching within veterinary pathology.

Research tasks
The focus of the position is:
  • General and comparative veterinary pathology, including the mechanisms, diagnosis, and characterization of disease processes across animal species.
  • Diagnostic pathology, encompassing post-mortem investigations, histopathology, and the integration of pathological findings into veterinary practice and meat inspection.
  • Pathological assessment of animal welfare aspects of mortality in livestock


Within his/her area of expertise, it is expected that in addition the candidate will:
  • Teach and supervise students and early-career researchers at bachelor, master, and PhD levels.
  • Conduct research-based advisory work for authorities and have an active role in externally funded research projects.
  • Contribute to the collection and curation of pathological specimens for teaching purposes and reporting of findings to referring veterinarians and animal owners.
  • Contribute to the continued development of the department's digital histopathology teaching platform, TUTOR.
  • Support in the administration and further development of the department's animal donor programme for anatomy and pathology.

Your profile
The preferred candidate should have experience with:
  • Post-mortem examinations, including diagnostic necropsies, case reporting, and communication of findings.
  • Diagnostic histopathology.


Your profle as Tenure Track assistant professor
You are a skilled researcher with a solid background within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • Documented research qualifications at a high international level
  • Teaching and supervision experience
  • Qualifications for the Tenure-Track assistant professor level at Aarhus University must include postdoctoral training or similar with a relevant research profile and a strong scientific publication record in one or more of the areas of the position you are applying for.

Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.

Your profile as Associate professor
You are established as a prominent researcher within your specific field of research, and you possess:
  • The ability to carry out independent and well-organized research work, as well as work as part of an interdisciplinary team.
  • Documented teaching qualifications at a high international level.
  • Experience with project management

In order to be assessed as qualified as associate professor, you must meet the academic criteria as outlined here

How to apply
  • You must indicate the specific position you are applying for by selecting it in the menu. You may only select one position. If you wish to apply for one of the other positions, you must submit a separate application for each position.
  • Please also indicate in your written application which position you are applying for.
  • Furthermore, please indicate whether you are applying for a tenure-track assistant professor position, an associate professor position, or both by ticking the box. .

Who we are
The Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences is well-known for its skilled and very innovative interdisciplinary research environments with a high international impact. We perform world-class research, which contributes with solutions to address essential societal challenges within the green transition; the food production and veterinary medicine – nationally and globally.

The department generates novel research at the highest international level within sustainable food production, the environment, climate, and the health and welfare for animals and humans. The activities form the basis for our research-based public authority consultancy and degree programmes covering bachelor’s, master’s and PhD degree programmes within animal science and veterinary medicine. We offer a lively, engaged and innovative learning and study environment, which is closely integrated with the research environment.

Our department has unique and advanced animal experimental research facilities and technologies located close to the research environment, and a comprehensive national and international research network and strong industrial and professional collaborations.

What we offer
  • A well-developed research infrastructure, laboratories and access to shared equipment and animal experimental facilities.
  • An informal and multicultural research environment with high professionalism and close collaboration and networking activities.
  • A workplace characterised by equality and a good work-life balance, and open discussions across different fields of research.


Living in Denmark
Please visit the international staff https://internationalstaff.au.dk/prearrival/ for information about arriving to and living in Denmark for both the applicants and their potential families.

Area of employment and place of work
The area of employment is Aarhus University (AU), with related departments The place of work is AU Viborg, Research Centre Foulum, Department of Animal and Veterinary Sciences, Blichers Allé 20, DK-8830 Tjele.
AU Viborg is approximately 10 km from Viborg. You can read more about it here: https://international.viborg.dk/

Contact
For further information, please contact Deputy head of department, Professor Henrik Callesen (henrik.callesen@anivet.au.dk)
or Head of department, Professor Charlotte Lauridsen (charlotte.lauridsen@anivet.au.dk)

Technical Sciences Tenure Track
Aarhus University offers talented scientists from around the world attractive career perspectives via the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme. Highly qualified candidates are appointed as Assistant Professors for a period of six years with the prospect of performance- based advancement to a tenured Associate Professorship.

The aim of the Technical Sciences Tenure Track Programme is to:
  • attract outstanding talented individuals that are competitive at an international level
  • to promote the early development of independent research success early in the career of scientists
  • to create transparency in the academic career path

As part of the tenure track position, the candidate is offered:
  • access to research infrastructure
  • capability development, including postgraduate teacher training
  • a mentoring programme
  • support to develop scientific networks and to secure interdisciplinary research at the highest level

As part of the Aarhus University Tenure Track Programme, the University carries out a mid-way evaluation to review the progress of the tenure track candidate after three years, according to the same criteria used in the final tenure review. The final tenure review is conducted after five and a half years. If the review is positive, the candidate will be offered a tenured position as Associate Professor at Aarhus University.

Please refer to the tenure track guidelines for the tenure review criteria and for the tenure review process.

Application procedure
Shortlisting is used. This means that after the deadline for applications – and with the assistance from the assessment committee chairman, and the assessment committee if necessary, – the head of department selects the candidates to be evaluated. The selection is made on the basis of an assessment of who of the candidates are most relevant considering the requirements of the advertisement. All applicants will be notified within 6 weeks whether or not their applications have been sent to an expert assessment committee for evaluation. The selected applicants will be informed about the composition of the committee and will receive his/her assessment.

title: Are you studying for an IT degree and looking for a student job where you'll gain hands-on experience with modern workplace technology, cloud services, cybersecurity, and IT operations? Then join us!
employer: International Council for The Exploration Of The Sea
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for a service-minded IT student to join our team as a Student Assistant in Copenhagen.

About ICES

The International Council for the Exploration of the Sea (ICES) is an intergovernmental organization which advances marine science and promotes sustainable use of the seas. Our Secretariat is located in central Copenhagen and consists of approximately 85 staff representing more than 30 nationalities.

We are a small, collaborative workplace with an international outlook and a strong focus on learning, innovation, and knowledge sharing.

Your role

As our new Student Assistant, you'll help support the day-to-day IT needs of colleagues across an international workplace. Working alongside four other members of the IT team, you'll gain practical experience with modern workplace technologies while helping ensure that staff can work securely and effectively both in the office and remotely.

Responsibilities
You will help with:

  • IT support and troubleshooting

  • Device setup and user administration

  • Microsoft 365 services and workplace technology

  • Meeting room and conferencing equipment

  • IT improvements, documentation, and security activities

  • Support cybersecurity and compliance activities, including CIS controls, using cloud and Microsoft 365 security solutions.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for a student who has completed at least 3 years of education within IT, computer science, business informatics, technical engineering, or a related field, and who is currently pursuing further studies.

You do not need to know everything already. We are more interested in your curiosity, motivation, and willingness to learn.

For this role, we expect you to have:

  • A strong interest in IT support and workplace technology

  • Good understanding of Windows and Microsoft 365

  • Confidence troubleshooting common technical issues

  • Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken

  • A structured and detail-oriented approach to your work

  • The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player

Experience with Microsoft 365 administration, cloud technologies, device management, cybersecurity, or scripting is an advantage, but not required.

Why join ICES?

At ICES, you'll do more than provide IT support. You'll gain practical experience with modern workplace technology, work closely with experienced colleagues, and help support an international community of staff and scientists. We offer flexible working hours to fit around your studies, along with plenty of opportunities to learn and develop your skills.

Terms of Appointment

This is a paid student role, and the working hours are 15 hours per week. This position will be established with an initial duration of 6 months, with a starting date as soon as possible (preferably January 2027).

Apply Now!

Don’t miss out on this opportunity to kickstart your IT career with us! Submit your application (CV and letter of motivation) by clicking the following link: Student Assistant (IT Support and Cybersecurity) Vacancy - ICES

Deadline for application submission is midnight 28 October 2026.

Questions about the role can be directed to IT Team Lead and Enterprise Architect, Nasrullah Iqbal (nas@ices.dk)

For more information about ICES, please visit our website:  www.ices.dk
