title: Chip Ecosystem Partnership and Funding Manager, The position is a Senior Advisor at TEK Innovation
description:
Do you want to help facilitate and grow the semiconductor and chip ecosystem in Denmark and beyond, working with the leading researchers in the field, and to turn potential into opportunities, partnerships and projects? Then this job could be for you.  

About the position 

SDU Microelectronics at TEK, headed by professor Farshad Moradi, is part of the Danish Chips Competence Centre (DkCCC) - the new Danish hub for chip technology and your strategic platform. The position offers an opportunity to play a central role in strengthening Denmark’s chip ecosystem and to help connect the ecosystem with fast-growing application areas such as drones, robotics, sensors and autonomous systems, where advanced chip technology is becoming increasingly critical for performance, reliability, energy efficiency and future innovation. 

You will work closely with SDU researchers, DkCCC partners, Danish universities, companies, incubators, industry organizations, funding advisers and European chip networks. Learn more here www.dkccc.eu 

The position involves regular travel within Denmark and occasional travel elsewhere in Europe. 

Your main responsibilities will include:  

  • Identifying relevant national and European funding opportunities in chip technology, semiconductor development, and chip-enabled applications. 

  • Developing and maintaining a strategic pipeline of funding calls, project ideas and potential consortium partners. 

  • Engaging proactively with Danish start-ups, SMEs and established companies to understand their technological needs and funding requirements. 

  • Connecting companies with relevant researchers, facilities and competencies at SDU and other Danish universities. 

  • Helping companies and researchers translate technical and business ideas into fundable project concepts. 

  • Initiating and facilitating Danish and European consortia for chip-related funding calls and identifying opportunities to join existing consortia. 

  • Promoting Danish chip competencies and contribute to the visibility and strategic development of DkCCC.  

  • Supporting the full process of funding applications, from project objectives and facilitating consortiums, to coordinating proposals with partners and funding advisers. 

  • Building relationships with key stakeholders, organizing activities, and events supporting the ecosystem.   

Your profile 
You have a relevant master's degree, for example within engineering or natural sciences, business development or innovation management, economics or business administration, European studies or public policy, research and innovation management, or another relevant field. 

You have documented experience in one or more of the following: 

  • National or European research and innovation funding 

  • Development of collaborative funding proposals 

  • Consortium building and partner identification 

  • University–industry collaboration or innovation/business development 

  • Supporting start-ups, SMEs or deep-tech companies 

  • Stakeholder management and professional networking 

We are looking for a colleague who: 

  • Is proactive and comfortable initiating contact with companies, researchers and potential partners.  

  • Is a strong relationship builder who can establish trust across organizational and disciplinary boundaries 

  • Understands both commercial needs and academic interests and can structure complex consortium-development processes, while maintaining momentum towards a deadline 

  • Communicates clearly with different stakeholders, technical, academia and experts, business 

  • Works independently and is persistent and solution oriented, while also contributing actively to a team 

Experience with semiconductors, microelectronics, integrated circuits, quantum technologies, photonics, sensors or other deep-tech fields is a significant advantage — though you don't need to be a chip designer. What matters more is your ability to grasp technology-based opportunities, engage technical specialists, and turn complex ideas into fundable partnerships. Knowledge of European research and innovation programs, including EU Chips Act calls, is also an advantage. 

What we offer 

  • Become part of SDU’s growing environment for microelectronics and chip technology. 

  • Build partnerships that may lead to new products, technologies, companies, and investments. 

  • Work directly with promising Danish start-ups, companies and research environments. 

  • Help create new university–industry collaborations. 

  • Develop national and European networks within a strategically important technology area. 

  • Influence the formation of projects from their earliest stages.  

  • Collaborate with leading researchers and industry specialists, in an international and interdisciplinary environment. 

  • A role with considerable independence and the opportunity to shape the methods, networks, and activities used to identify funding opportunities and develop consortia. 

Your organizational home will be TEK Innovation, the research support and innovation unit at TEK, where you will have colleagues with similar jobs, supporting emerging ecosystems, as well as funding advisors and project managers. Your academic home with SDU Microelectronics, where you will work closely with professor Farshad Moradi and his team.  

For further information about the position, please contact: 

Thit Juul Hvid, Head of TEK Innovation, The Technical Faculty at The University of Southern Denmark tjuul@tek.sdu.dk 

Professor Farshad Moradi, SDU Microelectronics, The Technical faculty at The University of Southern Denmark at moradi@sdu.dk  

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. 

The application deadline is November 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST).

First Interview: week 46, second interview, week 47.

The startdate will be January 1, 2027, or at the earliest convenience.

Salary and employment terms:  

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. title: Two-year Postdoctoral Position on Spintronics for Advanced Computing: Spintronic Device Fabrication, Characterization and Advanced Computing
description:
The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year position as a postdoctoral researcher within spintronic computing. The position offers an exciting opportunity to advance spintronics through device physics, simulation, fabrication, experimental characterization, and integration of spintronic devices for advanced computing applications.

We are seeking a highly motivated candidate to investigate, design, fabricate, and characterize spintronic devices, with particular emphasis on Anisotropic Magnetoresistance (AMR), Giant Magnetoresistance (GMR), and Tunneling Magneto Resistance (TMR) devices. The work will combine magnetic and spintronic device physics, materials and multilayer structures, device fabrication, electrical measurement, modelling, and data analysis, with the aim of developing reliable spintronic technologies for advanced computing and emerging semiconductor applications.

The research will focus on understanding, controlling, and exploiting thermal fluctuations and stochastic switching in MTJs for physical entropy generation and energy-efficient computing, with particular emphasis on True Random Number Generators (TRNGs) and Stochastic Neural Accelerators (SNAs).

The successful candidate will work on the physics-based design, modelling, simulation, fabrication, and experimental characterization of spintronic devices and their integration into advanced computing systems. The position also includes a role in the Danish Chips Competence Center, where the candidate will contribute to connecting the Danish semiconductor and spintronics ecosystem with relevant EU pilot lines, facilitating collaboration, technology development, prototyping, and access to European semiconductor fabrication capabilities. The candidate will also contribute to preparing and writing research proposals and funding applications related to spintronics, semiconductor technologies, and advanced computing.

As a spintronic postdoc, you are expected to: 

  • Perform atomistic and micromagnetic simulations of s-MTJ structures and magnetization dynamics to investigate switching mechanisms, thermal activation, stochasticity, variability, and operating conditions relevant to TRNG and SNA applications.

  • Contribute to the electrical, magnetic, and transport characterization of fabricated AMR, GMR, and TMR devices, including resistance states, magnetoresistance, switching behaviour, current/voltage dependence, temperature dependence, and device-to-device variability, and correlate experimental results with modelling and simulation.

 

What we offer 

  • A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing section integrating expertise in analog/digital IC design, spintronics, advanced computing, semiconductor technologies, and energy-efficient system architectures. 

  • Access to advanced facilities and infrastructure for spintronic device design, fabrication, electrical and magnetic characterization, and system prototyping, together with opportunities to collaborate with relevant Danish and European pilot-line and semiconductor facilities. 

  • Excellent opportunities for collaboration across SDU and with national and international academic and industrial partners in microelectronics, semiconductor technology, photonics, spintronics, and advanced computing, including activities connecting the Danish ecosystem with EU pilot lines.

  • An open and collaborative research culture within SDU’s Faculty of Engineering (TEK), The Mads Clausen Institute (MCI), promoting interdisciplinary innovation across electronics, materials science, semiconductor processing, spintronics, and artificial intelligence.

 

What we expect 

Applicants should hold a PhD in Electronic and Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or a closely related field (the degree should have been completed within the last 6 years at most): 

  • Expertise in spintronics, magnetism, magnetic device physics, or related areas, with demonstrated experience in physics-based modelling and/or simulation of magnetic or spintronic devices. Experience with s-MTJ devices, stochastic magnetization dynamics, or thermal switching is highly desirable and electrical modeling of sMTJs using Verilog to be used in Cadense

  • Experience with experimental characterization of AMR, GMR, MTJ, or related spintronic devices, including electrical and magnetic measurements, resistance and magnetoresistance characterization, switching behaviour, and data analysis. Experience with pilot-line activities, technology transfer, or collaboration with semiconductor foundries is an advantage.

  • A strong research track record demonstrated through peer-reviewed publications and the ability to work effectively in collaborative research environments. Experience in writing research proposals, funding applications, or project plans is highly desirable.

  • Team player with strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively with academic, industrial, and technology-development partners across Denmark and Europe. 

All candidates must demonstrate excellent verbal and written English skills, along with very good communication abilities and the ability to communicate technical results to multidisciplinary and international partners. 

 

Workplace description 

The successful candidate will join SDU Microelectronics, a dynamic and expanding section at the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering (IME). The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, semiconductor technologies, spintronics, photonics, and advanced computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation. Within the DKCCC project, the candidate will contribute to strengthening connections between the Danish ecosystem and EU pilot lines and to translating spintronic device research into fabrication, prototyping, and technology-development activities.

For further information about the position, please contact Professor Farshad Moradi (moradi@sdu.dk / email), Head of the SDU Microelectronics section and Associate Professor Hooman Farkhani (farkhani@sdu.dk / email), Deputy Head of SDU Microelectronics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

title: Two-year Postdoc position on Spintronic Quantum-inspired Computing
description:
Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a 2-year Postdoctoral Researcher position within the newly funded QUANTRONIC – Spintronic Pseudo-Qubits for Room-Temperature Quantum Computing project, supported by the Villum Experiment programme of Villum Fonden.

We are seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to investigate a new class of spintronic pseudo-qubits (p-qubits) based on spin-orbit torque magnetic tunnel junctions (SOT-MTJs). The project explores whether engineered stochastic spintronic devices can reproduce key computational mechanisms associated with quantum systems - including superposition-like states, probability-amplitude-based interference, and entanglement-like correlations—without relying on fragile quantum coherence or cryogenic operation.

QUANTRONIC is a high-risk, high-gain research project positioned at the intersection of spintronics, probabilistic computing, quantum-inspired computing, nanoelectronics, and integrated circuit design. The central concept is a novel SOT-MTJ architecture designed to represent and manipulate probability amplitudes and to enable synchronization between multiple pseudo-qubits. The project will combine physics-based modelling, device design and fabrication, experimental characterization, and system-level demonstrations.

The successful candidate will work within SDU Microelectronics and collaborate closely with international partners, particularly INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory, on the design and fabrication of spintronic devices.

The position is expected to start in February 2027, with the specific starting date to be agreed with the successful candidate.

 

As a Postdoctoral Researcher in QUANTRONIC, your key responsibilities will include:

  • Develop and refine physics-based compact models of SOT-MTJ-based pseudo-qubits, including stochastic switching and inter-device coupling.

  • Develop Verilog-A models and integrate them into circuit-level simulation environments such as Cadence.

  • Investigate the physical requirements for controlling probabilistic states and representing probability amplitudes in spintronic devices.

  • Collaborate with project partners on the design and fabrication of SOT-MTJ devices and arrays.

  • Experimentally characterize standalone devices and coupled arrays, including stochastic switching, synchronization, and entanglement-like correlations.

  • Investigate quantum-inspired gate operations and system-level demonstrations using networks of pseudo-qubits.

  • Contribute to proof-of-concept demonstrations, including integer factorization and other quantum-inspired computational problems.

  • Publish research results in high-quality international journals and conferences and contribute to the dissemination of project results.

  • Collaborate with researchers in spintronics, probabilistic computing, microelectronics, materials science, and quantum information.

 

What we offer

  • A unique opportunity to work on a high-risk, high-gain research concept exploring a new computational regime between classical probabilistic and quantum computing.

  • A stimulating research environment within SDU Microelectronics, a growing research section with expertise in spintronics, probabilistic computing, neuromorphic computing, analog/digital IC design, and emerging computing architectures.

  • Access to advanced facilities for electronic design, device characterization, measurement, and system prototyping.

  • Close collaboration with INL – International Iberian Nanotechnology Laboratory on spintronic device technology and fabrication.

  • Opportunities to collaborate with national and international researchers in spintronics, quantum-inspired computing, quantum technologies, and nanoelectronics.

  • An open, international, and collaborative research environment within SDU's Faculty of Engineering, supporting interdisciplinary research across electronics, physics, materials science, and computing.

  • Strong opportunities for developing an independent research profile in an emerging area of probabilistic and quantum-inspired hardware.

 

What we expect

Applicants should hold a PhD in electronic engineering, electrical engineering, applied physics, nanotechnology, spintronics, or a closely related field.

The ideal candidate should have experience in one or more of the following areas:

  • Spintronics and magnetic devices, particularly MTJs, STT-MTJs, SOT-MTJs, or related technologies.

  • Physics-based modelling of nanoscale or magnetic devices.

  • Verilog-A, SPICE, and Cadence or comparable circuit/device simulation environments.

  • Experimental characterization of electronic, magnetic, or spintronic devices.

  • Stochastic or probabilistic computing systems.

Experience in micromagnetic simulation, magnetotransport measurements, nanofabrication, probabilistic computing, or quantum/quantum-inspired computing will be considered a strong advantage.

We are particularly interested in candidates who are enthusiastic about working across traditional disciplinary boundaries and are comfortable combining device physics, modelling, experimentation, and computing concepts.

The successful candidate should be able to work independently while contributing actively to an interdisciplinary and international research team. Excellent written and spoken English and strong communication skills are required.

The section conducts internationally recognized research in integrated circuits, spintronics, photonics, and neuromorphic computing, and plays a central role in SDU’s ambition to be a national and European hub for semiconductor and chip innovation.

title: Soojusenergeetikainseneer, tootmisjuht
description:
Tööülesanded: Peamised ülesanded:
Tootmisjuht vastutab ettevõtte soojusenergia tootmise ja kaugküttevõrkude tehniliselt ohutu, töökindla, efektiivse ja nõuetekohase toimimise eest. Tootmisjuht korraldab ja juhib ettevõtte katlamajade ning kaugküttevõrkude igapäevast käitamist, hooldust, remonti ja arendamist ning vastutab tootmisega seotud tehniliste protsesside, personali ja tööohutuse korraldamise eest. Ettevõtte tootmisüksused hõlmavad hakkpuidul ja kütteõlil töötavaid katlamaju.

Omalt poolt pakume: • Huvitavat ja vaheldusrikast tööd konkurentsivõimelises ning arenevas ettevõttes
• Kaasaegseid töötingimusi ja -vahendeid • Arengu ja enesetäiendamise võimalusi • Konkurentsivõimelist töötasu • Tööauto

Muud nõuded: Kandidaadile esitatavad kohustuslikud nõuded:
Haridus ja kutsekvalifikatsioon • kõrgharidus energeetika, soojustehnika, soojusenergeetika või muul asjakohasel tehnikaerialal; • eelistatult Soojusenergeetikainsener, tase 6 või Diplomeeritud soojusenergeetikainsener, tase 7; • eeliseks on tase 7 kutse spetsialiseerumisega: - Kaugkütte- ja kaugjahutussüsteemid; - Soojusseadmed, soojusallikad ja soojuskeskused; - Soojusmajandus. Töökogemus: • vähemalt 5 aastat töökogemust energeetika, soojustehnika või katlamajade käidu valdkonnas; • vähemalt 3 aastat kogemust tootmise, tehnilise üksuse või katlamaja juhtimisega seotud ametikohal; • praktiline kogemus vähemalt mitme MW võimsusega katlamajade käidus; • praktiline kogemus hakkpuidul töötavate katelde käidu korraldamisel; • praktiline kogemus kütteõlil töötavate katelde käidu korraldamisel; • kogemus kaugküttevõrkude käidu ja hoolduse korraldamisel; • kogemus tehnilise personali juhtimisel; • kogemus hooldus- ja remonditööde planeerimisel ning korraldamisel. Kandidaadil peavad olema head teadmised: • katlamajade ja soojusenergia tootmise tehnoloogiast; • hakkpuidul töötavate katelde tööpõhimõtetest ja käidust; • kütteõlikatelde tööpõhimõtetest ja käidust; • soojusvõrkude ja soojussõlmede toimimisest; • pumpadest, soojusvahetitest ja muudest soojusenergia tootmise ning jaotamise seadmetest; • automaatikast ja protsessijuhtimisest; • seadmete hooldusest ja tehnilisest diagnostikast; • seadmete ohutu kasutamise nõuetest; • surveseadmete ohutuse nõuetest; • töötervishoiu ja tööohutuse nõuetest; • tuleohutuse põhimõtetest; • tootmisega seotud keskkonnanõuetest; • tehniliste auditite ja kontrollide korraldamisest; • kaugkütte toimimise ja majandusliku korralduse põhimõtetest; • energiatarbimise ja tootmise efektiivsuse analüüsist. Kandidaat peab tundma oma tööülesannete ulatuses eelkõige: • Seadme ohutuse seadust; • Kaugkütteseadust; • Töötervishoiu ja tööohutuse seadust; • asjakohaseid surveseadmeid, katlaid ja nende kasutamist reguleerivaid õigusakte; • keskkonna- ja tuleohutuse nõudeid; • elektripaigaldiste ohutu käidu nõudeid oma vastutusala ulatuses; • ettevõtte tegevusloa ning soojuse tootmise ja jaotamisega seotud nõudeid.

title: Product Engineer
description:
Work tasks: Hausing is a dedicated property management software platform that helps commercial property managers and owners save time through automation and gain a real-time overview with centralized portfolio data. The solution replaces manual and unreliable spreadsheets, allowing users to track lease changes, special agreements, work orders, utilities, and analytics in one place. Core features include task management, lease management, automated preventive maintenance calendars, and automated utility cost sharing with quick invoice generation. Hausing also provides robust analytics, such as rent-rolls, task reports, vacancy reports, and tenant changes, in both spreadsheet and visual formats. The team focuses on building practical, data-driven tools that make property operations more efficient and transparent.
What you'll do: - Design and develop reliable, user-friendly solutions that make a real difference for our customers. - Work closely with stakeholders to ensure business needs align with technical capabilities. - Take part in cross-functional initiatives to reduce technical debt and improve long-term scalability. - Proactively identify and solve complex problems. - Share your knowledge and help drive engineering excellence across the team.

We offer: Benefits:
- Professional development and career growth opportunities. - Autonomy in organizing and managing your own work. - A modern and inspiring work environment. - An inclusive company culture where employees' opinions are valued and taken into account. - Remote work opportunities. - Flexible working hours. - Flexible arrangements to support a healthy work-life balance.

Other requirements: What we're looking for:
- Strong skills in Java development and familiarity with React or similar frameworks. - Experience in building technical solutions for complex business logic. - Experience in API design and/or service-oriented architecture. - Solid competence in working with relational databases. - Familiarity with AWS or similar environments. - An AI-first mindset and curiosity to explore how AI can improve both your workflow and the products you build. - Familiarity with product engineering methodologies. - Willingness to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment. - Courage to take responsibility, show initiative, and give constructive feedback. - Proficiency in Estonian language is a plus.

title: Autoremondilukksepp
description:
Varasem kogemus autoremondi vallas vähemalt aasta.

Tööülesanded: Meil on töökojas tõstukid, tööriistad, õli, rooste, katkised autod ja aeg-ajalt ka klient, kes vannub, et “enne teie juurde tulekut oli kõik korras”.
Kui sa ei minesta rooste peale, ei hakka nutma kinnise poldi pärast ja tead, et “kliendi sõber juba vaatas” tähendab tavaliselt uut õudusfilmi kapoti all — siis räägime. Puudu on veel üks **autoremondi lukksepp**, kes ei hakka nutma, kui polt on kinni, käsi on must või kapoti alt vaatab vastu järjekordne “kodune remont”.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meie poolt:
🔥 normaalne palk — kui oskad, siis saad ka raha; 🔥 päris töö, mitte niisama kapoti silitamine; 🔥 seltskond, kus nalja saab ja lumehelbekesed sulavad kiiresti; 🔥 tööriided, lisasoodustused; 🔥 autod, mille kallal saad oma viha seaduslikult välja elada.

Muud nõuded: Ootame sind, kui:
✅ tead, et haamer ei ole alati vägivald — vahel on see diagnostikavahend; ✅ saad aru, et “klõbin ees vasakul” võib tähendada kõike alates kondist kuni täieliku katastroofini; ✅ ei arva, et piduritoru paikamine teibiga on loominguline lahendus; ✅ oskad autot remontida nii, et see pärast ka päriselt töötab; ✅ sul on töötahe suurem kui soov reede pärastlõunal kella vaadata.

title: Breakfast Cook
description:
Work tasks: Kolm Õde boutique hotel (Pikk 71, Tallinn Old Town) is looking for a breakfast chef to join our team. Our breakfast is a buffet focused on Estonian produce and bread and pastries baked on site, and it is open to guests of the hotel and our apartments as well as to outside visitors.
Your main duties: - preparing hot and cold breakfast dishes (egg dishes, porridges, hot sides, salads, cold cuts, smoked fish, etc.); - baking bread, buns and morning pastries on site; - setting up the buffet before opening and keeping it replenished during breakfast; - taking care of the taste, freshness and attractive presentation of the food; - preparing for the next day (doughs, prep work, etc.); - monitoring stock, preparing orders and receiving deliveries; - following food hygiene and self-monitoring (HACCP) requirements, checking temperatures and shelf life; - keeping the kitchen, equipment and tools clean and in order; - working closely with the breakfast server and reception, and helping develop the menu. You are responsible for making sure every morning starts with a tasty, fresh and beautifully presented breakfast for our guests.

We offer: - Work in a unique setting: Kolm Õde boutique hotel is housed in three medieval merchant houses in the heart of Tallinn Old Town.
- The opportunity to bring your own ideas to the menu. - Morning working hours – your evenings stay free. - Work uniform. - A small, friendly team and international guests. - A central location that is easy to reach by public transport.

Other requirements: - Previous experience as a cook (experience with breakfast service, hotel kitchens or baking is a big plus).
- Valid health certificate (tervisetõend). - Willingness to work early mornings, as well as on Saturdays and Sundays. - Cleanliness, accuracy, independence and good time management. - A desire to cook tasty, beautifully presented food and to help develop our new breakfast concept.

Option to work from home: No

title: Perintäasiantuntija
description:
Etsimme Tallinnan toimistollemme perintäasiantuntijaa, joka vastaa Suomessa olevien saatavien päivittäisestä hallinnasta ja perinnästä sekä yhteydenpidosta velallisiin ja yhteistyökumppaneihin suomeksi.Tavoitteenasi on löytää toimivia maksujärjestelyjä ja seurata kunkin perintäasian etenemistä sen ratkaisemiseen asti. Työssä yhdistyvät vahva kielitaito, analyyttinen ajattelu sekä rauhallinen ja määrätietoinen neuvotteluote.

**Työtehtäväsi**

- Hoidat vastuullesi osoitettua Suomen saatavasalkkua, priorisoit työsi ja huolehdit määräajoista sekä kunkin perintäasian seuraavista vaiheista.

- Tarkistat saatavien perusteena olevat asiakirjat, saatavien määrät ja maksusuoritukset sekä selvität, mitä lisätietoja tai asiakirjoja asian käsittelyn jatkaminen edellyttää.

- Olet yhteydessä velallisiin suomeksi puhelimitse ja sähköpostitse, selität saatavan sisällön ymmärrettävästi sekä vastaat perintää koskeviin kysymyksiin.

- Neuvottelet velkojen maksamisesta, selvität maksuvaikeuksien syitä ja etsit tilanteeseen sopivia ratkaisuja yrityksen antamien valtuuksien puitteissa.

- Laadit maksusopimuksia ja maksusuunnitelmia, seuraat niiden toteutumista ja reagoit maksuviiveisiin.

- Käsittelet velallisten esittämiä vastaväitteitä ja riitautettuja saatavia, kokoat tarvittavan todistusaineiston ja teet vaativissa tapauksissa yhteistyötä juridisten yhteistyökumppaneidemme kanssa.

- Valmistelet oikeudelliseen perintään ja ulosottoon liittyviä asiakirjoja. Pidät vastuualueellasi yhteyttä Suomen tuomioistuimiin ja ulosottoviranomaiseen sekä seuraat asioiden etenemistä. Tarvittaessa osallistut oikeuden istuntoihin.

- Pidät perintäjärjestelmän tiedot, sopimukset ja yhteydenpitohistorian ajan tasalla. Käsittelet henkilötietoja huolellisesti ja noudatat salassapito- ja tietosuojavaatimuksia.

- Noudatat Suomen perintää koskevia säännöksiä ja hyvää perintätapaa sekä pidät tehtävässä tarvittavan osaamisesi ajan tasalla.

- Raportoit esihenkilöllesi perintäasioiden tilanteesta, maksusuorituksista ja haastavista tapauksista sekä teet ehdotuksia toimintatapojen kehittämiseksi.


**Odotamme sinulta**

- **Erinomaista suullista ja kirjallista suomen kielen taitoa.** Pystyt käymään itsenäisesti neuvotteluja puhelimitse, laatimaan huoliteltua kirjeenvaihtoa sekä ymmärtämään saataviin ja perintämenettelyihin liittyviä asiakirjoja.

- **Korkeakoulututkintoa**, mielellään oikeustieteen, talouden tai rahoituksen alalta.

- Vähintään kolmen vuoden työkokemusta perinnästä tai siihen läheisesti liittyvistä rahoitus- tai oikeusalan tehtävistä.

- Hyviä neuvottelutaitoja ja kykyä toimia rauhallisesti haastavissa tilanteissa. Osaat kuunnella toista osapuolta ja päästä selkeisiin sopimuksiin.

- Analyyttistä ajattelua, tarkkuutta ja kykyä organisoida työsi itsenäisesti. Osaat arvioida saataviin liittyviä asiakirjoja ja numerotietoja sekä hoitaa useita perintäasioita samanaikaisesti.

- Luotettavuutta, vastuuntuntoa ja hienotunteisuutta henkilötietojen sekä luottamuksellisen tiedon käsittelyssä.

- Hyvää MS Office -ohjelmien, myös Excelin, käyttötaitoa sekä valmiutta oppia käyttämään perintäjärjestelmiä ja tietokantoja.

- Viron tai englannin kielen taitoa, jolla pystyt hoitamaan päivittäisen työasioihin liittyvän viestinnän tiimin kanssa.


Eduksi katsomme

- **Ruotsin kielen taidon**, jonka avulla pystyt asioimaan ruotsinkielisten velallisten ja yhteistyökumppaneiden kanssa.

- Aiemman kokemuksen saatavien perinnästä Suomessa sekä Suomen perintä- ja ulosottomenettelyjen periaatteiden tuntemuksen.

- Kokemuksen riitautettujen saatavien, vaativien asiakastapausten tai laajan saatavasalkun hoitamisesta.

title: Office Assistant
description:
Work tasks: The Role:
Dal’s Kitchen is looking for an organised and proactive Office & Food Safety Assistant to support our CEO and daily office operations while helping maintain our food-safety and BRCGS compliance systems. This is a varied position divided between office and executive-assistant duties and food-safety administration and internal auditing. It is suitable for someone who is highly organised, comfortable working with documents and systems, and interested in developing a career within food manufacturing and quality management. Office responsibilities: • Provide general administrative support to the CEO and wider management team. • Manage the CEO’s diary, appointments, meetings and reminders. • Organise meetings, prepare agendas, take minutes and follow up on agreed actions. • Maintain accurate customer, distributor and supplier information in the company CRM. • Prepare and issue customer invoices, credit notes and supporting documentation. • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate payment follow-ups. • Conduct research for the CEO, including suppliers, customers, distributors, competitors, logistics providers and new markets. • Prepare reports, presentations, spreadsheets and business correspondence. • Manage office documents, digital filing and confidential company information. • Coordinate travel arrangements, visits and external meetings when required. • Assist with purchasing, quotations and communication with service providers. • Support recruitment administration and employee-document management. • Monitor deadlines and ensure important actions are completed on time. Food-safety responsibilities • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Dal’s Kitchen food-safety and quality-management system. • Help maintain BRCGS, HACCP, food-safety, quality and operational records. • Plan, conduct and document scheduled internal food-safety and BRCGS audits. • Support external BRCGS and customer audits by preparing documentation, evidence and follow-up information. • Maintain the internal audit schedule and monitor completion against deadlines. • Record non-conformities and coordinate corrective and preventive actions with responsible team members. • Follow up corrective actions and verify that they have been completed effectively. • Assist with document control, including procedures, work instructions, forms and records. • Review production, cleaning, temperature, traceability, allergen and hygiene records for completeness. • Support traceability exercises, product-recall tests and other compliance checks. • Assist with supplier approval, specifications, certificates and food-safety documentation. • Monitor staff training records and help organise refresher training. • Report food-safety concerns, overdue actions and compliance risks to the CEO. • Help ensure the site remains prepared for announced and unannounced audits. BRCGS Food Safety Issue 9 provides a framework covering product safety, integrity, legality, quality and operational controls within food manufacturing; official certification is completed by an independent certification body, while this position would conduct internal audits and support certification audits.

We offer: What we offer
• A varied position with direct involvement in business operations and food safety. • The opportunity to work closely with the CEO and gain experience across multiple business functions. • Practical exposure to BRCGS, HACCP and food-manufacturing compliance. • Training and development relevant to the position. • The opportunity to grow with Dal’s Kitchen as the company develops. • Salary based on experience and qualifications.

Other requirements: • Väga hea eesti- ning inglise keele oskus, vene keel on eelis, kuid mitte kohustuslik. • Kehtiv B-kategooria juhiluba ja valmisolek regulaarseks reisimiseks Eestis ja välismaal. • Suurepärane suhtlemis-, läbirääkimis- ja esinemisoskus. • Tugev ärisuhete loomise võime ning praktiline, tulemustele orienteeritud tööstiil. • Hea MS Office’i kasutusoskus (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) ning kogemus CRM-i või müügiaruandluse tööriistadega. Positsioon sobib Sulle, kui oled: • Proaktiivne ja iseseisev algataja, kes suudab ise uusi kontakte luua ning oma müügitööd juhtida. • Struktureeritud, usaldusväärne ning valmidus töötama eesmärkide ja KPI-dega. • Kirg toidu vastu ning huvi Aasia köögi trendide vastu Eesti turul. • Meeskonnamängija, kes naudib koostööd kolleegidega müügi-, tootmis- ja turundusvaldkonnas.

description:
Work tasks: - Welcome guests warmly, assist with seating arrangements, and provide exceptional service by answering inquiries and offering menu recommendations for food and beverages.
- Prepare and serve food, and hot and cold drinks to established standards, ensuring quality and consistency. - Organize workstations, operate tools and appliances in the serving and work area, and notify the kitchen of low stock levels as needed. - Operate the POS system to process cash, card, and digital payments accurately, providing receipts and resolving customer payment inquiries professionally. - Open and close the restaurant in accordance with approved Company procedures and checklists, ensuring that all required opening and closing tasks are properly and fully completed. - Prepare and maintain the customer display/service line, including baking semi-ready products, arranging products, and ensuring appropriate availability, replenishment, presentation, and cleanliness. - Organize, coordinate, supervise, and control the daily operations of the restaurant-bakery, including customer service, cleaning, storage, inventory, and overall operational readiness. - Maintain and ensure compliance with food safety, hygiene, cleaning, allergen management, occupational safety, equipment, and workplace requirements. - Guide, supervise, train, and support servers and other assigned employees; provide instructions and feedback, assess their job performance, coordinate their work and priorities, and ensure assigned duties are properly and fully completed by assigned employees. - Communicate and coordinate effectively with servers, cleaners, management, suppliers, contractors, and other service providers to support smooth restaurant operations. - Participate in and coordinate employee recruitment, including reviewing CVs and applications, communicating with candidates, conducting interviews, assessing candidates against position requirements, and supporting the selection of suitable employees. - Prepare and coordinate employee schedules, breaks, replacements, and staff deployment, adjusting staffing according to workload, absences, and operational requirements. - Monitor customer service and assist service staff when operationally necessary, particularly during busy periods, breaks, staff shortages, or absences. - Complete and monitor required production, inventory, cleaning, temperature, write-off, operational, and other records, checklists, documents, and reports. - Manage and participate in continuous improvement of operations. title: Research fellow (University Researcher) in AI for Population Health and Genomics
description:
Research fellow (University Researcher) in AI for Population Health and Genomics
The Faculty of Science and the Finnish Institute for Molecular Medicine Finland (FIMM), HiLIFE at the University of Helsinki invite applications for a joint (50%:50%) position as
RESEARCH FELLOW (UNIVERSITY RESEARCHER) IN AI FOR POPULATION HEALTH AND GENOMICS
for a fixed-term appointment of maximum 4 years with starting date as soon as possible.
POSITION DESCRIPTION
The position relates to the Sustainable Wellbeing Across Lifespan (SWAN) (https://www.swan-helsinkiuni.net/) research action that conducts cutting-edge research to promote health span by identifying individual risks and susceptibilities, aiming to clarify mechanisms of degeneration across the lifespan and exploring new approaches to detecting, monitoring and treating remodeled metabolism associated with ageing.
The candidate is expected to develop an independent research program within this scope, focusing on methodological innovation and the application of modern AI approaches to large-scale biomedical data. Research topics may include foundation models for longitudinal electronic health records and genomics, multimodal learning integrating health records with molecular data, causal representation learning, in-context learning and amortized inference for healthcare decision-making, and AI-assisted scientific discovery workflows.
The work will be done together with the Ganna Lab (https://www.dsgelab.org/) at FIMM and the Probabilistic Machine Learning Lab (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/researchgroups/probabilistic-machine-learning; groups of Acerbi and Klami) at the Department of Computer Science, aligning with concurrent projects developing foundation models for healthcare. The groups are active members of the ELLIS Institute Finland (https://www.ellisinstitute.fi/), providing opportunities for collaboration with leading researchers in artificial intelligence across Finland and Europe.
The position offers access to globally unique research resources, including nationwide longitudinal health records from Finland covering more than five billion healthcare events, FinnGen with genomic data from over 500,000 participants, and extensive multi-omics datasets including proteomics and single-cell transcriptomics. Researchers also benefit from access to world-class computing infrastructure through CSC and LUMI, one of Europe's most powerful supercomputers.
RESPONSIBILITIES
The appointed researcher is expected to pursue independent research on methodological innovation in developing and applying AI methods, in collaboration with existing research groups at the university, and will have the opportunity to be part of ELLIS Institute Finland activities. They will also participate in university-wide activities advancing the use of AI in scientific research, together with other researchers working in the intersection of AI and other scientific disciplines.The daily working activities of the appointed researcher will be split between the Faculty of Science and FIMM. Opportunities for contribution to teaching (up to 5-10% of annual working time) will be provided.
QUALIFICATIONS
We require a doctoral degree and postdoctoral research experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, or computational statistics, with demonstrated interest in applications to population health and/or human genetics.
The candidates need to have:
* A doctoral degree in a suitable field
* Research activity after PhD (typically 2-4 years of postdoctoral research), ideally with evidence of independent research contributions, ability to lead a research group, experience in research funding acquisition, and public engagement.
* Scientific competence in developing and/or applying artificial intelligence methods with proven publication record in scientific venues in the field. We expect publication record in top-tier venues in AI and machine learning (e.g. NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, or similar) and/or publications with clear AI contributions in leading biomedical journals (e.g. Nature Genetics, Nature Medicine, Nature Machine Intelligence or similar).
* Personal research interest that relates to the scope and topic of the position and connects to existing research groups at the University of Helsinki.

WHAT WE OFFER
University of Helsinki is an equal opportunity employer and offers an attractive and diverse workplace with a variety of development opportunities and benefits. The appointees monthly salary varies between 4800-6000€ depending on their previous experience and qualifications. The employment contract will include a probationary period of six months.

The appointee is expected to reside in Finland while employed by the University of Helsinki. International staff are supported in relocating to Finland.
HOW TO APPLY
Please submit your application, together with the required attachments, through the University of Helsinki Recruitment System via the link "Apply now" (Hae nyt). Use your current email address to register to the Recruitment System. The closing date for applications is 16 November 2026.
The following documents in English are required and must be included in the application:
1) A curriculum vitae
2) List of publications
3) An accompanying 2–5-page document covering both qualifications for the Research Fellow level, and description of the planned research.
If you are invited to an interview, you will be asked contact details of 2 referees.
FURTHER INFORMATION
Further information about the positions and the research project may be obtained from Professor Arto Klami at the Faculty of Science (arto.klami(at)helsinki.fi), and from Professor Andrea Ganna at FIMM (andrea.ganna(at)helsinki.fi).

title: Raskaan kaluston asentaja (Pohjois-Pirkanmaa)
description:
Etsimme Pohjois-Pirkanmaalla sijaitsevalle asiakasyrityksellemme RASKAAN KALUSTON ASENTAJAA kokoaikaiseen ja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Mikäli sinulla on kokemusta raskaan kaluston huolto- ja asennustöistä sekä vahva ymmärrys hydrauliikasta ja mekaniikasta, saatat olla juuri etsimämme osaaja.

Työtehtäväsi koostuvat kuorma-autojen katsastusremonteista, joissa vastaat mm. jarrujen ja ohjauslaitteiden tarkastamisesta, asentamisesta ja huoltamisesta. Työnkuva sisältää myös hitsaamista, joten MIG-hitsaustaitoa tarvitaan, ja mahdollinen puikkohitsaustaito koetaan eduksesi. Työaika on joustava arkisin maanantaista perjantaihin (40 h/vko), joten sinulla on mahdollista sovitella itse työaikasi viikkotuntien sisälle.

Toivomme sinulta:

\- kokemusta raskaan kaluston asennuksesta ja huollosta

\- kykyä etsiä ja ratkaista teknisiä ongelmia

\- osaamista hydrauliikasta ja mekaniikasta

\- kokemusta vianhausta sekä koneiden testauksesta

Tarjoamme sinulle:

\- kokoaikaisen ja vakituisen työsuhteen vakaassa yrityksessä

\- monipuoliset ja teknisesti mielenkiintoiset työtehtävät

\- kattavan työterveyshuollon

title: Granlund: Senior Full Stack Developer (C#, React)
description:
**Type**: Full-time, permanent

**Location**: Malminkaari 21, 00700 Helsinki

**Application deadline**: 26.10.2026

Experienced with C#/.NET and React? Join Granlund to take ownership of a growing software platform and shape its future development!

**What will you be doing?**

Granlund is looking for a **Senior Full Stack Developer** to further develop its Design Data Management (DDM) platform. DDM transforms building information models into structured, usable data for cost, lifecycle, and 4D calculations. The platform is already in production, with new features and use cases actively being explored. Your work will help turn these opportunities into practical solutions for the construction and real estate industry.

In this role, you will develop the DDM platform, focusing mainly on C#/.NET backend development and SQL Server, while also working with React and TypeScript on the frontend. You will develop new features end-to-end, improve existing functionality, and propose practical technical and architectural solutions. Your responsibilities will also include maintaining code quality through automated testing and controlled releases.

You will collaborate with colleagues across different business areas to develop solutions that address real business needs. Beyond implementing new features, you will evaluate technical feasibility and help prioritize development efforts. Initially, your focus will include turning existing proofs of concept into usable features.

**What makes you a great fit?**

We are looking for an experienced developer who has a strong background in software development and actively uses AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, or Cursor. You understand software architecture, can critically evaluate AI-generated code, and enjoy building software.

You take ownership of your work and approach development with a practical, business-oriented mindset. You can assess business needs, identify what is worth developing, and suggest technical solutions that make sense. You also know when something is not worth implementing and can explain why.

You are comfortable working independently in a small team and collaborating with others to make technical decisions. You don't need previous experience in construction or real estate; we welcome applications from developers across all industries.

**We hope you have:**

- Several years of backend development experience, ideally with C#/.NET, and strong SQL skills

- Experience with React and TypeScript, and the ability to develop frontend features independently

- A good understanding of software architecture, clean code, and automated testing

- Hands-on experience building software with AI coding agents, and the judgement to review their output

- Good communication skills in English or Finnish


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with Python and data processing tools, such as FastAPI, pandas, pyarrow, or IfcOpenShell

- Experience working with large language models or developing AI-powered features

- Familiarity with Azure services and CI/CD pipelines

- Experience combining data from different sources into structured, usable information

- Experience in product development, startups, or other environments requiring broad technical ownership.


**What does Granlund offer you?**

- An opportunity to take ownership of a growing software platform and directly influence its technical development.

- Meaningful work turning complex building data into solutions that support smarter and more sustainable construction.

- The freedom to shape technical solutions and see your ideas progress from early concepts into working features.

- A small, collaborative team within an established company, with potential to grow into product or team leadership.

- Flexible remote and hybrid working arrangements that allow you to combine independent development with in-person collaboration.

- Comprehensive employee benefits, including occupational healthcare, sports and cultural benefits, and professional development opportunities.


**Practicalities**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Granlund. The role offers flexible remote and hybrid working arrangements. Still, we hope you are based in the Helsinki metropolitan area or nearby to make it easier to meet in person for collaboration and workshops at Granlund's office in Malmi when needed. We hope you can start as soon as possible, but the exact start date is negotiable.

Salary in this position is approximately 6000-8000 €/month. The final salary will be determined based on your experience and expertise. Granlund also offers a company-wide performance bonus scheme.

**Recruitment process**

- Remote interviews with aTalent

- Two rounds of interviews with Granlund, conducted remotely and/or in person


**Interested? We'd love to hear from you!**

Submit your application and CV in PDF-format latest by the 26th of October via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/390936/create/.

We review applications throughout the application period in the order they are received, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Please note that we only accept applications through our recruitment system, not by email.

We welcome applicants from different backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive recruitment process. We will accommodate individual accessibility needs whenever possible. You can learn more about Granlund at www.granlund.fi. For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Sofia Latva-Koivisto (+358 50 321 4473, sofia.latva-koivisto(at)atalent.fi). If Sofia is unable to answer your call, please leave a text message and she will get back to you.

title: Jul Extra till Normal i Sittkoff Gallerian i Mariehamn

Vi ser fram emot att läsa din ansökan.

title: Lärare inom småbarnspedagogik, Västerskog daghem
description:
Ligger småbarnspedagogik dig varmt om hjärtat?
Vill du vara med och utveckla pedagogiken i en varmhjärtad och omtänksam kommun?

Om svaret är ja, är detta ditt drömjobb!

Vi söker nu till vårt team en LÄRARE INOM SMÅBARNSPEDAGOGIK för en visstids anställning för tiden 7.1.2026- 31.7.2027. Arbetsplatsen är Västerskogs daghem och arbetet inleds enligt överenskommelse från och med 7.1.2026.

Vill du arbeta i en varm, kreativ och flerspråkig miljö där leken står i centrum?
Västerskog daghem söker nu en engagerad lärare inom småbarnspedagogik som vill bli en del av vårt professionella och dedikerade team. Vårt daghem ligger nära naturen, och våra lokaler är trivsamma och funktionella. Gården inbjuder till mångsidig lek och aktivitet.

Våra värderingar är
- närvaro
- arbetsglädje
- barncentrerad pedagogik
- en varm famn

Här får både barn och vuxna vara sig själva — och växa tillsammans.
Vi söker dig som:
- är entusiastisk, flexibel och positiv
- är genuint närvarande i barnens vardag
- möter barnen med värme och sensitivitet, både som individer och som gruppmedlemmar
- har goda samarbetsfärdigheter och en lösningsfokuserad arbetsstil
- vill utveckla småbarnspedagogiken med hjälp av lekpedagogik

Vi lägger stor vikt vid att du trivs i ett team och tycker om att arbeta i en miljö där humor, gemenskap och öppen kommunikation är en naturlig del av vardagen.

Leken är en central del av vår pedagogik. Som lärare inom småbarnspedagogik deltar du aktivt i leken och finns nära barnen i deras utforskande och lärande. Du ansvarar för den pedagogiska verksamheten i din grupp enligt planen för småbarnspedagogik
- enhetens verksamhetsplan
- barnets individuella plan (vasu)

Du planerar, genomför, dokumenterar och utvärderar verksamheten tillsammans med ditt team och barnen. Du får en god introduktion och kontinuerligt stöd av kollegor, daghemsföreståndaren och vår speciallärare inom småbarnspedagogik.

Vi erbjuder ett engagerat och stöttande arbetslag och en varm och inkluderande arbetsmiljö samt dagligt samarbete och kollegialt lärande. Med oss får du möjlighet att utvecklas och påverka pedagogiken genom lek.


Varför skulle du välja just Sibbo?
I småbarnspedagogiken i Sibbo är utvecklingsarbetet smidigt, långsiktigt och övergripande. I det betonas en verksamhetskultur som uppmuntrar till lek och rörelse. Närheten till naturen och tvåspråkigheten är våra styrkor. Vi satsar på kunnandet samt på ett arbetssätt som beaktar barnets bästa.

Vi erbjuder dig:
- en varmhjärtad, kunnig arbetsgemenskap och en omtänksam chef
- starkt stöd av din chef, ditt team och speciallärarna
- en arbetsgivare som bryr sig om just din välfärd
- många möjligheter att utbilda dig och utveckla din yrkeskunskap
- mångsidiga digitala verktyg, utlåning av idrottsredskap
- idrotts-, kultur- och välfärdsförmån (epassi)

Välkommen till vårt varmhjärtade och innovativa team som förverkligar småbarnspedagogiken i Sibbo med stort hjärta!

Behörighetskravet för uppgiften är minst behörighet i enlighet med i lagen om småbarnspedagogik (540/2018), dock så att ikraftträdandet av 74 § och 75 § samt övergångsbestämmelserna tas i beaktande. Läraren inom småbarnspedagogik som väljs ska ha utmärkta muntliga och skriftliga färdigheter i svenska.

Lönen och villkoren för anställningsförhållandet bestäms enligt UKTA Undervisningspersonalen inom småbarnspedagogiken (Del G).
I arbetsförhållandet tillämpas en prövotid. Den uppgiftsrelaterade nivålönen är 3111,76 euro/månad + eventuella tillägg. Den som väljs ska visa upp ett straffregisterutdrag enligt lagen om kontroll av brottslig bakgrund hos personer som arbetar med barn (504/2002) samt ett godtagbart intyg över sitt hälsotillstånd. Enligt lagen om smittsamma sjukdomar ska den som arbetar med barn under skolåldern utreda risken för tuberkulossmitta.

Välkommen med din ansökan! Vi ser fram emot att få en ny kollega som tillsammans med oss vill skapa en trygg, lärorik och glädjefylld vardag för barnen.

Ansökningarna ska lämnas in senast 3.11.2026 kl. 16. Studie- och arbetsintyg i original ska visas upp vid en eventuell intervju.

title: Autonasentaja
description:

Työsuhde on **perhevapaan sijaisuus,** ja se alkaa 2.11.2026. Työtä on tarjolla vähintään **31.08.2027 saakka.**

**Mitä työ pitää sisällään?** Työ on monipuolista henkilö- ja pakettiautojen huolto- ja korjaustyötä. Päivittäisiin töihin kuuluu osaamisesi mukaan esimerkiksi määräaikaishuoltoja, jarru- ja alustatöitä, jakopäätöitä sekä vianetsintää ja muita korjaamotöitä.

B-ajokortti on tehtävässä välttämätön.

Arvostamme erityisesti kokemusta monimerkkikorjaamosta sekä osaamista esimerkiksi vianetsinnästä, alusta- ja jarrutöistä tai moottorin mekaanisista korjauksista.

Jos diagnostiikka, sähkö- ja hybridiautot tai jokin muu osa-alue on erityisesti sinun juttusi, kerro siitä meille.

Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata, mutta **odotamme, että sinulla on jo valmiudet työskennellä autonasentajan tehtävissä.**

**Mitä meiltä sitten saa?** Tarjoamme kokoaikaisen määräaikaisen työn pitkään toimineessa paikallisessa autokorjaamossa, monipuoliset työtehtävät, asianmukaiset työvälineet ja kokeneen työporukan tuen.

**Palkka**: **15-20 €/h osaamisen ja kokemuksen mukaan, vähintään sovellettavan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti.**

Kyseessä on ensisijaisesti perhevapaan sijaisuus, mutta **mahdollisesta jatkosta voidaan keskustella tilanteen mukaan.**

**Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro lyhyesti aikaisemmasta kokemuksestasi sekä siitä, millaiset huolto- ja korjaustyöt ovat sinulle tutuimpia.**

**Hakuaika päättyy 19.10.2026** Käymme hakemuksia läpi ja haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana. **Paikka voidaan täyttää heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.**

title: Support Specialist for BeeHealthy
description:
Join us in our mission to make care smarter!

At BeeHealthy, were on a mission to make care smarter through our configurable, white-label SaaS platform. We combine over 115 years of healthcare expertise with modern technology, serving social, healthcare, and veterinary providers alongside insurance organisations in over 10 countries across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

Were a team of 90+, with 60+ in our product organisation, growing fast and looking for people who want to do meaningful work. If you care about impact, quality, and building products that genuinely improve how care is delivered and received, wed love to hear from you.

Location: Helsinki, Turku, Tampere, or Jyväskylä (Finland) or Berlin (Germany)
Working mode: Remote-friendly, hybrid working model

About the role
As a Support Specialist, you handle support issues independently from intake to resolution, with high-quality ticket handling, customer communication, and documentation. Youll build strong product and platform knowledge, spot recurring issues, and help improve how Support operates.

What you will do
Handle tickets end to end: prioritise, categorise, troubleshoot, resolve, and document them
Investigate issues using logs, tooling, and platform knowledge, and decide when to resolve them yourself and when to escalate
Keep customers updated clearly during incidents, escalations, and follow-ups
Work with SRE and Engineering on complex cases, keeping ownership until issues are resolved or clearly handed over, so nothing gets lost between teams
Spot recurring issues and raise them for Problem Management with the Service Delivery Manager
Turn your troubleshooting into reusable troubleshooting guides and known solutions in our knowledge base
Mentor Junior Support Specialists, helping them build confidence and solve problems on their own
Proactively suggest improvements to support processes, documentation, and ways of working
Work with Service Delivery to ensure relevant customer context is understood and reflected in support communication

What you bring
Previous experience in technical support, IT service desk, or another customer-facing ICT role
Structured troubleshooting skills, including reading logs and narrowing down root causes
Sound judgement on when to dig deeper, when to resolve, and when to escalate
Clear written and spoken communication in English and Finnish, including with customers during incidents
Strong documentation habits
Willingness to mentor and support colleagues

Bonus points
Interest in exploring and developing AI-based solutions that make Support faster and more effective
Experience with Jira Service Management or similar
Familiarity with ITIL practices
Experience in healthcare or another regulated environment, and an understanding of handling sensitive data (GDPR)
German and/or Italian

What success looks like
You resolve support issues independently and efficiently
You make sound escalation decisions and involve SRE or Engineering at the right time
Your tickets are accurate, appropriately prioritised, and well documented
You communicate clearly with customers throughout the support lifecycle
You help Junior Support Specialists develop their troubleshooting and ticket-handling skills
You strengthen the Support knowledge base with practical, reusable documentation
You identify recurring issues and help reduce them through Problem Management and continuous improvement
You contribute to a more consistent and scalable Support operation

Benefits
Generous, Nordic-style paid holiday
Flexible remote-work policy and working hours
Wide range of IT equipment to choose from
Comprehensive occupational healthcare
Sponsored sports or culture memberships
Healthy snacks and drinks at the office
Regular team days, game nights, and social events

Culture at BeeHealthy
At BeeHealthy, freedom and responsibility go hand in hand. Youll be trusted to work independently while collaborating closely with your colleagues, sharing knowledge, learning continuously, and respecting each other both professionally and personally.

Our culture is guided by strong values:
Skill and Knowledge: we never stop learning.
Caring and Responsibility: we look out for each other and the people who use what we build.
Partners and Entrepreneurship: we innovate through collaboration.
Growth and Development: were committed to unlocking potential, both for ourselves and our customers.

Were a close-knit, international team where talent and knowledge-sharing thrive. We believe that building great healthcare technology starts with taking care of the people who build it.

Recruitment process
We read every application: Once the application period closes, we take time to review everyone who applied. You'll hear back from us, whatever the outcome.
Short meeting with our VP Talent: A chance to get to know each other. The focus here is on bringing BeeHealthy's culture and values to life, and exploring how they resonate with your own.

Possible meeting with our C-level team.
Offer: When the right person meets the right role, we'll be in touch to make an offer and talk through the details together.

Apply through our recruitment system by 8 November 2026 by sending your CV and a brief note about why this role excites you. We review applications on a rolling basis and look forward to hearing from you. The start date is flexible and can be agreed together.

title: AUTOMEKAANIKKO – EKODRIVE OY, KERAVA
description:
**AUTOMEKAANIKKO – EKODRIVE OY, KERAVA**

Ekodrive Oy etsii **itsenäistä ja vastuullista automekaanikkoa** pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen Keravalle.

Työvoiman tarve on arviolta **loka–marraskuussa 2026**, mutta etsimme sopivaa henkilöä jo nyt. Jos olet tällä hetkellä töissä mutta harkitset työpaikan vaihtoa myöhemmin syksyllä, voit myös ottaa yhteyttä.

Etsimme mekaanikkoa, joka pystyy hoitamaan tavallisia korjaamotöitä itsenäisesti, tekee työnsä loppuun sovitussa ajassa ja **kantaa vastuun työnsä lopputuloksesta**.

Työhön kuuluu mm.

- määräaikaishuollot ja öljynvaihdot

- jarrujen huolto ja korjaus

- alustan ja ohjauksen korjaukset

- katsastuskorjaukset

- moottori- ja vaihteistoöljyjen vaihdot

- jakohihnojen ja jakopään osien vaihdot

- vikojen etsintä ja perusdiagnostiikka

- rengastyöt

- ilmastointihuollot

- muut tavalliset henkilöautojen korjaamotyöt


Sinun ei tarvitse osata kaikkea, mutta **tavalliset korjaamotyöt pitää pystyä tekemään itsenäisesti**.

Arvostamme mekaanikkoa, joka osaa ajatella käytännöllisesti: vika tutkitaan, korjataan järkevällä tavalla ja työ saatetaan loppuun ilman tarpeetonta asioiden monimutkaistamista.

Odotamme sinulta

- B-luokan ajokorttia

- vastuullisuutta ja luotettavuutta

- oma-aloitteista työotetta

- kykyä tehdä päätöksiä oman työn yhteydessä

- kiinnostusta autoihin ja korjaamiseen

- halua kehittää omaa ammattitaitoa

- kykyä työskennellä normaalisti osana pientä työporukkaa


**Autosähkön, diagnostiikan ja hitsauksen osaaminen on selvä etu.**

Aikaisempi työkokemus autokorjaamolta ja suomen kielen taito ovat plussaa. Työpaikalla voidaan kommunikoida **suomeksi tai venäjäksi**.

Meillä arvostetaan hyvää työilmapiiriä, keskinäistä kunnioitusta ja sitä, että jokainen hoitaa oman työnsä kunnolla.

Meille asiakkaan auto on tärkeä riippumatta sen merkistä, iästä tai arvosta. **Jokainen auto on asiakkaalle tärkeä ja meille työtä.**

Tarjoamme

- vakituisen työn sopivalle henkilölle

- työajan **37,5 h/vko**

- ma–pe **klo 8.00–16.00**

- 6 kuukauden koeajan

- pienen ja kehittyvän työyhteisön

- mahdollisuuden saada enemmän vastuuta ja kehittyä yrityksen kasvaessa

- palkka: **kerro palkkatoiveesi**


Myös **oppilaitoksen kautta tuleva työharjoittelu tai virallinen työkokeilu** voi olla mahdollinen, jos hakijalla on hyvä tekninen perusta, oikea asenne ja realistinen mahdollisuus jatkaa myöhemmin työntekijänä.

HAKEMINEN – VAIN SÄHKÖPOSTITSE

Puhelinhakemuksia emme käsittele.

Pitkää hakemusta ei tarvita. Lähetä lyhyt sähköposti **suomeksi tai venäjäksi** ja vastaa seuraaviin kysymyksiin:

1. Kuinka paljon sinulla on kokemusta automekaanikon työstä?

2. Mitkä korjaukset pystyt tekemään täysin itsenäisesti?

3. Oletko tehnyt jakohihnan/jakopään vaihtoja itsenäisesti?

4. Millainen kokemus sinulla on diagnostiikasta ja autosähköstä?

5. Onko sinulla kokemusta rengastöistä ja ilmastointihuolloista?

6. Onko sinulla voimassa oleva B-ajokortti?

7. Mikä on palkkatoiveesi?

8. Milloin voisit aloittaa?

9. Miksi etsit uutta työpaikkaa ja millaista työpaikkaa etsit pidemmällä aikavälillä?


**Hakemukset ja yhteydenotot ainoastaan sähköpostitse ekodrivepro@gmail.com**

**Ekodrive Oy Kerava**

title: Senior T24 Architect
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior T24 Architect to shape the evolution of a large and complex Core Banking environment. You will define and guide the architecture of the Temenos T24 landscape, making sure that business capabilities, technology platforms and long-term strategic goals stay aligned.

You will work with business stakeholders, engineers, architects and external partners across multiple markets, providing architectural leadership over several initiatives and delivery streams. Your goal is to protect the stability and resilience of business-critical banking services while enabling platform modernisation and simplification.

Key Responsibilities:
 Shape and evolve the architecture roadmap for Temenos T24 and surrounding Core Banking capabilities, defining target-state architecture, principles and standards in line with business and technology strategy
 Provide end-to-end architectural leadership across complex initiatives, ensuring consistency, scalability and sustainability of the Core Banking landscape
 Translate business requirements into robust, implementable solutions, including integrations between Core Banking and payments, digital channels, lending, deposits, customer management and data platforms
 Identify interfaces, data flows and dependencies across applications, infrastructure and external services
 Evaluate architectural alternatives and make clear trade-offs between business value, delivery risk and technical complexity
 Drive modernisation and simplification of the Core Banking ecosystem, promoting API-first, event-driven and cloud-enabled patterns where appropriate
 Improve platform maintainability, testability and operability, and identify opportunities for reuse, automation and standardisation across markets and delivery teams
 Define functional and non-functional requirements for availability, security, performance, scalability, resilience and operability
 Guide architecture reviews to ensure alignment with enterprise standards and regulatory expectations, and maintain the architectural runway for sustainable delivery
 Assess architectural risks, technical debt and lifecycle concerns, and guide proportionate remediation
 Act as a trusted advisor for strategic Core Banking initiatives and technology investment decisions, communicating complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Mentor architects and engineers, fostering collaboration and accountable decision-making within teams

Required Skills and Experience:
 Significant experience with Temenos T24 / Temenos Transact in architecture, solution design or senior engineering roles
 Deep understanding of Core Banking processes, platform capabilities and integration dependencies
 Proven record of leading architecture for large-scale transformation, migration or modernisation initiatives
 Experience working across multiple teams, products or markets in a complex enterprise environment
 Banking experience involving demanding availability, security, resilience and regulatory requirements

title: Sales Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced _Sales Manager_ to join us on our journey toward zero-emission shipping!

**About WE Tech Solutions**

WE Tech Solutions is a Finnish marine technology company leading the way in marine electrification. We develop and deliver advanced energy solutions that help the global shipping industry improve energy efficiency, reduce fuel consumption and lower emissions.

Our technologies combine variable frequency drives, permanent magnet generators, DC power distribution and intelligent energy management into integrated solutions for modern vessels.

Our offering covers Shaft Generator Solutions, Electrification Solutions and Retrofits & Conversions, serving customers across a wide range of vessel types worldwide. With solutions installed on more than 300 vessels, WE Tech combines proven marine technology with an ambitious drive to shape the next generation of efficient and increasingly electrified shipping.

**Sales Manager**

We are looking for a technically strong and commercially driven Sales Manager to grow WE Techs business globally.

The role covers both our Shaft Generator Solutions and Electrification Solutions, ranging from our established variable-speed shaft generator business to hybrid and full-electric propulsion, energy storage integration, DC power distribution and shore power solutions.

The Sales Manager will work directly with shipowners, shipyards, ship designers and technology partners to develop technically and commercially competitive solutions and convert customer needs into successful projects.

**Responsibilities**

The Sales Manager is responsible for designated Sales projects and is reporting to the Sales Director. The Sales Manager is expected to actively sell and develop business across both WE Techs Merchant Marine and Electrification Solutions, combining commercial responsibility with sufficient technical competence to develop solutions together with customers and WE Tech Engineering.

- Actively sell and promote WE Techs complete solution portfolio across both Merchant Marine and Electrification business

- Identify customer needs and develop technically and commercially competitive system solutions together with customers and WE Tech Engineering

- Understand customer vessel electrical architecture, operational requirements and interfaces

- Prepare and negotiate Technical Agreements with customers

- Negotiate and sign Sales Agreements within given authorization

- Represent WE Tech Solutions at trade shows, customer meetings and industry events

- Prepare quotations, technical proposals and other sales documentation

- Calculate and keep up to date Sales project-specific Sales Calculations

- Identify requirements from customer technical specifications, both documented and verbally

- Register and mitigate Sales project risks

- Budget responsibility for designated Sales projects

- Request quotations from sub-suppliers and technology partners

- Ensure quality, technical compliance and validity of sub-supplier quotations

- Coordinate solution definition with Engineering, Product Management, Sourcing and relevant technology partners

- Be part of the Sales Team and peer review related documentation

- Communicate directly with customers and support technical and commercial discussions throughout the sales process

- Communicate Sales projects with Delivery Project Management and Engineering

- Responsible for handover of Sales projects to Delivery Project Management upon closing

- Ensure timely submission of technically correct and commercially competitive quotations

- Develop and maintain Sales-related documentation

- Contribute to Sales network and customer relationship development

- Collect and register market and competitor intelligence

- Maintain and keep Sales project data up to date in CRM


**Competence requirements**

- M.Sc or B.Sc in Electrical, Automation, Marine or equivalent Engineering

- Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in technical sales, marine electrical systems, system integration or similar tasks

- Good understanding of marine electrical power systems, power conversion, drives and system integration

- Ability to understand electrical single-line diagrams, technical specifications and system interfaces

- Commercial mindset and ability to translate customer technical requirements into competitive solutions

- Fluency in English, written and spoken

- Business-minded and result-driven

- Willingness to travel internationally

- Strong negotiation and customer communication skills

- Able to perform under pressure and time constraints

- Excellent teamwork and communication skills in multicultural environments

- Ability to take responsibility and make decisions independently


**Strong advantages**

- Ability to prepare and modify P&I diagrams

- Experience with hybrid and/or full-electric marine propulsion systems

- Knowledge of ESS/battery systems, shore charging, DC distribution, propulsion drives and electrical power management

- Experience in marine system integration and multidisciplinary vessel projects

- Experience working directly with shipowners, shipyards, ship designers and equipment suppliers


Please apply before 31.10.2026.
