title: K Trainee, AI
description:
As a K Trainee, your experience goes beyond your role as an AI Trainee. You will get to explore K Groups business across different areas and broaden your perspective beyond your own field.

You will take on a hands-on professional role while developing your skills and building a network for the start of your career. A personal mentor, development sessions, job shadowing across our different business divisions and opportunities to meet K Group leaders will bring perspectives beyond your day-to-day role.

You will work as part of the AI Solutions team and contribute to the teams ongoing development work. Your assignments will be determined through the teams shared prioritization and will vary according to current business and technology needs. Your skills and experience will also be considered when determining suitable assignments for you. This gives you the opportunity to work on different AI-related challenges and gain broad, practical experience.

Depending on your assignments, you may work on AI agents and generative AI applications, shared AI platforms and components, system integrations, data processing and RAG solutions. Your work may also involve testing and improving large language model based solutions or supporting their operationalisation, monitoring and continuous development through LLMOps practices. You will collaborate with business and technology specialists and learn to look at AI solutions from both a technical perspective and in terms of the business value they create.

What we expect from you
- You have completed a relevant degree within the past six months or youll be graduated in six-months-time. Your studies may focus on artificial intelligence, machine learning, computer science, software engineering or a related field. - You can program in Python and are familiar with common software development tools and practices. - You understand the fundamentals of system integrations, APIs and data processing. - You have basic knowledge of large language models, prompt engineering, generative AI frameworks and RAG architectures. - You are already familiar with LLMOps practices and understand the fundamentals of the operational lifecycle of AI solutions. - You are fluent in both Finnish and English. While English is the working language of the AI Solutions team, the K Trainee programme and its joint activities are conducted in Finnish. - You take an active approach to your assignments, take responsibility for agreed tasks and want to continue developing your skills throughout the traineeship.
Experience with Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services or Snowflake is considered an advantage. We also consider an interest in developing your communication skills and a willingness to share your K Trainee experience on social media an advantage.

What you will gain as a K Trainee
- A real role with real responsibilityYou will join us for a paid traineeship. The final salary will be based on the selected candidates experience and skills. You will contribute to meaningful development work, and your responsibilities will grow as your skills develop. - Personal support for your development You will learn above all by doing, but youll be surrounded by experienced specialists who can support you with everyday questions and help you develop your technical expertise. Your personal mentor and the K Trainee development programme will also support your professional growth. - A broad view of the retail sector You will gain insight into K Group beyond your own role and learn about our three business divisions through the K Trainee programme. - A network for the start of your career You will get to know other K Trainee participants and K Group specialists from different parts of the business. You will build a network that can support you well beyond the programme.
You will also have access to a wide range of employee benefits, including the ePassi culture and sports benefit, employee discounts at K Group stores, occupational healthcare services and leisure-time accident insurance.

You will work in the modern facilities of K Kampus in Helsinki, where employees have access to a gym, saunas, occupational healthcare services, a staff restaurant and a café. The work is carried out according to K Groups hybrid working practices.

The position is fixed-term from January 2027 to September 2027.

Are you ready to join us? LETS K!

Submit your application by 31 October 2026. As part of the preselection stage, selected applicants will be invited to a video interview. On-site interviews will be held during weeks 47-49 at K Kampus in Helsinki. We perform drug testing before the start of the employment relationship.

If you have any questions about the position or the recruitment process, please contact us at rekrytointi@kesko.fi.

You can also demonstrate your readiness to learn and take on new opportunities by completing the free LETS K! Duunitaidot training and attaching the completion badge to your application. The training provides practical tips on job seeking, finding your direction and working life. You can find the training at kesko.fi/duunitaidot.

We at K Group value diversity and believe that different backgrounds and perspectives are key to success. We strive to create a work environment where everyone has the opportunity to grow. Equality, non-discrimination, and fairness are our core principles in recruitment, compensation, and career development.

title: Gen B Graduate Program, Process Development Engineer
description:
Start your future at one of Europe’s leading mining- and smelting companies and become part of Gen B! Begin a one-year journey designed to challenge and inspire you. As a graduate, you will gain in-depth, hands-on experience across different business areas, functions, and sites in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Portugal or Ireland, depending on your chosen position.



To drive change for future generations, we need new ways of thinking, that’s why we encourage you to apply. You are the hearts behind tomorrow.  



A program designed for your future

For one year, divided into three periods, you will explore how Boliden operates end to end, and how your own unique background and experience connect to the bigger picture. As a graduate, you are employed in a permanent position from day one and supported by an individual development program. Throughout the year several engaged and experienced colleagues, will guide you in your progress. You will become part of an international network of graduates and colleagues, expanding both your knowledge and connections. Six joint training weeks with top-class lecturers will challenge your thinking and give you the opportunity to further deepen your skills. After graduation you will continue your journey with a mentor for six months. In addition, you will receive practical training in project methodology and Boliden’s production methods, enabling you to apply what you learn directly in our operations.

Learn more how you can step into a future where raw material meets your potential. 

Find your path

As a graduate and part of Gen B, you will be given a unique gateway into Boliden. Whether you want to grow as an expert in business, engineering or tech, you will get the opportunity to grow in the area that excites you the most.  

In this role as a Process Development Engineer, you'll be part of the the R&D team at Harjavalta smelter, supporting production operations and, when needed, investment projects. You will solve process-related challenges, contribute to long-term assignments linked to strategic objectives, and collaborate closely with production, maintenance, and project personnel.

Responsibilities:

    Respond promptly to requests from production and help resolve process-related problems

    Support production operations and contribute to investment projects when needed

    Contribute to longer-term assignments linked to the company’s strategic objectives

    Combine rapid operational problem-solving with systematic long-term planning

    Review historical reports, external research, and industry publications and assess their relevance to Harjavalta smelter

    Document trials, new materials, operating-window changes, results, and lessons learned for future use

    Collaborate with production, maintenance, and project personnel on process development initiatives

Qualifications:

    Master of Science in metallurgy, sustainable process metallurgy, extractive metallurgy, process engineering, chemical engineering, process chemistry, or a closely related field



Who you are

We think you are a forward thinker and a team thriver, who is naturally curious, and solutions oriented. You communicate with honesty and respect, are eager to take initiative and dedicated to follow through. Above all, you are ready to take responsibility and grow as an expert.

What you bring

You hold a relevant university degree completed in 2025 or later. You can communicate clearly in English, hold a valid driver’s license and are available to start in September 2027.

How to apply

Submit your application and CV in English. The recruitment process includes assessments, interviews, and a final Assessment Center for selected candidates.

The Assessment Center will take place in Stockholm, Sweden, on one day between February 16-19, 2027. Boliden will cover travel and accommodation expenses. Please ensure your availability between February 14-20, 2027, if you progress to the final stage.

About Boliden

Boliden is at the forefront of advancing our industry through sustainable solutions and innovation. Every day, we work to reduce our footprint, and drive long-term progress. We are on a journey towards becoming the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world. With us, you will be part of a diverse workplace built on care, courage and responsibility. We work together to grow and take the lead. Our priority is your safety, well-being and growth. Make a lasting impact, in your everyday work, for future generations. Let a rock-solid career start with us.

Learn more at www.boliden.com.



Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!

Do you have any questions about your application? Please send an e-mail to genb@boliden.com. Last day to apply for this position is November 17th 2026. Selection will be ongoing; we are looking forward to receiving your application as soon as possible.

If you are a representative of a recruiting firm, please refrain from contacting us about this posting. We appreciate your consideration.

title: Senior Mechanical Engineer
description:
Creo Center is a Nordic product development partner with operations in Finland and Sweden, helping both local and international organizations create and develop innovations across different industries. We have strong interest in new techniques and innovative solutions, with our clients primarily consisting of international R&D companies, manufacturing firms, or startups with innovative product ideas. United by our passion for product development, we help our clients turn ideas into success.

We are currently looking for an experienced Senior R&D Engineer to join our team!

Key Responsibilities

* Design and develop mechanical systems, components, and assemblies for advanced technology products

* Create detailed 3D models and manufacturing documentation using Siemens NX

* Manage product data and engineering documentation in Teamcenter

* Support prototype builds, testing activities, and product validation collaborating with different suppliers

* Ensure designs comply with relevant industry standards, quality requirements, and safety regulations

Required Qualifications:

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in mechanical engineering or a related technical field

* Minimum of 7 years of experience in mechanical engineering within engineering, manufacturing, industrial technology, or high-tech industries

* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills

* Extensive hands-on experience with Siemens NX and Teamcenter

* Fluent communication skills in both English and Finnish

* Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams

* Willingness to work on-site in the Western Uusimaa region

* Flexibility and willingness to travel within Southern Finland, particularly to supplier and manufacturing sites

Preferred Qualifications:

* Knowledge of semiconductor, vacuum process, precision equipment, or similar high-technology industries

* Familiarity with ASME and related industrial standards

Why Creo Center?

At Creo Center, you'll join a community of over 160 product development professionals, where expertise thrives and grows through multidisciplinary collaboration. Our network of experienced colleagues and diverse customer base across multiple industries provide continuous opportunities for learning, professional growth, and the development of new expertise. We support your well-being with a comprehensive benefits package that includes a lunch benefit, mobile phone benefit, commuter benefit or company bike benefit, extended occupational healthcare, and comprehensive leisure-time accident insurance. We believe in shared success, which is why every year we distribute a portion of our operating profit among all employees through our People Bonus program.

Join us!

Please submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 31.10.2026. This position is permanent and full-time, with the start date to be agreed upon.

If you have any questions about the position or the recruitment process, please contact R&D Unit Manager Benjamin Ekström +358 41 507 7201 on weekdays.

title: Plate fitters, Meyer Turku Oy, Turku
description:
We are looking for Plate Fitters for the Meyer Turku Shipyard in Turku, Finland. The employment contract will be made directly with Meyer Turku Oy, and StaffPoint will support you throughout the recruitment process. You will have the opportunity to help build some of the world's most impressive cruise ships as part of a community of more than 2,000 professionals.

Summary

Employer: Meyer Turku Oy
Location: Meyer Turku Shipyard, Turku, Finland
Employment Type: Permanent employment
Working Hours: 40 hours per week, willingness to work shifts required
Start Date: As soon as possible
Application Deadline: 8 November 2026
Number of Positions: 2

Job Description

As a Plate Fitter, you will manufacture and assemble steel structures and ship blocks in accordance with technical drawings, quality requirements, and production schedules.

Your responsibilities include:

- Reading technical drawings and work instructions

- Measuring, marking, cutting, bending, and fitting steel plates

- Assembling steel structures and ship blocks and verifying alignments and tolerances

- Tack welding and oxy-fuel cutting as part of the fabrication process

- Identifying and reporting deviations, quality issues, and safety risks

- Collaborating with welders, supervisors, and designers

The work is performed in production halls, around the shipyard area, and outdoors in varying weather conditions. The role includes working at heights and in confined spaces while always using the required personal protective equipment.

What We Expect from You

- Experience as a plate fitter, ship plate fitter, steel structure assembler, or in a similar role

- Ability to read technical drawings and work within specified tolerances

- Experience in steel plate processing, structural assembly, and the use of measuring equipment

- Safe working practices and a careful, proactive approach to work

- Ability to work independently and as part of a production team

- Readiness to work indoors and outdoors, at heights, and in confined spaces

- Ability to communicate in either Finnish or English regarding work-related matters

Relevant education in metalwork, manufacturing technology, or shipbuilding supports success in the role; equivalent competence may also be demonstrated through work experience.

The following are considered an advantage:

- Experience in shipbuilding or shipyard environments

- Experience in ship block construction

- Tack welding and oxy-fuel cutting skills

- Valid safety and professional certifications

What We Offer

- Direct employment with Meyer Turku Oy and the opportunity to work at the forefront of shipbuilding

- A challenging and varied plate fitter position alongside experienced professionals

- A work community where everyones contribution is essential to achieving shared goals

- Wellbeing and sports benefits, as well as support from the shipyards own occupational healthcare center

How to Apply

Submit your application and CV no later than 8 November 2026.

In your application, please describe:

- The types of steel structures or ship blocks you have assembled

- The materials, material thicknesses, and measuring tools you have worked with

- Your experience in tack welding and oxy-fuel cutting

- Your earliest possible start date

We review applications on an ongoing basis and make hiring decisions as soon as suitable candidates are found.

The selection process includes:

- StaffPoint interview

- Meyer Turku interview

- Verification of qualifications

- Medical examination and drug test

- Shipyard access permit and onboarding process

The selected candidate must provide a negative drug test result and be assessed as fit for the position in the occupational health examination. Please also note that we require valid right to work in Finland (Finnish citizenship, EU citizenship or work permit issued by Finland) from all the applicants.

Contact Information

Siiri Tietäväinen
Recruitment Consultant
siiri.tietavainen@staffpoint.fi
+358 44 420 4427

About Meyer Turku and StaffPoint

Meyer Turku Oy builds some of the world's most advanced and energy-efficient cruise ships, car ferries, and special-purpose vessels. The company holds approximately 17% of the global cruise shipbuilding market. Its largest customers include Royal Caribbean and the Finnish Border Guard.

Meyer Turku employs more than 2,000 professionals at the Turku shipyard, where ships have been built since 1737. Its subsidiaries include: Piikkio Works Oy, a cabin manufacturing facility in Piikkiö, Shipbuilding Completion Oy, providing turnkey solutions for ship public spaces, ENGnD Oy, a shipbuilding and offshore engineering company located in Rauma

Meyer Turku continuously strives toward more sustainable shipbuilding. The company has identified five UN Agenda 2030 Sustainable Development Goals where it can make a significant impact through its operations and cooperation with customers and partners.

StaffPoint is a Finnish HR services company and acts as Meyer Turkus recruitment partner in this hiring process.


Meyer Turku

Meyer Turku Oy rakentaa maailman uudenaikaisimpia ja energiatehokkaimpia risteilyaluksia, autolauttoja ja erikoisaluksia. Turun telakalla on rakennettu laivoja vuodesta 1737 lähtien.

Meyer Turun telakalla työskentelee yli 2 000 ammattilaista ja telakalla on yli 450 eri ammattia. Jokaisen työpanosta tarvitaan yhteisen päämäärän saavuttamiseen.

title: Aana Palvelut Oy, Henkilökohtainen avustaja Poriin
description:
Etsitkö ihmisläheistä työtä, jossa saat samalla vaikuttaa omiin työaikoihisi?
Haluatko työn, joka mukautuu elämäntilanteeseesi eikä vaadi aiempaa koulutusta tai pitkää työkokemusta?
Olemme käynnistämässä henkilökohtaisen avun palvelutoimintaa, jossa työ rakentuu sinun ja asiakkaan arjen ympärille.

Aana Palvelut työnantajana

Aana Palvelut on uusi henkilökohtaiseen apuun keskittyvä yritys.
Rakennamme toimintaamme yhdessä avustajien ja asiakkaiden kanssa – avoimesti, inhimillisesti ja luottamukseen perustuen.
Emme etsi työntekijöitä järjestelmään, vaan ihmisiä ihmisille. Sinusta tulee tärkeä osa jonkun arkea.

Mitä henkilökohtainen avustaminen on?

Henkilökohtaisena avustajana autat asiakasta elämään omannäköistään elämää sairauden tai vamman tuomista rajoitteista huolimatta. Työsi on käytännönläheistä, vaihtelevaa ja merkityksellistä.
Avustaminen voi sisältää esimerkiksi:
- kodin arjen askareissa avustamista,
- asiointia ja liikkumista kodin ulkopuolella,
- harrastuksiin ja vapaa-ajan toimintoihin osallistumista.

Kenelle työ sopii?

Etsimme ihmisiä, joilla on aito halu auttaa ja kohdata toinen ihminen arvostavasti ja luontevasti. Et tarvitse aiempaa koulutusta tai kokemusta.
Arvostamme luotettavuutta, avoimuutta ja halua oppia. Perehdytämme sinut työhön ja olemme tukenasi myös arjessa. Meille on tärkeää, että voit olla oma itsesi.

Joustavat työajat

Keskustelemme kanssasi siitä, millainen työmäärä ja aikataulu sopivat elämäntilanteeseesi. Työ voi olla kokoaikaista, osa-aikaista tai keikkaluonteista. Noudatamme palvelualan työehtosopimusta.

Henkilökohtaiseksi avustajaksi otettavan henkilön on esitettävä alle 6 kuukautta vanha rikosrekisteriote työnantajalle ennen työn aloittamista. Rikosrekisteriote haetaan sähköisesti Oikeusrekisterikeskuksesta työnhakijan toimesta.

title: CNC - machinist

title: Work as a chef and, if desired, additional tasks related to tourism services.
description:
**We are looking for a reinforcement to our kitchen team and hiring a chef or a person with equivalent basic skills.** This is a permanent position, and our restaurant serves customers year-round.

You should have experience in à la carte cooking. However, we will provide a thorough orientation to our products so that you will be ready for the challenges of the winter season. You can start as soon as possible, but from September to November, our opening hours are limited, which means fewer working hours.

The high season truly begins in December, so the starting date can be negotiated flexibly. We also have a busy summer season. We require an appreciation for good food and the ability to adapt to the varying demands of seasonal work.

We have a fully furnished company apartment available for rent, located about 1 km from the workplace (400 EUR/month). Salary is determined based on experience. title: Support Specialist for BeeHealthy
description:
Join us in our mission to make care smarter!

At BeeHealthy, were on a mission to make care smarter through our configurable, white-label SaaS platform. We combine over 115 years of healthcare expertise with modern technology, serving social, healthcare, and veterinary providers alongside insurance organisations in over 10 countries across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

Were a team of 90+, with 60+ in our product organisation, growing fast and looking for people who want to do meaningful work. If you care about impact, quality, and building products that genuinely improve how care is delivered and received, wed love to hear from you.

Location: Helsinki, Turku, Tampere, or Jyväskylä (Finland) or Berlin (Germany)
Working mode: Remote-friendly, hybrid working model

About the role
As a Support Specialist, you handle support issues independently from intake to resolution, with high-quality ticket handling, customer communication, and documentation. Youll build strong product and platform knowledge, spot recurring issues, and help improve how Support operates.

What you will do
Handle tickets end to end: prioritise, categorise, troubleshoot, resolve, and document them
Investigate issues using logs, tooling, and platform knowledge, and decide when to resolve them yourself and when to escalate
Keep customers updated clearly during incidents, escalations, and follow-ups
Work with SRE and Engineering on complex cases, keeping ownership until issues are resolved or clearly handed over, so nothing gets lost between teams
Spot recurring issues and raise them for Problem Management with the Service Delivery Manager
Turn your troubleshooting into reusable troubleshooting guides and known solutions in our knowledge base
Mentor Junior Support Specialists, helping them build confidence and solve problems on their own
Proactively suggest improvements to support processes, documentation, and ways of working
Work with Service Delivery to ensure relevant customer context is understood and reflected in support communication

What you bring
Previous experience in technical support, IT service desk, or another customer-facing ICT role
Structured troubleshooting skills, including reading logs and narrowing down root causes
Sound judgement on when to dig deeper, when to resolve, and when to escalate
Clear written and spoken communication in English and Finnish, including with customers during incidents
Strong documentation habits
Willingness to mentor and support colleagues

Bonus points
Interest in exploring and developing AI-based solutions that make Support faster and more effective
Experience with Jira Service Management or similar
Familiarity with ITIL practices
Experience in healthcare or another regulated environment, and an understanding of handling sensitive data (GDPR)
German and/or Italian

What success looks like
You resolve support issues independently and efficiently
You make sound escalation decisions and involve SRE or Engineering at the right time
Your tickets are accurate, appropriately prioritised, and well documented
You communicate clearly with customers throughout the support lifecycle
You help Junior Support Specialists develop their troubleshooting and ticket-handling skills
You strengthen the Support knowledge base with practical, reusable documentation
You identify recurring issues and help reduce them through Problem Management and continuous improvement
You contribute to a more consistent and scalable Support operation

Benefits
Generous, Nordic-style paid holiday
Flexible remote-work policy and working hours
Wide range of IT equipment to choose from
Comprehensive occupational healthcare
Sponsored sports or culture memberships
Healthy snacks and drinks at the office
Regular team days, game nights, and social events

Culture at BeeHealthy
At BeeHealthy, freedom and responsibility go hand in hand. Youll be trusted to work independently while collaborating closely with your colleagues, sharing knowledge, learning continuously, and respecting each other both professionally and personally.

Our culture is guided by strong values:
Skill and Knowledge: we never stop learning.
Caring and Responsibility: we look out for each other and the people who use what we build.
Partners and Entrepreneurship: we innovate through collaboration.
Growth and Development: were committed to unlocking potential, both for ourselves and our customers.

Were a close-knit, international team where talent and knowledge-sharing thrive. We believe that building great healthcare technology starts with taking care of the people who build it.

Recruitment process
We read every application: Once the application period closes, we take time to review everyone who applied. You'll hear back from us, whatever the outcome.
Short meeting with our VP Talent: A chance to get to know each other. The focus here is on bringing BeeHealthy's culture and values to life, and exploring how they resonate with your own.
Meeting with the hiring manager: This conversation goes deeper into the role, its responsibilities and expectations, as well as the requirements.
Team meeting and case assignment: You'll get to meet your future teammates and work through an engaging case.
Possible meeting with our C-level team.
Offer: When the right person meets the right role, we'll be in touch to make an offer and talk through the details together.

Apply through our recruitment system by 8 November 2026 by sending your CV and a brief note about why this role excites you. We review applications on a rolling basis and look forward to hearing from you. The start date is flexible and can be agreed together.

title: Art educator, part-time
description:
Are you passionate about working in arts education and with young people, alongside other professionals?

We are looking for three part-time art educators for Annantalo Arts Centre for Children and Young People for The Call of Art - Advancing Equity and Accessibility in Cultural Education Plans project. The position is for the period 1 January 2027-31 May 2028. The position is a 30 % working time role, with working hours totalling approximately 11.5hours per week. The work will mainly take place at Annantalo on three weekdays per week during school year, which will be specified as the project moves on, between approximately 12.00 and 16.00. Outside school year, the working days and working tasks will be defined according to the projects phase and needs.

The job-specific salary for a full-time position would be EUR2,994.14 per month. We are seeking employees on a 30 % part-time basis, meaning that the job-specific salary is reduced proportionally, amounting to EUR898.24 per month.

As an art educator, you will primarily be working on the The Call of Art - Advancing Equity and Accessibility in Cultural Education Plans project, providing course-based arts education to groups of lower secondary school students. You will plan lessons and courses, teach classes and develop teaching practice in collaboration with other project staff. You will adapt your teaching to the needs of the participating groups. You will organise the students artwork exhibitions, shows or performances, for example. You will document your own work and communicate about it in line with the projects objectives, in addition to which you will also ensure that teaching materials and facilities are fit for purpose.

You are a professional in your own form of art and an experienced art educator. Your form of art could be, for example, animation, digital art, light art, sound art, performance art, dance, theatre, music, nail art, visual arts, architecture or some art form we have not even heard of yet! You enjoy working with young people and give them the space to express their own creativity. You are familiar with working in a multilingual environment. You enjoy collaborating with other professionals in the fields of art and education, and you want to share your expertise for the benefit of others. Documenting your own work and communicating about it comes naturally to you.

The course-based art education provided at Annantalo is part of the national The Call of Art - Advancing Equity and Accessibility in Cultural Education Plans project, which will run from 2026 to 2028. The aim of the project is to strengthen childrens and young peoples cultural participation, equity and motivation at school and prevent the decline of arts education amongst young people. The project is coordinated by the Association of Childrens Culture in Finland and it is co-funded by the European Social Fund (ESF+). The project consortium comprises the cities of Helsinki, Vantaa, Joensuu and Oulu; and Culture Cooperative Uulu.

The position requires a relevant bachelors degree, as well as either completed pedagogical studies or pedagogical competence gained through work experience.

In addition to this, the role requires expertise in ones own form(s) of art, as well as experience in working with children and young people. The language requirement is a good command of spoken and written Finnish or English.

Documentation and communication skills, as well as other language skills, particularly proficiency in the languages spoken by pupils at Helsinki lower secondary school, are considered an advantage for this role.

Successful candidates must, prior to commencing employment, provide the employer with a criminal record extract for inspection, in accordance with section 6, subsection 2 of the Criminal Records Act.

Please submit your application via our recruitment system.

title: KotiAvustajat - yrittäjä
description:
KotiAvustajat ovat palvelleet asiakkaita 15 vuoden ajan Seinäjoella ja vuosien varrella laajentaneet toimintaansa Alavudelle, Ilmajoelle, Kuortaneelle, Kaustiselle, Veteliin, Hausjärvelle, Hyvinkäälle, Körkölään, Mäntsälään, Riihimäelle, Lempäälään, Nokialle, Pirkkalaan, Sastamalaan, Tampereelle, Ylöjärvelle, Helsinkiin, Espooseen, Kauniaisiin ja Vantaalle

Haemme itsenäisiä KotiAvustaja - yrittäjiä ympäri Suomen, jotka toimivat yhteistyössä KotiAvustajien kanssa uniikin toimintamallin mukaisesti omalla asuinpaikkakunnallaan.

KotiAvustajana voit vaikuttaa omalla työlläsi siihen, että asuinpaikkakuntasi ikäihmiset saavat hyvää hoivaa ja huolenpitoa sekä konkreettista apua kotona asumiseen. KotiAvustajana autat ja huolehdit asiakkaan hyvinvoinnista antaen ohjausta terveydentilan ja toimintakyvyn ylläpitämiseksi. Kotikäynnit keskittyvät arkipäiviin ja sinulla on aikaa kohdata asiakas.

Kaikki KotiAvustajat toimivat uniikin KotiAvustajat® brändin mukaisesti, joka luo paremmat toimintaedellytykset yrityksellesi sekä mahdollisuuden kehittyä paremmaksi osaajaksi. Asiakkuudet ovat pääsääntöisesti pitkäkestoisia ja se tuo turvaa yrittäjyyteen. Sinulla on hyvät mahdollisuudet erittäin hyviin ansioihin, joka luonnollisesti riippuu sinusta ja aktiivisuudestasi.

Asiakastyötä tulet tekemään omalla persoonallasi ja täydellä sydämellä. Avoimuus, kyky kuunnella ja halu auttaa ovat tärkeimpiä ominaisuuksiasi. Lähtökohta toiminnallesi on hyvä asiakaspalvelu, jossa työtä teet aina asiakkaalle.

Sinulla on terveysalan koulutus (esim. sairaanhoitaja, terveydenhoitaja, toimintaterapeutti, farmaseutti, fysioterapeutti jne.), hygieniapassi, auto omaan käyttöön sekä hallitset erinomaisesti suomen kielen.

Saat yrittäjyyteen vankan tuen ja asiantuntevia neuvoja sekä ohjeita alkumetreiltä lähtien, "Liikkuvaan junaan" ja osaajien joukkoon on nyt helppo hypätä mukaan!

title: Assistant Professor (tenure-track) in Finance / Biträdande professor (nivå 1) i finansiell ekonomi (tenure track)
description:
[Se nedan för svenska]

Hanken School of Economics invites applications for an Assistant Professor (tenure-track) in Finance

beginning no later than August 2027, or as otherwise agreed. The position is at the Finance Unit at the Department of Finance and Economics in Helsinki. For this position, we will consider candidates in all fields of Finance.

The position is part of the Hanken tenure track system. It is open to talented individuals who have potential for an excellent scientific career. Individuals placed on the Hanken tenure track have the possibility to advance in their career through regular performance assessments, which consider their merits in all relevant qualification areas in accordance with [Hankens tenure track guidelines](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/hankens-tenure-track-system).

Hanken School of Economics is a research-oriented business school offering education in English and Swedish. Hankens Finance unit is committed to high-quality teaching and research. We offer full scale graduate and undergraduate programs.

We have a strong research climate, reflected in a growing volume and range of research activities. We value high-quality, practice-oriented research, as evidenced by our publications in top-ranked journals. In addition, Hanken's Finance unit is an active partner in the Graduate School of Finance (GSF), which offers the national doctoral program in finance. GSF also organizes seminars and workshops for faculty members and doctoral students.

Requirements
The applicants will be reviewed based on their research, teaching, institutional service, and societal impact. Applicants should hold a doctoral degree (or be near completion of the doctorate) in Finance (or a related field). When evaluating the applicants qualifications, the main focus will be on the potential to conduct high-quality scientific research and the potential to provide high-quality teaching. A focus on asset pricing is considered a strong merit.

Being a stand-alone business school with strong Nordic roots, Hanken offers degree programmes in Swedish and English. For this position, applicants are required to have fluent command of English, knowledge of Swedish is considered a merit. Hanken supports its faculty in learning the Swedish language, which serves as the administrative language of the business school.

Academic staff at Hanken are expected to carry out and supervise scientific research, provide academic teaching, closely follow the advances of their field, and contribute service to Hanken, the academic community, and society. Teaching tasks are allocated based on the curriculum needs of the subject and by considering relevant expertise.

The full-time position has an annual working time of 1612 hours. During the academic year, it is expected that a minimum average of three days per week is spent at the office in Helsinki to actively contribute to the research and teaching environment. Hanken requires academic employees to reside and work in Finland, and it offers relocation support for applicants coming from outside Finland.

Salary
The salary is based on the university salary system in Finland (includes employee healthcare as well as pension and holiday contributions). The exact salary level depends on the recruited individuals qualifications. Hanken will support the selected employee with a start-up research budget, and additional research, travel and teaching development grants can also be applied for. Hanken rewards excellence in both research and teaching.

For more Information
For additional information, please contact Head of Department Jesper Haga (jesper.haga@hanken.fi) or Head of Subject Karl Felixson (karl.felixson@hanken.fi).

General instructions for applicants are provided [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/hankens-tenure-track-system/research-track-0). Also, read more about Hanken as an employer [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/node/2413861).

Recruitment process and timeline
The application deadline is 22 November 2026. Selected candidates will be interviewed online shortly after the application deadline. Short-listed candidates will be invited to on-site campus visits including an interview and research presentation.

How to apply
The application is to be addressed to the Rector and application materials should include:

- CV (proposed content [here](https://tenk.fi/en/advice-and-materials/template-researchers-curriculum-vitae)), including list of publications.
- Personal statement, which includes a description of past research and its scientific quality, academic impact, plans for future research and a description of the candidates service to the department and university and a description of the candidates societal impact.
- Teaching portfolio (proposed content [here](https://www.hanken.fi/en/faculty-staff/job-opportunities/job-opportunities/applications-and-selection-process)).
- Copies of no more than five research publications, including a job market paper
- Three letters of reference from academic researchers, to be submitted via [Econjobmarket](https://econjobmarket.org/positions?show=all&type=reg&searchType=quick&saved_search_id=0&cutoffDate=2007-01-01&position_type_id=&category_id=&iso2=&oid=1337#ad-11885) or directly to Hanken via humanresources@hanken.fi.

Please submit all application materials in English in Hankens recruitment database LAURA. The application deadline is 22 November 2026.

Hanken School of Economics is one of the leading business schools in the Nordic countries. It is located in Finland, with campuses in Helsinki and Vaasa. Hanken offers a range of B.Sc., M.Sc., EMBA, PhD, and Executive Development programmes taught mainly in English and Swedish. Hanken has 2 725 Bachelor and Masters students, and 118 Doctoral students. The School has close ties to the business community and an active alumni network with over 13 800 alumni working in more than 70 countries. The School is accredited by AACSB, AMBA, and EQUIS. The Masters programme was ranked 56 in the Masters in Management by Financial Times in 2026. Hanken is also recognized for its research quality, its international orientation, and its focus on sustainability.

title: Senior Full Stack Developer
description:
About the role

Bittium SafeMove Comms is a quantum-safe, end-to-end encrypted communications platform for government agencies, defence forces, and critical infrastructure organisations. It covers voice, video, and messaging on Android, iOS, and Windows, and is built on a zero-trust architecture that customers can run on-premises, in air-gapped networks, in the cloud, or in isolated tactical environments.

Within our Security business, we are looking for an experienced and versatile Senior Full Stack Developer to join Bittium Wireless Oy and the team that develops, deploys, and maintains SafeMove Comms across our entire customer base. The position is based in Oulu, Finland, and offers a hybrid working model. You will work on both client and server, and you'll have real influence on how the product evolves. When the situation calls for it, you'll take the technical lead, both within the team and together with our customers.

We are a small team, and we see that as a real opportunity for you. You'll get to take ownership early, have a direct say in technical decisions, and learn faster than you would in a larger organisation, across clients, servers, security, and customer work. With that opportunity comes responsibility: you'll own what you build, and you should be comfortable handling the pressure that comes with work where our customers' security depends on us.

What you'll do

- Develop SafeMove Comms desktop and mobile clients as well as server-side components
- Solve demanding integration and architecture challenges without losing sight of the user experience
- Take ownership of problems and drive them to working solutions, independently or together with the team
- Lead technical discussions with the team and customers when needed
- Take part in deploying and maintaining the product in demanding customer environments

What we expect from you

- Solid experience in software development across both client-side and server-side technologies
- Strong software development skills and an agile mindset
- Good collaboration skills and the ability to solve demanding problems independently
- A willingness to take ownership and provide technical direction within the team and beyond
- Experience with desktop development using JavaScript/TypeScript and React, or with Android development
- Experience with server-side technologies such as Linux, Java, SQL databases, and Nginx
- Fluent Finnish and English

We especially value

- Knowledge of network security
- Knowledge of the Signal Protocol or similar end-to-end encryption protocols
- Knowledge of PKI and certificate management
- Experience in iOS development

Nice to have

- Broader expertise in information security and cryptography
- Experience with Rust, Redux, or Electron

Interested?

Send us your application as soon as possible. We will begin interviewing candidates during the application period.

About Bittium

Bittium specializes in the development of reliable, secure communications and connectivity solutions leveraging its 40-year legacy of expertise in advanced radio communication technologies. Bittium provides innovative products and services, customized solutions based on its product platforms and R&D services. Complementing its communications and connectivity solutions, Bittium offers proven information security solutions for mobile devices and portable computers. Bittium also provides healthcare technology products and services for biosignal measuring in the areas of cardiology and neurology. Net sales in 2025 were EUR 119.3 million and operating result was EUR 19.4 million. Bittium is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki

title: Senior T24 Architect
description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior T24 Architect to shape the evolution of a large and complex Core Banking environment. You will define and guide the architecture of the Temenos T24 landscape, making sure that business capabilities, technology platforms and long-term strategic goals stay aligned.

You will work with business stakeholders, engineers, architects and external partners across multiple markets, providing architectural leadership over several initiatives and delivery streams. Your goal is to protect the stability and resilience of business-critical banking services while enabling platform modernisation and simplification.

Key Responsibilities:
 Shape and evolve the architecture roadmap for Temenos T24 and surrounding Core Banking capabilities, defining target-state architecture, principles and standards in line with business and technology strategy
 Provide end-to-end architectural leadership across complex initiatives, ensuring consistency, scalability and sustainability of the Core Banking landscape
 Translate business requirements into robust, implementable solutions, including integrations between Core Banking and payments, digital channels, lending, deposits, customer management and data platforms
 Identify interfaces, data flows and dependencies across applications, infrastructure and external services
 Evaluate architectural alternatives and make clear trade-offs between business value, delivery risk and technical complexity
 Drive modernisation and simplification of the Core Banking ecosystem, promoting API-first, event-driven and cloud-enabled patterns where appropriate
 Improve platform maintainability, testability and operability, and identify opportunities for reuse, automation and standardisation across markets and delivery teams
 Define functional and non-functional requirements for availability, security, performance, scalability, resilience and operability
 Guide architecture reviews to ensure alignment with enterprise standards and regulatory expectations, and maintain the architectural runway for sustainable delivery
 Assess architectural risks, technical debt and lifecycle concerns, and guide proportionate remediation
 Act as a trusted advisor for strategic Core Banking initiatives and technology investment decisions, communicating complex topics clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Mentor architects and engineers, fostering collaboration and accountable decision-making within teams

Required Skills and Experience:
 Significant experience with Temenos T24 / Temenos Transact in architecture, solution design or senior engineering roles
 Deep understanding of Core Banking processes, platform capabilities and integration dependencies
 Proven record of leading architecture for large-scale transformation, migration or modernisation initiatives
 Experience working across multiple teams, products or markets in a complex enterprise environment

title: Lähihoitaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen uuteen Keisarinnaan!
description:
**Hei sinä hyvä lähihoitaja. Meillä olisi ehkä juuri sinulle paikka Keisarinnassa.**

**Keisarinna on uusi. Sinä voit olla mukana tekemässä siitä meidän näköisemme.**

Lokakuussa on Piikkiöön avautunut uusi Keisarinna – koti ikääntyneille ja samalla kokonaan uusi työyhteisö.

Siksi emme etsi vain lähihoitajaa täyttämään työvuoroja. **Etsimme työkaveria. Ihmistä. Persoonaa.** Sellaista, joka osaa hoitaa, mutta ennen kaikkea osaa kohdata.

**Millainen tyyppi viihtyy meillä?**

Ehkä sinä olet se työkaveri, joka huomaa, kun joku tarvitsee apua ennen kuin sitä ehditään pyytää. Ehkä sinulle on tärkeää, että aamulla ei vain jaeta lääkkeitä ja tarkisteta vointeja, vaan pysähdytään hetkeksi juttelemaan.

Ehkä olet järjestelmällinen ja tarkka – tai ehkä vahvuutesi on siinä, että saat ihmiset nauramaan myös kiireisen päivän keskellä.

**Me tarvitsemme kaikkia näitä puolia.**

Keisarinnassa haluamme tehdä hoitotyötä, jossa asukkaat saavat olla omia itsejään. Jos joku haluaa kuunnella musiikkia, jutella päivän uutisista, lähteä ulos tai vain istua kaikessa rauhassa kahvikupin kanssa, sille pitää olla aikaa ja tilaa.

Koska elämä ei lopu siihen, kun ihminen muuttaa hoivakotiin. **Sen pitää jatkua. Ja tässä kohtaa sinä tulet mukaan.**

Uudessa Keisarinnassa pääset rakentamaan asioita alusta alkaen. Ei tarvitse kuulla lausetta: _"Näin meillä on aina tehty."_

Sen sijaan haluamme kuulla: **"Mitä jos kokeiltaisiin tätä?"**

Meillä saat ehdottaa, kysyä, haastaa ja kehittää. Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa työkaveria autetaan, huumorille on tilaa ja jokainen voi tulla töihin omana itsenään.

**Mitä lähihoitajan työ Keisarinnassa tarkoittaa?** Tavallista hyvää hoitotyötä – mutta ihmisen kokoista.

Työhösi kuuluu muun muassa:

- asukkaiden kokonaisvaltainen hoiva ja huolenpito

- lääkehoito ja voinnin seuranta

- toimintakyvyn tukeminen ja kuntouttava työote

- päivittäisissä toiminnoissa avustaminen

- yhdessäolo, ulkoilu ja viriketoiminta

- yhteistyö läheisten ja muun henkilöstön kanssa

- ennen kaikkea asukkaan kohtaaminen ja kuunteleminen.


Meillä hoitaja ei ole vain se, joka tekee asiat asukkaan puolesta.

**Hyvä hoitaja auttaa ihmistä tekemään itse sen, minkä hän vielä pystyy tekemään.**

**Mitä me toivomme sinulta?** Sinulla on lähihoitajan tutkinto ja halu tehdä työtä, jolla on oikeasti merkitystä. Arvostamme ammattitaitoa, mutta emme etsi täydellistä ihmistä.

Etsimme ihmistä, joka:

- pitää ihmisistä

- ottaa vastuuta

- uskaltaa kysyä

- haluaa oppia

- osaa tehdä yhteistyötä

- kohtelee asukkaita ja työkavereita arvostavasti

- pystyy heittäytymään mukaan uuden rakentamiseen.


Ja jos sinulla on joku erityinen taito tai intohimo – **kerro siitä meille.**

Osaatko soittaa kitaraa? Oletko intohimoinen ulkoilija? Rakastatko leipomista, musiikkia, liikuntaa, askartelua tai vanhojen tarinoiden kuuntelemista? Loistavaa!

**Miksi kannattaa tulla juuri nyt?** Koska myöhemmin voit sanoa: **"Minä olin mukana, kun Keisarinna syntyi."**

Saat mahdollisuuden rakentaa uutta yksikköä ja uutta työyhteisöä yhdessä muiden ammattilaisten kanssa. Ja ehkä kaikkein tärkeintä: Saat tehdä työtä, jossa **yksi hymy, yksi hyvä kohtaaminen ja yksi pieni teko voivat tehdä jonkun päivästä paremman.** Jos tämä kuulostaa enemmän sinulta kuin perinteinen työpaikkailmoitus, lähetä meille hakemuksesi.

Kerro meille kuka olet, mitä osaat ja ennen kaikkea: **Miksi juuri sinä olisit hyvä tyyppi Keisarinnaan?**

Me haluamme tavata sinut.

**Tehdään tästä yhdessä paikka, jossa on hyvä asua – ja vielä parempi tehdä töitä.**

**Lähetä hakemuksesi aivan heti:** sofia.heinonen@kototiimi.fi

_P.S. Jos olet sellainen hoitaja, joka ajattelee, että työssä saa olla myös iloa, huumoria ja sydäntä – saatamme hyvinkin etsiä juuri sinua._

Lue meistä lisää www.kototiimi.fi

title: KOTA CHEF – TRADITIONAL FINNISH CAMPFIRE COOKING
description:
**Levi, Finnish Lapland | Winter Season 2026–2027**

**Scandinavian Travel Group (STG) – Safarimarket** is looking for an experienced Kota Chef to join our winter team in Levi.

You will prepare and serve traditional Finnish food and drinks at our outdoor venues, including cosy wooden kotas, snow igloos and Arctic wilderness camps in Levi and occasionally Rovaniemi.

This is a hands-on, guest-facing role for someone who enjoys cooking over an open fire, sharing Finnish food traditions and creating a welcoming atmosphere for visitors from around the world.

The position is **part-time, approximately 20–30 hours per week**, with daytime and evening shifts depending on guest bookings. It is a great opportunity to combine work with skiing, outdoor activities and winter life in Lapland.

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Prepare food in advance at our company kitchen, including soups, berry jams, Finnish pancake batter and other simple dishes.

- Cook and serve traditional Finnish food over an open fire in our kotas, including _lettu_ (Finnish pancakes), warm _leipäjuusto_ (Finnish squeaky cheese) and grilled sausages.

- Prepare coffee and traditional pot-brewed tea over the fire.

- Welcome guests, introduce the dishes and share Finnish food traditions in a friendly, engaging way.

- Set up the cooking and dining areas before programs, ensuring everything is ready for groups of approximately 10–20 guests.

- Follow established recipes and menus, with opportunities to suggest improvements.

- Manage food storage, ingredient stocks and kitchen supplies, coordinating purchasing needs with the office.

- Handle cleaning, hygiene and proper food storage at both the kitchen and outdoor venues.


**WHAT WE EXPECT**

- **Previous practical experience cooking over an open fire in a Finnish kota is required.**

- Experience in hospitality, catering or customer service, with confidence interacting with international guests.

- **Valid Finnish Hygiene Passport (Hygieniapassi).**

- Good conversational English; Finnish and other languages are an advantage.

- **Valid Category B driving licence** and willingness to drive company vehicles between venues, transporting food and equipment when needed.

- Good organisational skills and the ability to work independently.

- A friendly, reliable and service-minded attitude.

- Readiness to work outdoors in cold winter conditions, including evening shifts.


**WHAT WE OFFER**

- Seasonal position from **1 November 2026 to 31 March 2027**.

- Part-time work, approximately **20–30 hours per week**, with shifts based on guest programs.

- Hourly pay, agreed individually based on experience.

- Fixed-term seasonal employment or the possibility of working as a self-employed contractor.

- Winter work clothing, necessary equipment and training.

- Additional leisure-time accident insurance and limited additional healthcare through Pihlajalinna for eligible employees.

- Staff accommodation in Levi available at **€400 per person/month + electricity**.

- A friendly international team and the opportunity to enjoy Lapland's winter lifestyle alongside your work.


**HOW TO APPLY**

Send your CV and a short introduction describing your **campfire cooking, hospitality and customer service experience** to **hr@gostg.fi**.

**Applications are open until the position is filled.**

Join our team and help us share the warmth, flavours and traditions of Finnish Lapland with our guests!

title: SNOW CONSTRUCTION & OUTDOOR WINTER CAMP MAINTENANCE SPECIALIST
description:
**Levi, Finnish Lapland | Winter Season 2026–2027**

**Scandinavian Travel Group (STG) – Safarimarket** is looking for a practical, hands-on person to join our team in Levi for snow construction and outdoor camp maintenance.

Working with a team of 4–5 people, you will help build our **Snow Igloo Park** during an intensive 3–4-week construction phase. Throughout the winter, you will also prepare **Polarman's Camp** for regular evening guest programs and take care of the outdoor areas, facilities and equipment.

This is a varied, physical job for someone who enjoys working outdoors, knows how to use tools and machinery, and is comfortable getting things done in winter conditions.

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES**

- Good physical fitness and willingness to work outdoors in cold and sometimes demanding winter conditions.

**Previous experience in snowmaking or snow construction is welcome but not required.** We will provide training in the specific techniques and equipment used at our sites.

- Seasonal work from **1 November 2026 to 28 February 2027**, with the starting date depending on weather conditions.

- **Possible extension until 31 March 2027**, depending on operational needs.

- Fixed-term employment or the possibility of working as a self-employed contractor.

- Hourly pay: **\[rate to be confirmed\]**.

- Winter work clothing, necessary safety equipment and training.

- Additional leisure-time accident insurance and limited additional healthcare through Pihlajalinna for eligible employees.

- Staff accommodation available at **€400 per person/month + electricity**.

Send your CV and a short introduction about your practical construction, machinery or maintenance experience to **hr@gostg.fi**

**Application deadline: 31 October 2026.**

We look forward to welcoming a new colleague to our team in Levi!

title: Electrical Solutions Engineer, Data Centers
description:
Eltel Networks Oy is a leading provider of critical infrastructure services in the Nordics. We enable the digitalization and electrification of society through reliable solutions for power, communication and renewable energy networks.

Do you want to help deliver the next generation of critical infrastructure? Eltel is now looking for a driven and enthusiastic Electrical Solutions Engineer to join our growing Data Center team.

In this role, you will support our Data Center team in developing and evaluating electrical solutions for large-scale data center projects. Rather than focusing solely on design or reviewing the existing, you will help ensure that proposed solutions are technically robust, commercially competitive, and ready for successful execution. You will provide technical input for bids and supplier evaluations while ensuring that solutions reflect Finnish industry practices, utility requirements, and proven construction methods. Your involvement will not end at contract award; you will continue to support project teams throughout delivery, helping to evaluate design changes, resolve technical challenges during construction and commissioning, and ensure that all agreed modifications are accurately reflected in the final project documentation and handover package. You will work closely with solutions sales, suppliers, and site teams, helping bridge the gap between engineering and construction.

Your key responsibilities

-
Review electrical designs: Review electrical designs, models, and drawings from a contractor's perspective.

-
Assess layouts & feasibility: Assess equipment layouts, cable routing, and installation feasibility.

-
Discipline coordination: Support the coordination of electrical, mechanical, automation, and structural disciplines.

-
Technical calculations: Review electrical load calculations, cable sizing, equipment selections, and protection concepts.

-
Material Take-Offs: Prepare equipment and material take-offs, including cable quantities.

-
Tendering & Procurement support: Support technical tendering, procurement, and supplier evaluation activities.

-
Supplier documentation: Review supplier documentation and coordinate technical clarifications.

-
Technical issue resolution: Assist project teams in resolving technical issues during project execution.

-
Documentation update: Help ensure that design changes are correctly implemented in project documentation.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for a technically strong, energetic, and solution-oriented procurement professional who loves velocity, excels in dynamic, fast-moving projects, and wants to grow within a leading infrastructure company.

We expect you to have:

-
Degree: B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field.

-
Industry understanding: Good understanding of electrical distribution systems and infrastructure projects.

-
Evaluation skills: Ability to review and evaluate technical solutions and documentation.

-
Problem-solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

-
Communication: Good communication skills and ability to work with multiple stakeholders.

-
Language skills: Fluency in Finnish is required; English language skills are considered an asset.

title: Electrical Supervisor, Data Centers
description:
Eltel Networks Oy is a leading provider of critical infrastructure services in the Nordics. We enable the digitalization and electrification of society through reliable solutions for power, communication and renewable energy networks.

Do you want to help deliver the next generation of critical infrastructure on the frontline? Eltel is looking for a hands-on, proactive Electrical Supervisor to join our growing Data Center team.

This is a 100% site-based role tailored for an energetic and solution-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced construction environment, loves velocity, and excels in leading execution safely and efficiently directly on the field.

Your key responsibilities

-
Pre-Mobilization & Constructability Verification: Review electrical designs, models, and technical drawings from a practical contractor's perspective before site mobilization. Identify potential installation clashes, assess layout feasibility, and proactively suggest constructability improvements.

-
On-Site Supervision & Quality Control (QA/QC): Manage day-to-day electrical installation workflows on-site. Oversee for example cable containment routing, cable and busbar installations. Drive a strict 'Right First Time' quality culture, ensuring all torque marks, cable pull tension logs, and inspection sheets are digitally documented.

-
HSE Leadership & Energy Isolation: Maintain rigid adherence to Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) protocols. Lead sureness around specialized Permit to Work (PTW) systems for energized spaces, working at heights, and confined zones. Manage complex Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) protocols to safely isolate energy during construction and commissioning phases.

-
Logistics & Material Management: Supervise on-site materials, track component delivery workflows, perform material take-offs (including MV and LV cable tracking), and manage subcontractors and crew sourcing to hit strict project timelines.

-
Commissioning (Cx) & Interface Management: Partner closely with Commissioning (Cx) Engineers as energization approaches. Coordinate testing activities (including for example Megger insulation resistance and protection relay testing) to ensure an ultra-smooth, high-velocity transition from installation to active operations.

What We Are Looking For

-
We are looking for a technically astute, assertive, and energetic field leader who enjoys solving real-time engineering challenges on active construction sites.

-
Strong understanding of SFS standards and the ability to apply their requirements to practical installation workflows on-site.

-
Solid experience as an Electrical Supervisor or General Foreman on industrial sites, substations, or large-scale mission-critical electrical construction projects.

-
Technical understanding of MV/LV electrical distribution systems (cabling, TX, RMU, busbar, CB etc.), back-up solutions (UPS and generators) and general construction sequencing.

-
Proven track record managing technician and subcontractor groups and site crews in high-pressure, fast-paced project environments.

-
Strong safety mindset with direct exposure to strict Permit to Work (PTW) systems and operational Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) methodologies.

-
Professional communication skills with the ability to operate comfortably in an English-speaking project environment.

Desirable Skills (considered an advantage)

-
B.Sc. degree in Electrical Engineering or a related technical field (or an applicable strong technical trade background).

-
Ability to navigate and work with CAD drawings or 3D models (Autodesk BIM, Dalux, Navisworks).

-
Prior experience working inside high-security or mission-critical Data Center environments.

title: Sovitteluohjaaja
description:
**Laki rikosasioiden ja eräiden riita-asioiden sovittelusta (1015/2005) määrittää sovitteluohjaajan työtehtävän kuvausta.** Sovittelua tuotetaan koko Suomessa, ja sen järjestämisestä vastaa THL vuoden 2026 loppuun saakka. Vuoden 2027 alusta järjestämisvastuu siirtyy Oikeuspalveluvirastolle. Sovittelu ry on yksi Suomen 17 sovittelupalveluntuottajasta. Työyhteisöön kuuluu seitsemän sovitteluohjaajaa ja sovittelun vastuuhenkilö.

Rikosasioiden sovittelulla (_sovittelu_) tarkoitetaan maksutonta palvelua, jossa rikoksesta epäillylle ja rikoksen uhrille järjestetään mahdollisuus puolueettoman, koulutetun sovittelijan välityksellä kohdata toisensa luottamuksellisesti, käsitellä rikoksesta sen uhrille aiheutuneita henkisiä ja aineellisia haittoja sekä pyrkiä omatoimisesti sopimaan toimenpiteistä niiden hyvittämiseksi.

_Sovittelun ohjaaja on henkilö_, jonka tehtävänä on ohjata ja valvoa sovittelijoiden toimintaa sekä toimia tarvittaessa sovittelijana.

Sovittelulain **16 § :n mukaisesti sovittelumenettelyyn liittyvät sovittelutoimiston tehtävät**

Kun sovittelutoimisto on ottanut asian soviteltavakseen, sen tulee:

1)nimetä asiaa sovittelemaan sellainen sovittelija, joka soveltuu tehtävään kokemuksensa ja henkilökohtaisten ominaisuuksiensa perusteella eikä ole esteellinen hallintolaissa (434/2003) tarkoitetulla tavalla;

2)hankkia sovittelua varten tarvittavat asiakirjat osapuolten suostumuksella poliisi- tai syyttäjäviranomaiselta, tuomioistuimelta taikka muilta tahoilta;

3)huolehtia tulkin tai kääntäjän hankkimisesta, jos osapuoli ei hallitse sovittelussa käytettävää kieltä taikka ei aisti- tai puhevian tai muun syyn vuoksi voi ymmärtää sovittelussa käytävää keskustelua tai tulla ymmärretyksi siinä; sekä

4)sovittelun päätyttyä toimittaa poliisi- tai syyttäjäviranomaiselle salassapitoa koskevien säännösten estämättä tieto sovittelun kulusta ja lopputuloksesta.

title: Kokki
description:
**Kokki, tule tekemään Saimaan makuja Sahanlahteen!**

Sahanlahti Resort on perheomisteinen, ympäri vuoden palveleva matkailukohde Saimaan rannalla Puumalassa. Meille tullaan hyvän ruoan, viihtyisän majoituksen, järviluonnon ja lämminhenkisten kohtaamisten vuoksi. Vieraanamme on niin lomailijoita, juhlaseurueita kuin yritysryhmiä Suomesta ja maailmalta. Haluamme, että jokainen tuntee olonsa tervetulleeksi ja saa mukaansa syyn palata.

Ruoka on Sahanlahden sydän. Keittiössämme lähiruoka tarkoittaa lähiseudun tuottajia, sesongin raaka-aineita ja omin käsin tekemistä. Lautasillemme päätyvät lähijärvien kalat, metsien sienet ja marjat sekä lähitilojen parhaat antimet. Arvostamme raaka-aineiden alkuperää, selkeitä makuja ja huolellista käsityötä.

Kolme erilaista ravintolaamme – maisemaravintola Koskivahti, avotuliravintola Pajapirtti ja kesäravintola Rantamakasiini – tarjoavat monipuolisen ympäristön kokin työhön. Pajapirtin avotuli-illallinen valittiin **Suomen parhaaksi ruokamatkailutuotteeksi Hungry for Finland -ruokamatkailukilpailussa 2026**. Olemme saavutuksesta ylpeitä ja haluamme jatkaa ruokatuotteemme kehittämistä yhdessä osaavan tiimin kanssa.

**Etsimme nyt ammattiylpeää kokkia joukkoomme**

Toivomme sinulta vähintään viiden vuoden työkokemusta kokin tehtävistä sekä innostusta ruokaan, ravintola-alaan ja lähiruokaan perustuvaan tapaamme tehdä työtä. Haluat oppia uutta, kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja tuoda ajatuksiasi yhteiseen tekemiseen.

Osaat suunnitella ja viedä työsi läpi itsenäisesti sekä toimia osana tiimiä. **Järjestelmällisyys ja siisteys ovat meille erityisen tärkeitä:** pidät työpisteesi kunnossa, ennakoit tulevaa ja huolehdit siitä, että keittiön arki sujuu myös kiireessä. Arvostamme hyvää yhteistyötä, vastuullista työotetta ja reilua suhtautumista työkavereihin.

**Työ elää vuodenaikojen mukana**

Sahanlahdessa työtehtävät ja työyhteisön koko vaihtelevat sesonkien mukaan. Kesäkaudella keittiötiimissämme työskentelee noin 15 henkilöä. Talvikaudella olet osa kolmen hengen keittiötiimiä, joka täydentyy tarpeen mukaan lisäkäsillä.

Työssäsi osallistut monipuolisesti ravintoloidemme ja tilaisuuksiemme ruoanvalmistukseen, esivalmisteluista annosten viimeistelyyn. Pienessä talvitiimissä korostuvat itsenäisyys ja kokonaisuuden hallinta, kesällä puolestaan yhteistyö suuremman tiimin kanssa. Ympäri vuoden yhteistä ovat hyvä maku, huolellinen tekeminen ja ylpeys omasta työstä.

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työn lähiruoan parissa, mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi ja olla mukana rakentamassa Sahanlahden ruokaelämyksiä. Meillä laadukas tekeminen ja lupsakka yhdessäolo kuuluvat samaan keittiöön.

**Puumalassa on tilaa hyvälle arjelle**

Puumala tarjoaa Saimaan maisemien ja luonnon lisäksi myös käytännön etuja: maksuttoman varhaiskasvatuksen, alhaisen kunnallisveron sekä hyvin saatavilla olevia vuokra- ja omistusasuntoja. Täällä on tilaa asua, harrastaa ja viihtyä myös työpäivän jälkeen.

Työn aloitus sovitaan joustavasti, kuitenkin viimeistään **helmikuussa 2027**.

Kiinnostuitko? Kerro meille itsestäsi, kokemuksestasi ja siitä, mikä sinua ruoan tekemisessä innostaa.

**Tervetuloa tekemään hyvää ruokaa ja hyvää arkea Sahanlahteen!**

title: Coach sportif H/F
description:

Aujourd'hui, nous souhaitons agrandir notre équipe et nous recherchons avant tout des personnalités.

Parce que l'équilibre de vie compte aussi : chez nous, pas de travail le week-end et des journées qui se terminent au plus tard à 19h30.

Votre diplôme ne nous dira pas tout de vous.

Vous êtes déjà diplômé(e) CQP, BPJEPS ou STAPS ? Très bien.

Vous ne l'êtes pas encore ? Votre profil nous intéresse aussi.

Pour les personnes non diplômées, nous recherchons des candidats prêts à s'engager dans un parcours de formation afin d'obtenir la qualification professionnelle nécessaire à l'encadrement sportif.

Ce que nous recherchons surtout

Une personne dynamique, bienveillante, fiable et engagée, avec un vrai sens du relationnel.

Quelqu'un qui aime travailler en équipe, créer de l'énergie, encourager, motiver et célébrer les progrès.

Chez Curves, on ne reste pas dans un coin à regarder les adhérentes s'entraîner. On crée une ambiance, on rassemble, on motive et on accompagne chacune pour l'aider à progresser.

Et surtout, nous cherchons quelqu'un qui a envie d'apprendre et de s'investir durablement dans le club.

Votre mission

Vous participerez à la vie du club dans son ensemble :

* accueillir et accompagner nos adhérentes ;
* animer le circuit et créer une dynamique de groupe ;
* suivre leur progression et célébrer leurs résultats ;
* réaliser les mesures, suivis corporels et bilans de forme ;
* accompagner nos adhérentes vers leurs objectifs de remise en forme, de perte de masse grasse et de préservation de leur masse musculaire ;
* présenter nos solutions et programmes d'accompagnement ;
* assurer le suivi de la fréquentation et la relation avec les adhérentes ;
* participer aux ventes et au développement du club ;
* contribuer ponctuellement à notre communication et à nos actions de promotion ;
* et, comme toute l'équipe, participer au bon fonctionnement et à la tenue du club.

Principales missions et actions :

- Lire et interpréter les plans, les schémas mécaniques ou les fiches techniques constructeur.

- Participer à la mise au point et à l'amélioration des outillages ou machines.
- Assister et accompagner les techniciens spécialistes d'entreprises extérieures lors de la remise en état des machines critiques ou à forte valeur ajoutée pour le site.

- Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des équipements (analyse de pannes, fiabilisation, propositions techniques).
- Appliquer les procédures de sécurité, de consignation et de déconsignation lors des interventions.

title: Vendeur / Vendeuse en vins et spiritueux (H/F)
description:
Commercial régional vins - Grande distribution  (h/f)

Vous connaissez le vin et la grande distribution, et vous aimez le terrain ? Nous recherchons notre Responsable commercial régional GMS (h/f) pour la zone 30/34.

Une gamme qui s'enrichit chaque année, des clients à écouter, des idées à transformer en produits : voilà le métier de commercial chez Fonjoya.

Entre le causse du Larzac et la plaine de l'Hérault, la matière à raconter est riche : Terrasses du Larzac, Languedoc, Languedoc Saint-Saturnin, IGP Pays d'Hérault, IGP Saint-Guilhem-le-Désert, du rouge, du blanc, du rosé. Huit à dix nouveautés par an, et une histoire à raconter aux enseignes. Vous écoutez vos clients, vous trouvez ce qui leur manque, vous le leur proposez ; et si le produit n'existe pas encore, vous le créez avec eux. La commande vient en aboutissement.

  

Pourquoi ce poste est stimulant

1. Un portefeuille acquis, un territoire à ouvrir
Le terrain se joue sur deux tableaux. Dans l'Hérault, de nouveaux magasins ont rejoint le portefeuille chaque année : vous reprenez une zone déjà acquise, à sécuriser et à fidéliser. Dans le Gard et sur le littoral, une zone quasi vierge, tout est à développer.

2. Une autonomie encadrée
La politique de prix est posée, les opérations cadrées, et vous négociez avec une réelle autonomie, à l'intérieur d'une marge de manœuvre définie.

3. Au cœur d'une maison de vin
Fonjoya est une coopérative de vignerons qui a tout d'une maison de vin : ses appellations, un chai à barriques et un outil d'embouteillage au siège, deux boutiques. Vous faites le lien entre la maison et ses clients, et vous contribuez aux nouveautés de l'année.

  

Pourquoi nous avons besoin de vous
Nous cherchons la personne qui prendra la suite d'un commercial dont le travail laisse de bonnes bases : une partie de son portefeuille vous revient, avec des magasins qui connaissent déjà la maison.
Votre premier objectif : sécuriser ce portefeuille, en gardant les relations en place et en y ajoutant les vôtres. En parallèle, vous partez à la conquête du Gard et du littoral.

  

Ce que vous ferez au quotidien
Votre activité est tournée vers le terrain. Les centrales d'achat sont gérées par notre responsable grands comptes ; vous, vous gérez le Direct.


  Prospecter et ouvrir des comptes : prospecter les magasins de votre secteur, dans l'Hérault et le Gard, littoral compris.

  Fidéliser votre portefeuille : entretenir la relation avec les magasins que vous reprenez.

  Visiter vos magasins et assurer le merchandising : mise en rayon, niveaux et mise à niveau, avec l'appui d'un alternant.

  Vendre les opérations : proposer les promotions et opérations cadrées à vos clients.

  Proposer et co-créer : étiquettes, marques de magasin, personnalisation, palettes sur mesure. Vous suivez la concurrence et les attentes des consommateurs, vous remontez les idées du terrain et vous participez au lancement de nouveaux produits.

  Négocier : défendre vos prix auprès de vos clients et préparer avec la direction les tarifs annuels.

  Contribuer aux objectifs de vente : sécuriser votre portefeuille la première année et développer le Gard et le littoral.

  Suivre vos clients et piloter votre activité : saisie des commandes et suivi dans Corail.


Le profil que nous recherchons
Vous avez déjà une expérience réussie dans le vin, et la grande distribution n'a plus de secret pour vous : vous savez parler à ses interlocuteurs en magasin. Vous avez une formation supérieure en commerce des vins (Bac+3 à Bac+5), ou un parcours équivalent.

Mais au-delà du parcours, c'est votre façon de faire qui compte. Vous aimez ouvrir de nouveaux comptes, négocier et construire des relations de confiance avec vos clients. Un interlocuteur difficile ne vous fait pas perdre le cap : vous gardez votre sérénité, et la relation tient dans la durée. Vous avancez par l'échange et le conseil, et vous trouvez votre place dans une équipe qui joue collectif, autour d'un objectif commun.

Vous êtes curieux-se : vous cherchez l'opportunité. Vos idées, vous aimez les partager.

Et si vous avez déjà un portefeuille en grande distribution en direct, l'expérience du lancement de produits et de la personnalisation, la connaissance du milieu coopératif ou un réseau dans le Gard : ce sera un vrai plus.

  

Avec qui vous le ferez
Vous rejoignez une équipe dynamique, dans une cave de 35 salariés en progression, qui cultive la simplicité et la sobriété.

Vous êtes rattaché-e à la direction, avec qui vous échangez presque chaque jour : ce que vous voyez sur le terrain remonte, ce qui se décide à la cave redescend.

Au quotidien, vous travaillez avec :


  deux autres commerciaux, autonomes, avec qui vous partagez les produits, les idées et les retours du terrain ;

  un alternant, qui vous seconde sur la mise en rayon.


Le mercredi, vous êtes au bureau pour la réunion commerciale.
...

Vous serez formé(e) à notre méthode et à notre façon d'accompagner les adhérentes, notamment sur l'activité physique, le suivi corporel, la nutrition et le bien-vieillir.

Nous ne recherchons pas quelqu'un qui sait déjà tout. Nous recherchons quelqu'un qui a envie d'apprendre, de progresser et de faire progresser les autres.

Et si c'était vous ?

Vous avez de l'énergie.
Vous aimez les gens.
Vous aimez le sport.
Vous êtes sensible aux questions de santé et de bien-vieillir.
Vous êtes fiable et aimez travailler en équipe.
Vous avez envie que votre travail ait un impact concret sur la vie des autres.

Même sans expérience professionnelle dans le sport, nous avons envie de découvrir votre profil.

-Fin de journée au plus tard à 19h30

Les profils présélectionnés seront ensuite recontactés pour poursuivre le processus de recrutement.

Les missions du poste

Vous avez envie de faire partie d'une équipe dynamique dans une entreprise en croissance ?

Evoluant dans le secteur BTP, et plus précisément dans la maintenance et les travaux de toitures, Ecotoit a des collaborateurs sur des centaines de sites, participant à la maintenance et rénovation de plusieurs milliers de bâtiments par an. Nous intervenons sur tout type de problématiques de toitures, de la plus simple couverture à la plus complexe des étanchéités.

Dans le cadre de notre essor, nous recherchons un chef d'équipe étancheur placé sous la direction du conducteur de travaux.

VOS MISSIONS
Sur des chantiers d'étanchéité allant de la maintenance (recherches de fuites, réparations, entretien de toitures-terrasses...) jusqu'aux chantiers plus conséquents, vous :

* Formation continue

ECOTOIT est une entreprise spécialisée dans la MAINTENANCE et TRAVAUX de toiture de tous types. Nous intervenons essentiellement pour le secteur public : maintenance, urgence (dont recherche de fuites) et travaux d'étanchéité et de couverture traditionnelle. Notre force : une très forte culture sécurité et des outils informatiques performants qui optimisent nos interventions.
