title: Join Landspítali as a Consultant in Respiratory Medicine in Iceland
description:
We are seeking a Consultant in Respiratory Medicine to join Landspítali University Hospital, with a start date of 1 November 2026 or as otherwise agreed.
The position is full-time; however, a lower employment ratio may be considered by mutual agreement.

Our Department of Pulmonary Medicine consists of a strong and ambitious team of physicians managing a broad range of clinical responsibilities in close collaboration with other healthcare professionals. We are looking for a dedicated and motivated specialist who wishes to contribute to highly specialised care and follow-up of patients with respiratory diseases.

Why Join Landspítali?

At Landspítali, we offer:
•    A stimulating and rewarding consultant-level position at Iceland's national university hospital, with diverse and interesting clinical responsibilities.
•    A 36-hour work week that supports a healthy work-life balance.
•    Close collaboration with experienced multidisciplinary teams and specialists across a range of clinical disciplines.
•    An academic environment where clinical practice, research, teaching, and innovation go hand in hand.
•    A supportive workplace that values staff wellbeing, professional development, and continuous learning.
•    Opportunities to learn Icelandic, including language courses offered partly during working hours during the first two years of employment.
•    The opportunity to live and work in Iceland and enjoy a high quality of life in a safe and well-functioning society.
•    Easy access to spectacular nature, clean air, and year-round outdoor activities, including hiking, skiing, geothermal bathing, and unique natural experiences.

Duties and Responsibilities
•    Care of patients on hospital wards and in the intensive care unit.
•    Outpatient clinics and day-ward services involving a broad range of pulmonary conditions, including but not limited to:
   o    Interstitial lung diseases
   o    Severe asthma
   o    Lung cancer diagnostics and follow up
   o    Advanced COPD and other late-stage obstructive lung diseases
   o    Acute and chronic respiratory failure
   o    Home mechanical ventilation and other ventilatory support therapies
•    Performance of interventional procedures, including:
   o    Bronchoscopy
   o    Pleural procedures/thoracentesis
   o    Exercise testing (cardiopulmonary excercise testing)
•    Participation in the pulmonary medicine on-call service.
•    Participation in acute internal medicine services, including on-call duties, as agreed with the Head of Pulmonary Medicine.
•    Teaching and supervision of medical students, intern/foundation doctors, and specialty trainees.
•    Participation in research activities.
•    Other duties as agreed with the Head of Department.

Qualifications
•    Specialist certification in Pulmonology/Respiratory Medicine.
•    Icelandic medical licence and specialist recognition in Pulmonology, or eligibility to obtain these credentials.
•    Broad knowledge and experience in Internal Medicine and Pulmonology.
•    Proven ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
•    Positive attitude, flexibility, and strong collaborative skills.
•    Experience in teaching and research is considered an advantage.

Additional Information
A full-time position is exclusively affiliated with the hospital in accordance with Article 3.3 of the current collective agreement between physicians and the Icelandic State.

The position is available from 1 November 2026 or by mutual agreement. The application deadline is 23 October 2026.

For further information, please contact:
Sif Hansdóttir, Consultant Physician
E-mail: sifhan@landspitali.is

Application Requirements
Applications should include information on:
•    Previous employment, education, and professional qualifications
•    Positions of trust and references

Mandatory Attachments
•    Certified copies of degree certificates and specialist qualifications/licences
•    Curriculum Vitae (CV), including teaching, research, and leadership experience
•    List of scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals. Applicants should either provide a link to their Google Scholar profile or submit publication documentation from PubMed.
•    Cover letter describing the applicant's qualifications and interest in the position

All attachments must be submitted in PDF format.

Selected candidates will be invited for interviews. Appointment decisions will be based on interviews and submitted documentation. Recruitment is conducted in accordance with Landspítali's Equal Opportunities Policy. All applicants will be informed of the outcome of the recruitment process.

Information regarding residence and work permits is available on our website.
To apply for the position, click the dark blue button "Sækja um starf" (Apply for Position). You may then switch the website language to English and log in to the Icelandic Government's recruitment system.

About Landspítali
Landspítali is a dynamic and diverse workplace where approximately 7,000 employees work in multidisciplinary teams and in close collaboration across professional groups. The hospital's vision is to provide healthcare of the highest quality, based on science, professionalism, and compassion, delivered by skilled staff and supported by modern facilities and a positive working environment.
Landspítali is certified according to the Icelandic Equal Pay Standard ÍST 85:2012. The certification has been awarded following an audit conducted by Versa Vottun ehf.

Applications may remain valid for up to six months from the publication date of the advertisement, in accordance with Icelandic Government Regulation No. 1000/2019 on the advertisement of vacant public positions, as amended.

title: Experienced Grounds Maintenance Operative
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
About the job We are looking for a hardworking, reliable and practical person to join us in carrying out garden maintenance and lawn care throughout Mid-Kerry and Killarney. This is a hands-on, outdoor role for someone who enjoys physical work, takes pride in doing a good job and is comfortable working in changeable Irish weather. Some previous gardening or grounds maintenance experience is essential, but we are happy to train the right person who has a positive attitude, is willing to learn and takes their responsibilities seriously. You will work at different properties throughout the area, helping to maintain gardens and outdoor spaces to a high standard. Main duties; Lawn mowing, strimming and general lawn care. Hedge trimming, pruning and weeding. General garden maintenance and seasonal work. Safe use and care of gardening machinery. Keeping gardens and work areas tidy. Working efficiently and taking pride in the quality of your work. The person we're looking for The ideal candidate will be: Reliable, punctual and hardworking. Experienced in basic gardening, lawn care or similar outdoor work. Physically fit and comfortable with practical, outdoor work. Happy to work in rain, cold and changeable weather when conditions are safe. Willing to learn new skills and operate machinery safely. Attentive to detail and committed to doing a good job. Able to work well with others and follow instructions. A full driving licence is an advantage. Working hours and weather; This is a full-time position, with a typical working week of approximately 39 hours, depending on workload and weather conditions. Hours may vary from week to week, and working hours may reduce during the winter months when weather conditions are unpredictable. We work outdoors throughout the year where conditions allow. However, we do not work during storms or flooding, and work may be postponed when conditions are unsafe. Flexibility and an understanding of the seasonal nature of gardening work are important. Travel and equipment; Work takes place at different locations throughout Mid-Kerry and Killarney. We meet at an agreed base and travel to the day's jobs together. All main gardening machinery and equipment are supplied by the business. You do not need to purchase or bring your own lawnmower, strimmer, hedge trimmer or other main machinery. We will explain any requirements for suitable work clothing and footwear before you start. What we offer; Full-time outdoor work. Main gardening machinery and equipment provided. The opportunity to develop your gardening and grounds maintenance skills. Hands-on training for the right candidate. A varied role working at different properties throughout the area. Pay will be discussed based on experience and suitability for the role. How to apply Please send us your CV and a short description of your gardening, grounds maintenance or other practical outdoor work experience. We are looking for someone dependable who takes pride in their work.

title: Transfer Pricing Senior
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
RBK is seeking a high-performing Transfer Pricing Senior to join our International Tax – Transfer Pricing (TP) Team. Working directly with our Transfer Pricing Director, you will support a varied portfolio of multinationals, mid-market companies and fast-growing international businesses across transfer pricing, tax compliance and advisory. The role can be tailored to your experience and career goals, whether you wish to broaden your consultancy experience across tax, focus on compliance or develop a specialist area. Responsibilities Manage end-to-end TP projects, including scoping, benchmarking, documentation (local and master files) and financial/economic analysis. Draft and review TP reports, technical memoranda, intercompany agreements, intangible pricing, intra-group services and cost allocations. Handle client queries and conduct functional, industry and economic analyses to support pricing models. Support TP audits and disputes, defend documentation before tax authorities and contribute to dispute prevention and resolution. Apply and monitor OECD/G20 BEPS guidance, EU and local TP regulations. Build client relationships, understand business models, value chains and risks, and align TP policies with commercial strategies. Collaborate across tax, finance, legal and operations on structuring, cross-border transactions, supply chains, IP and intra-group financing. Review junior colleagues' work, provide coaching and feedback, and contribute to training and knowledge sharing. Manage project budgets, billing and WIP, ensuring timely, high-quality delivery. Support business development through proposals, client pitches and practice growth. Requirements 2–4 years' relevant TP experience in a professional services consulting firm. Strong knowledge of OECD guidelines, the BEPS framework and local TP regulations. Experience in TP documentation, benchmarking, financial modelling and technical report writing. Exposure to audits, dispute resolution or advisory projects (e.g. supply chain, IP or restructuring) is advantageous. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to interpret complex financial and economic data. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including explaining technical issues to non-technical stakeholders. Experience with TP databases (e.g. Capital IQ, RoyaltyStat or TP Catalyst) preferred. Proficiency in MS Office, including Excel, PowerPoint and Word. Ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines and maintain high-quality work. Teamwork, leadership potential and willingness to coach junior colleagues. Proactive, detail-oriented and committed to keeping up with international tax and TP developments. Commercial awareness and understanding of how TP interacts with business strategy, risk and cost structures. This is a full-time position based in Dublin, with a 37.5-hour working week.

title: tecnico dell’ambiente
description: Per importante realtà manifatturiera nostra cliente ricerchiamo un/una SENIOR HSE SPECIALIST / ASPP. Inserita a riporto diretto dell'HSE & Facility Manager, la risorsa avrà un ruolo chiave nel presidio quotidiano di Salute, Sicurezza e Ambiente in stabilimento, con responsabilità operative e di miglioramento continuo. Responsabilità principali Condurre attività di valutazione dei rischi e contribuire alla stesura/aggiornamento del DVR e della documentazione correlata. Definire e implementare misure di prevenzione e protezione, monitorandone l'efficacia tramite audit, verifiche e indicatori. Gestire e aggiornare lo scadenziario relativo ad adempimenti normativi (safety e ambiente) e requisiti volontari. Coordinare il supporto di consulenti esterni per valutazioni specifiche (es. rumore, chimico, ATEX, ergonomia, movimentazione manuale, ecc.). Pianificare ed erogare (o far erogare) la formazione HSE e la sensibilizzazione del personale, anche con iniziative sul campo. Gestire la sorveglianza sanitaria in collaborazione con il Medico Competente (programmi, idoneità, tracciabilità). Presidiare la qualifica e gestione HSE degli appaltatori: accessi, documentazione, permessi di lavoro e DUVRI. Curare la gestione delle sostanze chimiche (valutazione rischio, conformità, impatti ambientali, schede sicurezza, omologazioni/approvazioni interne). Supportare la verifica dei processi produttivi e delle modalità operative per ridurre rischi e impatti ambientali. Contribuire agli adempimenti ambientali (autorizzazioni, prescrizioni, monitoraggi e attività analitiche). Mantenere e migliorare procedure e istruzioni operative del Sistema di Gestione secondo ISO 45001 e ISO 14001, supportando audit interni/esterni. Promuovere la cultura della sicurezza e programmi di sicurezza comportamentale, favorendo il coinvolgimento attivo dei lavoratori. Analizzare near miss, incidenti e infortuni con approccio root cause, definendo e tracciando azioni correttive/preventive. Collaborare con l'HSE Manager su iniziative di sostenibilità e miglioramento delle performance ambientali. Requisiti Laurea (preferibile indirizzo ingegneristico/tecnico con focus HSE o affini). Abilitazione ASPP (Moduli A e B). Esperienza consolidata in ruolo HSE in contesti manifatturieri/industriali. Conoscenza operativa delle norme ISO 45001 e ISO 14001. Offerta Contratto a tempo indeterminato, CCNL Metalmeccanico, livello impiegatizio. RAL indicativa 45.000 - 55.000 € + variabile. RAL commisurata a esperienza e competenze. Sede di lavoro: Provincia di Alessandria (AL) con un giorno di smart working. Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description:
.....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich
- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour
- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Interesse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Fahrzeugführung, Gästebetreuung, Technisches Verständnis

Familiarità con modelli GEO/MEO/LEO, servizi MSS, satellite IoT, NTN, VSAT o connettività in aree remote. Inserito/a nel reparto Engineering (R&D/Industrializzazione), contribuirai allo sviluppo di soluzioni software avanzate per macchine e impianti automatici, integrando automazione, robotica e visione artificiale, con focus su performance, affidabilità e sicurezza. Sviluppo & commissioning automazione: PLC, Motion, HMI/SCADA (Siemens/Rockwell/Beckhoff/Codesys). Test/validazione, troubleshooting, ottimizzazione. Robot/celle (ABB/Fanuc/Yaskawa), motion planning & digital twin. ROS2 + simulazione (RVIZ/Unity/Emulate3D/Isaac Sim). Doc tecnica, training, supporto rilascio/avviamento. DevOps (es. Azure DevOps) per versioning/review. PackML & best practice per linee/upgrade converting. Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? title: 3D Production Manager (m/f/d) (3-D-Artist)
description:
We`re fast. We‘re colorful. We are loud and quiet. We love what we do and make an important contribution to our customers‘ success every day. We create quality and are one of the leading media and IT service providers in Europe. From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. SCHNELLMEDIA stands for know-how and future. Our passion is professional image editing, online and print production as well as real 3D/AI visualization.

We are SCHNELLMEDIA and have a lot of plans.

A strong team needs strong personalities, therefore we are looking for a

3D Production Manager (m/f/d)
Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm
YOUR TASKS:

- Leadership of a motivated 3D production team (Home & Living, Fashion, Retail Industry)
- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows
- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi
- Monitoring, ensuring, and optimizing processes
- Organizing and coordinating between the local branch and the German headquarters
- Actively contributing to the further development of our company
YOUR PROFILE:

- Experience in leadership
- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows
- Experience in photorealistic 3D visualizations of products (focus on furniture) is a plus
- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner
- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability
- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style
- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness
- Fluent English (business level)
OUR TOP 3 REASONS:

- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design
- Responsibility right from the start
- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international company

After an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Apply now with your complete application documents, your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.
WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION.

-------------------

Wir sind schnell. Wir sind farbenfroh. Wir sind laut und leise. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und leisten täglich einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden. Wir schaffen Qualität und zählen zu den führenden Medien- und IT-Dienstleistern in Europa. Von Deutschland und unseren Standorten in Asien aus beraten und unterstützen wir internationale Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen – etwa Werbung, Fotografie, Handel und Industrie. SCHNELLMEDIA steht für Know-how und Zukunft. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der professionellen Bildbearbeitung, der Online- und Printproduktion sowie der echten 3D- und KI-Visualisierung.

Wir sind SCHNELLMEDIA und haben viel vor. Ein starkes Team braucht starke Persönlichkeiten – daher suchen wir einen

3D Production Manager (m/w/d)
Hanoi (Vietnam) sowie Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm

DEINE AUFGABEN:

Führung eines motivierten 3D-Produktionsteams (Bereiche: Home & Living, Fashion, Einzelhandel)
Steuerung der täglichen 3D-Asset-Produktion sowie Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe und effizienter Workflows
Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Motivation des Teams in Hanoi
Überwachung, Sicherstellung und Optimierung von Prozessen
Organisation und Koordination der Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Standort vor Ort und der deutschen Zentrale
Aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens

DEIN PROFIL:

Führungserfahrung
Erfahrung mit 3D-Software wie Blender und/oder 3ds Max sowie V-Ray für ein fundiertes Verständnis von 3D-Workflows
Erfahrung in der fotorealistischen 3D-Produktvisualisierung (Schwerpunkt Möbel) ist von Vorteil
Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und lösungsorientierter Kommunikation
Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität sowie Zuverlässigkeit
Strukturierte, eigenständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Durchsetzungsstärke
Fließende Englischkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher)

UNSERE TOP-3-GRÜNDE:

Eine von Zusammenarbeit und Mitgestaltung geprägte Unternehmenskultur
Verantwortung von Anfang an
Kurze Entscheidungswege in einem wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen
Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase unterstützen wir dich selbstverständlich bei deinem Umzug nach Hanoi und stehen dir bei Fragen jederzeit zur Seite. Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

WIR FREUEN UNS AUF DEINE BEWERBUNG.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Visualisierungs- und Animationssoftware Blender, Grafikprogramm 3D Studio Max/3ds Max, 3-D-Design, Grafik-Design (Gebrauchsgrafik)

title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e creare sinergie commerciali a mercato per l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture. Ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). title: assistente alle risorse umane
description: Hai una mente analitica e ti appassiona lavorare con i dati? Cerchi lavoro in ambito finanziario? Grafton Office è la specializzazione dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per prestigiosa azienda cliente selezioniamo: Financial Analyst - Personnel Cost Ricerchiamo candidato/a con consolidata esperienza nel controllo del costo del lavoro. Nello specifico la risorsa si occuperà di redazione del budget annuale e forecast mensili, con analisi puntuale degli headcount e degli scostamenti, creazione di report e dashboard per il monitoraggio dei principali HR analytics (turnover, assenze, straordinari, ferie, ecc.); eseguirà inoltre registrazioni contabili e attività di supporto amministrativo-contabile connesse al costo del personale, supporto ai processi di Payroll, con focus su tematiche e quadrature legate ai costi del personale e alla loro corretta rappresentazione. Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Industrial Design Engineer (m/w/d)

Interfaccia operativa, sotto supervisione, con laboratori esterni, consulenti regolatori ed enti certificatori. Collaborazione trasversale con team R&D, Qualità e Operations. description: Per Startup in fase di sviluppo che sta costruendo una piattaforma europea di connettività satellitare con focus su capacità wholesale, servizi di connettività gestita e applicazioni IoT abilitate dal satellite, ricerchiamo un/una Responsabile Downstream, Wholesale e Connettività Satellitare IoT (percorso Co-founder) La figura riportando alla direzione, affiancherà e collaborerà con il responsabile Upstream & Space Systems già inserito nel progetto, portando esperienza concreta, verificabile e diretta nel settore satcom. Obiettivo della ricerca Inserire un profilo senior in grado di guidare lo sviluppo downstream e commerciale dell'iniziativa, con responsabilità primaria nella costruzione del mercato, delle partnership e dell'offerta per la vendita di connettività satellitare all'ingrosso e dei servizi collegati. Il ruolo è pensato per una figura con forte attitudine imprenditoriale, credibilità industriale e capacità di esecuzione in una fase iniziale di impresa. title: 3D Production Manager (m/f/d) (3-D-Artist)
description:
We`re fast. We‘re colorful. We are loud and quiet. We love what we do and make an important contribution to our customers‘ success every day. We create quality and are one of the leading media and IT service providers in Europe. From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. SCHNELLMEDIA stands for know-how and future. Our passion is professional image editing, online and print production as well as real 3D/AI visualization.

We are SCHNELLMEDIA and have a lot of plans.

A strong team needs strong personalities, therefore we are looking for a

3D Production Manager (m/f/d)
Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm
YOUR TASKS:

- Leadership of a motivated 3D production team (Home & Living, Fashion, Retail Industry)
- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows
- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi
- Monitoring, ensuring, and optimizing processes
- Organizing and coordinating between the local branch and the German headquarters
- Actively contributing to the further development of our company
YOUR PROFILE:

- Experience in leadership
- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows
- Experience in photorealistic 3D visualizations of products (focus on furniture) is a plus
- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner
- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability
- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style
- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness
- Fluent English (business level)
OUR TOP 3 REASONS:

- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design
- Responsibility right from the start
- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international company

After an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Apply now with your complete application documents, your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.
WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION.

-------------------

Wir sind schnell. Wir sind farbenfroh. Wir sind laut und leise. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und leisten täglich einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden. Wir schaffen Qualität und zählen zu den führenden Medien- und IT-Dienstleistern in Europa. Von Deutschland und unseren Standorten in Asien aus beraten und unterstützen wir internationale Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen – etwa Werbung, Fotografie, Handel und Industrie. SCHNELLMEDIA steht für Know-how und Zukunft. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der professionellen Bildbearbeitung, der Online- und Printproduktion sowie der echten 3D- und KI-Visualisierung.

Wir sind SCHNELLMEDIA und haben viel vor. Ein starkes Team braucht starke Persönlichkeiten – daher suchen wir einen

3D Production Manager (m/w/d)
Hanoi (Vietnam) sowie Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm

DEINE AUFGABEN:

Führung eines motivierten 3D-Produktionsteams (Bereiche: Home & Living, Fashion, Einzelhandel)
Steuerung der täglichen 3D-Asset-Produktion sowie Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe und effizienter Workflows
Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Motivation des Teams in Hanoi
Überwachung, Sicherstellung und Optimierung von Prozessen
Organisation und Koordination der Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Standort vor Ort und der deutschen Zentrale
Aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens

DEIN PROFIL:

Führungserfahrung
Erfahrung mit 3D-Software wie Blender und/oder 3ds Max sowie V-Ray für ein fundiertes Verständnis von 3D-Workflows
Erfahrung in der fotorealistischen 3D-Produktvisualisierung (Schwerpunkt Möbel) ist von Vorteil
Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und lösungsorientierter Kommunikation
Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität sowie Zuverlässigkeit
Strukturierte, eigenständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Durchsetzungsstärke
Fließende Englischkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher)

UNSERE TOP-3-GRÜNDE:

Eine von Zusammenarbeit und Mitgestaltung geprägte Unternehmenskultur
Verantwortung von Anfang an
Kurze Entscheidungswege in einem wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen
Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase unterstützen wir dich selbstverständlich bei deinem Umzug nach Hanoi und stehen dir bei Fragen jederzeit zur Seite. Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

WIR FREUEN UNS AUF DEINE BEWERBUNG.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Visualisierungs- und Animationssoftware Blender, Grafikprogramm 3D Studio Max/3ds Max, 3-D-Design, Grafik-Design (Gebrauchsgrafik)

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

title: PROGRAMMĒTĀJS
description:
Darba devējs ir Wandoo Finance SIA, reģ. Nr.: 40103970112

Pievienojies Wandoo Finance komandai kā Programmatūras izstrādātājs (-a) un palīdzi izstrādāt un attīstīt mērogojamu aizdevumu platformu, kas atbalstīs miljoniem aizdevumu visā pasaulē.

Mēs esam strauji augošs globāls fintech uzņēmums ar galveno biroju Latvijā un darbību Polijā, Spānijā, Rumānijā, Peru un nu jau arī Lietuvā. Mēs nodrošinām inovatīvus finanšu risinājumus dažādos tirgos, apvienojot tehnoloģisku domāšanu ar starptautisku mērogu.

Šajā amatā Tu uzņemsies atbildību par vienu no mūsu aizdevumu platformām — izstrādāsi jaunas funkcionalitātes, kas uzlabo lietotāju pieredzi, stiprināsi sistēmas stabilitāti un drošību, kā arī pilnveidosi sistēmas arhitektūru, lai tā būtu gatava straujai izaugsmei.

Šī nav pozīcija cilvēkam, kurš vienkārši izpilda uzdevumus pēc saraksta. Mēs meklējam spēcīgu tehnisko profesionāli, kurš vēlas izprast biznesa un lietotāju vajadzības un aktīvi atbalstīt uzņēmuma izaugsmi. Tu cieši sadarbsies ar produktu, analītikas un biznesa komandām, lai veidotu sistēmu, kuru izmanto desmitiem tūkstošu lietotāju un kas pārvalda miljoniem eiro aizdevumos.

Ja Tev patīk veidot uzticamas sistēmas, uzdot jautājumu “kāpēc?” pirms “kā?”, un apvienot tehnisko izcilību ar biznesa izpratni — šī loma ir Tev.

Tu pievienosies motivētu un aizrautīgu izstrādātāju komandai, kas strādā pie nākamās paaudzes aizdevumu platformas. Tas nozīmē, ka Tavi lēmumi, kods un profesionālais vērtējums tieši ietekmēs produkta attīstību.

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

title: Rahoituskonsultti / -neuvoja

**Rahoituskonsultti / -neuvoja, yrittäjämalli rakenna oma roolisi yritysrahoituksessa**

Rekryprosessimme löytyy linkistä: **_https://www.financialservicesgroup.fi/rekry_**

Yritysrahoitus ei ole pelkkiä hakemuksia ja päätöksiä. Se on ymmärrystä, ajoitusta ja oikean ratkaisun rakentamista asiakkaalle.

FSG Financial Services Group rakentaa Trusty Finance -brändin alla uudenlaista toimintamallia pk-yritysten rahoitukseen. Yhdistämme asiakasymmärryksen, datan ja teknologian ja autamme suomalaisia pk-yrityksiä saamaan tarvitsemansa rahoituksen nopeammin ja oikeammilla ehdoilla. Perustajatiimillämme on yhteensä yli 95 vuotta kokemusta rahoituksesta, varainhoidosta ja teknologiasta.

Etsimme nyt itsenäisiä yrittäjiä mukaan asiakastyöhön Trusty Finance Broker -palvelun pariin. Kyseessä ei ole työsuhde, vaan yrittäjämallinen yhteistyö, jossa oma roolisi, vastuusi ja ansaintasi rakentuvat tekemisen laadun ja tulosten mukaan.

Työskentelet pk-yritysten kanssa ja olet usein heidän ensimmäinen kontaktinsa Trusty Finance Brokerin pariin. Työsi sisältää:

- yritysten kontaktointia ja keskustelun avaamista heidän tilanteestaan

- rahoitustarpeiden ja liiketoiminnan alustavaa kartoittamista

- asiakkaan ohjaamista Trusty Finance Brokerin välityspalveluun

- asiakkaan tukemista prosessin aikana ja eteenpäin viemistä


Roolin ydin ei ole tuotteiden myynti, vaan asiakkaan tilanteen ymmärtäminen ja oikean reitin tunnistaminen. Trusty Finance Broker on yritysasiakkaalle maksuton, mikä madaltaa kynnystä keskustelun aloittamiseen.

- Toimintatapasi rakentuu selkeän ja toistettavan polun varaan:

- avaat keskustelun pk-yrityksen kanssa ja kartoitat alustavasti tilanteen

- tunnistat, milloin Trusty Finance Broker vastaa asiakkaan rahoitustarpeeseen

- ohjaat asiakkaan tekemään rahoitusanalyysin Trusty Finance Brokerin välityspalvelussa

- tuet asiakasta prosessin aikana ja varmistat, että hän etenee


Varsinainen rahoitusanalyysi ja vaihtoehtojen rakentaminen tapahtuu Trusty Finance Brokerin välityspalvelussa. Sinun tehtäväsi on tunnistaa oikea hetki, rakentaa luottamusta ja saada asiakas käynnistämään prosessi. Tämä tekee tekemisestäsi suoraviivaista ja skaalautuvaa voit keskittyä asiakaskontaktiin ja luottamuksen rakentamiseen, kun analyysi ja kilpailutus hoituvat palvelussa.

Tämä mahdollisuus sopii sinulle, jos:

- viihdyt asiakastyössä ja osaat rakentaa luottamusta

- olet oma-aloitteinen ja pystyt toimimaan itsenäisesti

- olet kiinnostunut liiketoiminnasta, rahoituksesta tai konsultatiivisesta työstä

- haluat vaikuttaa omaan tekemiseesi ja ansaintaasi


Taustasi voi olla esimerkiksi B2B-myynnissä, yritysasiakkaiden parissa, rahoituksessa, pankissa, taloushallinnossa tai muussa roolissa, jossa olet työskennellyt asiakkaiden kanssa. Aiempi kokemus auttaa, mutta tärkeintä on oikea ote, kyky oppia ja halu viedä asioita eteenpäin.

title: Executive Assistant & Business Management Support - CEO Office (H/F)
description: Description du poste Spécialisés dans le recrutement des profils qualifiés et experts, People Solutions by Arhis propose un accompagnement sur-mesure pour votre évolution professionnelle. Chez People Solutions by Arhis, nous savons que chaque parcours est unique. C'est pourquoi nous mettons notre expertise en recrutement au service de votre projet professionnel, en vous proposant un accompagnement personnalisé et attentif pour trouver l'opportunité qui correspond réellement à vos aspirations. Nous recherchons pour un de nos clients, un.e : Executive Assistant & Business Management Support - CEO Office CDI / Banque / Luxembourg NOTRE CLIENT Pour l'un de nos clients, acteur bancaire de premier plan au Luxembourg, nous recherchons un(e) Executive Assistant & Business Management Support pour rejoindre l'environnement direct du CEO et de son Executive Office. Cette opportunité va au-delà d'un poste classique d'Executive Assistant. Aux côtés du CEO et de son environnement exécutif, vous combinez support de haut niveau, coordination, préparation de supports et suivi de sujets stratégiques et opérationnels. Votre rôle : permettre au CEO d'être organisé, préparé et concentré sur ses priorités, tout en assurant un suivi rigoureux des informations, demandes et actions qui gravitent autour de l'Executive Office. Il s'agit d'une fonction particulier/ièrement intéressant/ante pour un profil ayant environ 5 années d'expérience, souhaitant continuer à apprendre, gagner en exposition et évoluer progressivement vers des responsabilités plus larges de Business Management / Executive Office. Vous ne vous contentez pas d'organiser : vous anticipez, identifiez les conflits de priorité et proposez des solutions. Business Management & coordination Une partie important/ante de votre rôle consiste à faciliter le fonctionnement de l'Executive Office. À ce titre, vous : assurez le suivi des actions et décisions prises lors des réunions ; sollicitez les différentes parties prenant/antes afin d'obtenir les informations attendues ; consolidez des informations provenant de plusieurs interlocuteurs ; structurez ces éléments afin de les rendre immédiatement exploitables par le CEO ; maintenez des trackers et outils de suivi permettant de donner de la visibilité sur l'avancement des différents sujets ; contribuez à la coordination de projets et initiatives transverses ; identifiez les échéances ou sujets nécessitant une attention particulier/ière et les faites remonter de manier/ière proactive. Votre capacité à comprendre rapidement un sujet, structurer l'information et assurer le suivi jusqu'à sa finalisation fera réellement la différence. Executive Communication & préparation de supports Vous contribuez directement à la qualité des informations et documents utilisés au niveau exécutif : préparation et mise en forme de présentations PowerPoint ; préparation de briefings, notes de synthèse et meeting packs ; consolidation de données et préparation de reportings simples sous Excel ; rédaction, relecture et adaptation de communications en français et en anglais ; préparation et organisation de documents destinés à des réunions de management ou de gouvernance. Vous savez transformer une quantité important/ante d'informations en un support clair, synthétique et orienté décision. Coordination & stakeholder management Positionné(e) au cœur de l'organisation, vous êtes en interaction avec de nombreux interlocuteurs internes et externes. Vous assurez une communication fluide et professionnelle, relancez lorsque nécessaire et savez adapter votre approche à des interlocuteurs de niveaux de séniorité différents. La confidentialité, la diplomatie et la qualité de votre communication sont essentielles dans cette fonction. title: RESEARCH ENGINEER IN ATMOSPHERIC PRESSURE PLASMA DEPOSITION OF FUNCTIONAL COATINGS m/f
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST E.P.
description:
Description:

RESEARCH ENGINEER IN ATMOSPHERIC PRESSURE PLASMA DEPOSITION OF FUNCTIONAL COATINGS

Fixed term contract | Belval | 24 Months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

• Within European collaborative research and innovation projects, the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is seeking a Research Engineer in Atmospheric-Pressure Plasma Deposition of Functional Coatings. Working with universities, research institutes, and industrial partners across Europe, you will help develop high-performance, multifunctional materials and surfaces for applications ranging from fluid-dynamic surfaces to textile finishing. Your mission and contributions are:
• To conduct applied research work on atmospheric pressure plasma deposition of functional materials.
• To optimise atmospheric-pressure plasma deposition processes for functional coatings (e.g. barrier, hydrophobic, antimicrobial, or protective layers) on textured, porous, or flexible substrates.
• To scale up and transfer processes from laboratory to pilot level, including continuous (e.g. roll-to-roll) configurations, in close collaboration with industrial partners.
• To characterize the deposited materials using various surface analytical techniques, together with functional performance testing adapted to project requirements.
• To contribute to the preparation of scientific reports, publications, and presentations.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education

A PhD (or equivalent experience) in materials science, plasma science, chemistry, or on textile science and technology, with a strong focus on finishing/functionalization.

Experience and skills

• 3 to 5 years of proven experience in an international R&D environment (public or private sector).
• Demonstrated experience in atmospheric-pressure plasma deposition (e.g. DBD, plasma jets, plasma-enhanced CVD, plasma polymerisation, aerosol-assisted plasma deposition), including reactor setup, pilot or semi-pilot operation, and process implementation for functional thin films and coatings.
• Ability to evaluate and optimise key process parameters, including power and frequency, gas composition and flow, precursor delivery (vapour or aerosol), electrode gap, and substrate temperature and speed.
• Proven autonomy in surface characterization techniques, such as SEM, AFM, XPS, FTIR, ellipsometry, contact angle measurements, and functional performance testing.
• Strong awareness of laboratory and process safety, including high-voltage and RF equipment, handling reactive precursors, and management of by-products.
• You are committed to a strong data security and confidentiality, with experience in handling sensitive information according to consortium agreements.
• You have ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced international consortium environment.

Language skills

• Fluency in English, both oral and written.
• Other relevant languages are an asset.

Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 60 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
• Flexible working hours, home working policy (not remote) and access to Digital lunch vouchers

Apply online

Your application must include:

•          A motivation letter oriented towards the position and detailing your experience
•          A scientific CV with contact details
•          List of publications (and patents, if applicable)
•          Contact details of 2 references

Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by email will not be considered.

Application procedure and conditions
In accordance with Article L 252-1 of the Luxembourg Labour Code and the requirements of European Defence Agency funding, this position is open exclusively to nationals of the European Union Member States. While we maintain a commitment to equal opportunities and non-discrimination, this restriction applies due to the defence and strategic nature of this EDA-funded research initiative.

We kindly request applicants to provide their nationality for statistical purposes only, as part of our commitment to promoting diversity and ensuring equal opportunities in our workforce. This information will be kept confidential and will not be used for any discriminatory purposes.
LIST is dedicated to maintaining an inclusive work environment and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to attracting, hiring, and retaining a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without discrimination based on national origin (knowing the EDA constraints), race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, religion, age, or disability.
Applications will be continuously reviewed until the position is filled. An assessment committee will thoroughly evaluate applications, adhering to guidelines designed to ensure equal opportunities. The primary criteria for selection will be the alignment of the applicant's existing skills and expertise with the requirements mentioned above.

As part of our recruitment process, the selected candidate might be subject to a background check in accordance with applicable laws and institutional policies. Further checks and restrictions might apply to candidates in compliance with export controls requirements
For the purposes of the position and in accordance with applicable legislation, the successful candidate may be requested to provide a recent criminal record certificate.

This position offers a gross monthly salary between €6094 and €6678, paid over 13 months (€79.222–€86.814 annually) based on full time employment. The final salary offer within this range will be determined based on the candidate's overall profile, qualifications and professional experience.
For part time employment, the salary is adjusted pro rata.

description:
Description de tâches:


SD-25168 - PHD POSITION IN ADVANCED CORRELATIVE MICROSCOPY AND ISOTOPIC IMAGING FOR NEXT-GENERATION LI-ION BATTERIES

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | up to 48 months (14 months initial contract)

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us.

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies, LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.


How will you contribute?

The PhD project will focus on the development of advanced correlative microscopy and isotopic imaging methodologies to investigate lithium transport and interfacial processes in next-generation silicon-based Li-ion battery electrodes.
The candidate will contribute to the development of high-throughput FIB-SIMS workflows, building on methodologies previously developed at LIST, and will adapt innovative sample preparation strategies to preserve the complex porous structure and fragile Solid Electrolyte Interphase (SEI).
A major objective of the PhD will be to develop and optimize advanced characterization approaches, including cryogenic sample preparation and analysis, protective capping and lift-out strategies, and automated high-resolution isotopic mapping.
The candidate will also contribute to the development of automated acquisition and data-processing workflows, enabling large-area, statistically representative 2D and 3D maps of lithium isotopes and SEI-related species.
These datasets will provide quantitative information on lithium distribution and transport at the nanoscale and serve as inputs for predictive modelling of battery behaviour.
The doctoral researcher will work closely with experienced scientists, engineers and international project partners in a highly interdisciplinary environment combining battery science, nano-analytics, instrumentation, software development and data science.
The position offers the opportunity to gain expertise in cutting-edge FIB-SIMS and correlative microscopy, electrochemical materials characterization, isotopic tracing, automated data analysis and scientific communication.
The candidate will take an active role in designing and performing experiments, developing analytical methodologies, interpreting results, publishing scientific findings and presenting the work at international conferences.

Job Description
Find your purpose at KPMG Luxembourg

Join a team of diverse and dedicated problem solvers, connected by a common cause: to turn insight into opportunity for clients and communities around the world. If you are eager to learn, are interested in growing rapidly and strive to make an impact in a diverse environment, you're in the right place at the right time.

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Accountant – Corporate & Accounting Services

We are looking for a highly skilled and detail-oriented Senior Accountant with extensive experience in accounting principles and practices, particularly within the private equity and real estate sectors. In this pivotal role, you will oversee the management of accounting records, prepare comprehensive financial statements, and provide strategic insights to our clients. You will lead diverse assignments, mentor junior staff, and foster strong client relationships in a dynamic and collaborative environment.

What you will be working on

• Lead the preparation and review of financial statements, ensuring full compliance with accounting standards and regulatory requirements.
• Provide expert support to clients in maintaining their accounting records, delivering high-level technical and business insights.
• Collaborate with a dedicated team of professionals to devise and implement exceptional service solutions for clients.
• Build and maintain strong, long-lasting client relationships, demonstrating excellent communication, negotiation, and commercial acumen.
• Continuously enhance and share your technical knowledge of accounting principles and industry best practices with the team.
• Manage and oversee assignments across various sectors, ensuring quality and timely delivery of services.
• Mentor and guide junior accountants, fostering their professional growth and development within the team.
• Participate in strategic planning and decision-making processes to enhance operational efficiency and client satisfaction.

What we look for

• Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Management, or a related field.
• 4-6 years of experience in accounting or audit, with significant exposure to real estate or private equity sectors.
• In-depth knowledge of accounting principles, regulations, and best practices.
• Strong analytical, organizational, and leadership skills.
• Proven ability to work collaboratively, efficiently, and to maintain professionalism in a fast-paced environment while managing multiple priorities.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a client-focused mindset.
• A commitment to continuous learning and professional development.
• Fluent in English. French, German, Luxembourg is considered as an asset.

What you will get

We offer more than just a job. With our flexible work model, you can work, rest and recharge. Our competitive compensation packages, paid time off, recognition bonuses and dedicated programs for personal development and well-being help to keep you refreshed and motivated.

We will accompany you on a journey of professional growth, offering an expansive spectrum of prospects to elevate your career in Luxembourg, an emerging financial center. Feel a sense of belonging by enjoying year-round celebrations and engaging events that bring us all together.

Risk Officer - UCITS (m/f)

Fundsight is looking for a Risk Officer to join its UCITS Risk Management team.
In this role, you will be responsible for managing the risk management framework for a portfolio of UCITS clients.

Your role

• Assist the UCITS Risk Management team with the implementation and ongoing enhancement of the risk management framework.
• Prepare periodic risk reports on a daily, weekly and monthly basis.
• Perform risk assessments for existing and new UCITS, determine their risk profiles and monitor applicable risk limits, including market risk (commitment and VaR), credit risk, liquidity risk, counterparty risk and operational risk indicators (including TER, PTR and NAV errors).
• Contribute to the integration and monitoring of sustainability risks, including ESG, SFDR and EU Taxonomy considerations, within the risk management process.
• Support the Head of Risk Management on a range of risk management matters.
• Review the existing risk management framework against regulatory and internal requirements, in close cooperation with other departments.
• Monitor UCITS liquidity and analyse the results of liquidity stress tests.
• Provide regular updates to the Head of Risk Management and the relevant governing bodies.

Your skills and experience

• Master's degree in economics, finance, mathematics or a related field.
• At least 2 years of previous experience in risk management, control and/or audit functions.
• Good knowledge and understanding of the Luxembourg investment fund industry and the UCITS regulatory framework.
• Ability to work independently, take initiative and manage priorities effectively.
• Fluency in English; proficiency in French or Italian would be an asset.

Who we are

FundSight is an independent third-party Management Company (ManCo) based in Luxembourg, regulated by the CSSF and holding a dual AIFM and UCITS license as well as a MiFID authorization. Its business has been licensed since 1971 and was carved out and wholly acquired (100%) by BlackFin in 2025; FundSight has since been an independent company, with no operational or capital ties to Lemanik. It has a center of excellence in Porto, a branch in Paris, and representative offices in Hong Kong and Tokyo. The Group is also established in New York and Atlanta. FundSight today supports more than 120 institutional clients and manages more than €40 billion in assets under management. For more information: www.fundsight.com.

How to apply

If you are interested in this opportunity and would like to develop your career in a young, dynamic and international environment, please submit your cover letter and detailed CV in English.
All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.

Before the employment agreement is signed, a copy of an official criminal record certificate (Bulletin No. 3), issued within the previous two months, must be provided for review.

title: Deal Advisory - Valuation Senior Analyst (m/f)

Deal Advisory - Valuation Senior Analyst
BDO Luxembourg is looking for Deal Advisory Valuation Senior Analyst!

Who are we?

BDO is present in over 169 countries and we offer an extensive range of services in the areas of Audit, Tax, Advisory, Accounting, Business Services and Outsourcing.

At BDO Luxembourg, our mission is to provide our clients with the expertise of our global network tailored to the unique needs of the Luxembourgish market, delivering personalized services and building valued relationships.

With over 700 employees representing more than 40 nationalities, we embrace diversity and encourage skills and people development among our employees.

Our main office is ideally located in the modern and rapidly expanding Cloche d'Or area. This dynamic area offers easy access to public transport, stores and park-and-ride facilities.

title: Depositary Specialist (m/f)
description:
The SEI Luxembourg team (“SEI Lux”) is seeking a Depositary Specialist. SEI Lux provides depositary services to Luxembourg domiciled funds ensuring that the funds are managed in compliance with regulatory requirements and funds' constitutional documents.

The Specialist will liaise with Investment Managers, Global Custodians, Prime Brokers, and Administrators on an ongoing basis. The individual must be self-motivated, goal orientated and can manage multiple tasks concurrently and within predetermined deadlines. This position reports to the Head of Depositary and is an opportunity for a suitable candidate to gain exposure to all areas of depositary and fund administration with a leading global service provider.

This position may be eligible to be performed in a hybrid fashion (in the office 3 or more days/week, and from a home office up to 2 days/week), within any applicable tax and social security limits for cross-border work.

What you will do:

The candidate will be required to work both independently and as part of a team to ensure that SEI and its clients are in full compliance with regulatory requirements.  Specific responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

• Prepare compliance and NAV reviews in accordance with the Depositary's policies and procedures.
• Perform and review cash-flow monitoring
• Perform asset verification checks
• Liaise with the global sub-custodians, administrator and prime brokers, as required  
• Meet deliverables and deadlines
• Participate in new fund launches
• Participate in annual due diligence oversight program of administrators, sub-custodians and AIFM and UCI managers
• Participate in internal audit reviews
• Ad-hoc tasks / projects as required
• Develop and maintain strong business relationship with colleagues
• Assist with training and development of analysts within the team
• Work collaboratively with colleagues within our Group

What we need from you:

• 5+ years' experience with depositary services in alternative investments/hedge funds, ideally with private equity/private debt
• Ability to independently manage multiple projects and deadlines to meet strict deadlines, prioritizing work and maximizing efficiencies to manage time
• Business Fluency in English
• P.C. proficiency, particularly with Microsoft Excel and Word.

What we would like from you:

• Third level qualification, preferably in Finance or related field
• Proven Oversight skills, including experience overseeing and monitoring delegates.
• Project management experience, including strong organizational and administrative skills
• Knowledge of Anti-Money Laundering requirements
• Initiative and ownership of assigned deliverables and responsibilities
• Excellent interpersonal and customer service skills
• Keen critical thinking, analysis and problem solving skills
• Fluency in foreign language (both written and verbal) an advantage
• Someone who will embody our SEI Values of courage, integrity, collaboration, inclusion, connection and fun.  Please see our website for more information.  https://www.seic.com/

About SEI® & SEI Lux:

SD-25168 - PHD POSITION IN ADVANCED CORRELATIVE MICROSCOPY AND ISOTOPIC IMAGING FOR NEXT-GENERATION LI-ION BATTERIES

Fixed term contract | Belvaux | up to 48 months (14 months initial contract)

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us.

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies, LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.


How will you contribute?

The PhD project will focus on the development of advanced correlative microscopy and isotopic imaging methodologies to investigate lithium transport and interfacial processes in next-generation silicon-based Li-ion battery electrodes.
The candidate will contribute to the development of high-throughput FIB-SIMS workflows, building on methodologies previously developed at LIST, and will adapt innovative sample preparation strategies to preserve the complex porous structure and fragile Solid Electrolyte Interphase (SEI).
A major objective of the PhD will be to develop and optimize advanced characterization approaches, including cryogenic sample preparation and analysis, protective capping and lift-out strategies, and automated high-resolution isotopic mapping.
The candidate will also contribute to the development of automated acquisition and data-processing workflows, enabling large-area, statistically representative 2D and 3D maps of lithium isotopes and SEI-related species.
These datasets will provide quantitative information on lithium distribution and transport at the nanoscale and serve as inputs for predictive modelling of battery behaviour.
The doctoral researcher will work closely with experienced scientists, engineers and international project partners in a highly interdisciplinary environment combining battery science, nano-analytics, instrumentation, software development and data science.
The position offers the opportunity to gain expertise in cutting-edge FIB-SIMS and correlative microscopy, electrochemical materials characterization, isotopic tracing, automated data analysis and scientific communication.
The candidate will take an active role in designing and performing experiments, developing analytical methodologies, interpreting results, publishing scientific findings and presenting the work at international conferences.

title: Higher Education & Careers Counsellor full-time (m/f)
description:
Description de tâches:


Want to help students shape what comes next?

At XXXX, we want every student to leave us with the self-knowledge, skills and confidence to make thoughtful choices about their future.

We are looking for an experienced Higher Education & Careers Counsellor to guide students in Grades 9–12 as they explore universities, careers and other post-secondary pathways around the world. You will help students connect their interests, strengths, values and learning experiences with future possibilities—developing the agency to make choices that are meaningful to them.
Working within our international and IB learning environment, you will help students connect the IB Learner Profile, Approaches to Learning (ATL) skills and their academic and wider experiences with life beyond XXXX. You will also guide students and families in understanding our three pathways: the full IB Diploma Programme, IB Courses and Global Impact Diploma (GID).


What will you do?

You will build trusting relationships with students and families and provide personalised, internationally minded guidance throughout the future-planning process.

• Coach students to reflect on their strengths, interests and aspirations and take ownership of their future choices.
• Deliver a coherent Higher Education & Careers programme across Grades 9–12, including individual and small-group guidance.
• Help students research and evaluate universities and other post-secondary opportunities around the world, alongside vocational education, gap experiences, entrepreneurship and employment.
• Guide students and families through international university admissions, with particular expertise in the US college and university application process.
• Support applications, including essays and personal statements, CVs/résumés, portfolios, interviews, recommendations and deadlines.
• Help students articulate who they are as learners and contributors by connecting their academic learning, IB Learner Profile attributes, ATL skills, CAS and community engagement with their future aspirations.
• Build relationships with universities, admissions professionals, alumni, employers and other partners internationally, and coordinate university fairs, visits and information events.
• Collaborate across the Upper School, including with the IB Diploma Programme and Global Impact Diploma teams, to connect academic choices, experiential learning, wellbeing and future pathways.
• Support relevant university admissions testing and maintain accurate, confidential student records.


What will you bring to XXXX?

Essential

• A Master's degree or equivalent in counselling, education, careers guidance or a relevant field.
• 5–8 years of successful experience in higher education/university counselling.
• Strong knowledge of international higher education and admissions systems and the ability to advise students about universities around the world.
• Experience with the IB Diploma Programme and knowledge of the US college and university application process.
• Strong counselling and coaching skills, with the ability to build trusting relationships with adolescents and families.
• Excellent communication, collaboration, organisation and attention to detail.
• The ability to work effectively within a culturally and linguistically diverse international community.
• Strong digital competence and confidence using higher education and careers platforms.
• Excellent written and spoken English.
• Professional discretion, sound ethical judgement and a strong commitment to safeguarding.


Valued experience

• Within an IB World School and with pathways beyond the full IB Diploma.
• Supporting applications across multiple countries and higher education systems.
• Working with platforms such as Unifrog, UCAS, Common Application and Studielink.
• Coordinating university fairs, admissions events or career-related learning.
• Supporting experiential, service or impact-based programmes such as the Global Impact Diploma.
• Supporting multilingual learners and students with diverse learning needs.
• Using French and/or German.
• Membership or qualifications in higher education, university admissions or careers counselling.


You'll thrive in this role if you...

...are a relationship builder and thoughtful listener who creates space for students to talk openly about their aspirations and uncertainties.
...believe in student agency and use coaching, questioning and reflection to help young people make their own informed decisions.
...are internationally minded, culturally responsive and open-minded, recognising that there is no single pathway or definition of future success.
...are an organised and collaborative professional who can make complex admissions processes understandable while managing multiple priorities and deadlines.
...remain curious and reflective, keeping your knowledge current as higher education, careers and the world of work continue to evolve.


Interested in joining our learning community?

At XXXX, future planning is about more than helping students decide where they will go next. It is about helping them understand who they are, what matters to them and how they can contribute.
As our Higher Education & Careers Counsellor, you will help students explore possibilities, navigate choices and develop the skills and confidence to shape their own futures.
XXXX is committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expects all staff to share this commitment.

title: IT Application Expert (m/f/x)
description:
Description de tâches:


For our department Application Management within General Services, we are looking for a (an):

IT Application Expert (m/f/x)

The IT Application Expert plays a crucial role in maintaining and enhancing the effectiveness of our application landscape. This individual serves as a key escalation point for the Service Desk and internal customers, addressing complex application-related support issues. The role involves continuous collaboration with IT stakeholders and vendors to manage application lifecycles, improve support processes, and contribute to IT service management (ITSM) knowledge.


Key responsibilities:

Serve as an advanced support contact for the Service Desk and internal customers, addressing application-related inquiries and issues.
Enhance the ITSM knowledge base with detailed application support processes and user-centric articles.
Oversee the lifecycle management of a designated application portfolio, including road-mapping, licensing, integration, user training, support, and upgrades.
Coordinate and participate in application upgrades, releases, and maintenance activities with internal IT teams and external vendors, including planned interventions outside normal working hours, typically after the last scheduled flight, to minimize operational disruption and ensure service continuity.
Proactively inform and advise business stakeholders on new application functionalities, utilizing established communication channels.
Collaborate with various IT teams and external vendors to define and establish necessary environments for testing and deploying new releases.
Engage in continuous improvement initiatives, developing and maintaining relevant guidelines and best practices.
Support on the creation of Business Impact assessments for the applications.
Participate in IT related projects, contributing expertise and insights.
Provide occasional administrative support within the activity scope, ensuring operational efficiency.
Uphold responsibility for ITIL process adherence and implementation within the domain.


Required profile:


Qualifications:

Possession of a Bachelor's degree in Information Technology or an equivalent blend of education and experience in a similar role.
Demonstrated ability to prioritize tasks effectively.
Methodical approach to analysis and documentation with a keen attention to detail.
Proven reliability and precision in work output.
Exemplary customer service orientation and ability to act as a role model in this capacity.
Proficiency in standard office software applications.
Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written.
Strong training delivery capabilities, tailored to diverse audiences.
Effective presentation skills.


Technical knowledge:

Ability to troubleshoot complex application issues using application logs, monitoring dashboards, event management tools, alerts, and performance metrics.
Working knowledge of relational databases and SQL to execute queries for data validation, incident investigation, troubleshooting, and reporting.
Understanding of application integrations, APIs (REST/SOAP), middleware, messaging, and data flows between enterprise systems.
Knowledge of networking and authentication concepts relevant to application support, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTPS, firewalls, Active Directory, LDAP, SSO, OAuth, and SAML.
Ability to analyze technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and system dependencies to support root cause analysis and issue resolution.
Software development skills are not required; however, the ability to understand technical concepts, communicate with technical teams and vendors, and participate in technical troubleshooting is essential.


Desired skills:

Ability to work collaboratively and independently within a team-oriented environment.
Eagerness to learn and apply new technologies.
Advanced communication skills, capable of engaging with all organizational levels and external parties.
Familiarity with departmental tools and applications.
Agility and flexibility in responding to new challenges and priorities.
Basic understanding of ITIL Framework principles.
Commitment to delivering results within agreed timeframes and maintaining data confidentiality.
Additional language skills are considered a valuable asset.


The IT Application Support Specialist in Luxair is a pivotal role aimed at enhancing our IT application services throughout our business lines. We are looking for a dedicated professional who demonstrates a passion for technology, a commitment to service excellence, and a deep understanding of application support dynamics. If you are seeking a challenging and rewarding career opportunity, we invite you to apply for this position.
