title: UTVECKLINGSANSVARIG FÖR HOTELL & VÄRDSKAP
description:
UTVECKLINGSANSVARIG FÖR HOTELL & VÄRDSKAP

Någonstans där ute finns du. Kanske har du erfarenhet från några av Sveriges främsta hotell och restauranger. Kanske har du arbetat internationellt inom hospitality eller varit en del av verksamheter där service, kvalitet och detaljer står i främsta fokus.

Nu vill du ta nästa steg och söker kanske en ny arbetsplats.

Ästad Vingård växer och söker nu personer som vill ta nästa steg i sina hotell- och restaurangkarriärer. För något år sedan tog vi över driften av Varbergs Kusthotell. Sedan en tid tillbaka driver vi bageriet Dan Bakstudio.

Framöver kommer det att bli fler verksamheter, men att växa är inte ett mål i sig. Målet är istället att skapa så bra gästupplevelser som möjligt, i en avslappnad nordisk kontext.

Vi söker därför dig med gedigen erfarenhet från daglig drift, som kan ditt område på djupet och nu vill använda din kunskap till att utveckla människor, arbetssätt och gästupplevelser i flera verksamheter.



Vi söker utvecklingsansvariga inom:

    Restaurang
    Housekeeping
    Hotell & värdskap



Rollerna är koncernövergripande och innebär att du arbetar med samtliga våra verksamheter. Ditt uppdrag är att utveckla hur vi arbetar inom ditt område och hjälpa verksamheterna att ta nästa steg.

Du arbetar nära de lokala teamen och platsansvariga, men framför allt nära den faktiska driften. Vi söker inte personer som vill utveckla verksamheter från ett skrivbord. Du ska vilja vara på plats, se vad som fungerar, förstå vad som kan bli bättre och tillsammans med teamen omsätta det i praktiken.



DITT NÄSTA STEG

Du kanske har arbetat länge som restaurangchef, hovmästare, hotellchef, housekeepingchef eller i en annan ledande roll inom hotell och restaurang. Du känner branschen, tycker fortfarande om den operativa delen och vet vad som krävs för att skapa riktigt bra gästupplevelser.

Samtidigt är du redo för något större.

Du behöver vara trygg i din erfarenhet, prestigelös i ditt sätt att arbeta och bra på att få människor med dig. Rollen handlar inte om att komma in och tala om för andra hur de ska göra, utan om att skapa utveckling tillsammans med dem som arbetar i verksamheten varje dag.

Som utvecklingsansvarig rör du dig mellan våra olika verksamheter. Periodvis innebär det resor och övernattningar några dagar i sträck, och resande är därför en naturlig och nödvändig del av tjänsten.

Du kommer också att vara delaktig när vi öppnar nya verksamheter och bidra med din erfarenhet från planering och uppstart till att arbetssätt och team fungerar när dörrarna öppnas.

Det här är en roll för dig som har gjort mycket inom ditt område, men fortfarande är nyfiken på hur det kan göras ännu bättre.

title: Contract Manager
employer: HOCHTIEF Infrastructure GmbH Tyskland Sverige     Filial
description:
Contract Manager

OL31 Rail Project, Vagnhärad, Sweden

Shape the future of Swedish infrastructure

HOCHTIEF is one of the world's leading infrastructure and construction groups, employing approximately 38,000 people worldwide. We deliver complex projects across a wide range of sectors, including roads, bridges, tunnels, railways, airports, ports, buildings, and both conventional and renewable energy. With operations across Europe, North America, and the Asia-Pacific region, HOCHTIEF combines engineering expertise with innovative and sustainable solutions to shape the infrastructure of the future.

We are currently looking for an Contract Manager / Senior Contract Engineer to join our team on the OL31 Project in Vagnhärad, Sweden.

The OL31 Project forms part of the Ostlänken programme, one of Sweden's largest and most important railway infrastructure investments. Ostlänken is a new approximately 160-kilometre double-track railway connecting Järna and Linköping, designed to increase capacity, improve regional connectivity and support sustainable transport across Sweden.

The project involves complex civil engineering works, extensive stakeholder coordination, demanding management of sophisticated procurement activities. Working on OL31 offers the opportunity to contribute to a landmark infrastructure programme that will have a lasting impact on Sweden's transport network and future development.

About the Role

As Contract Manager / Senior Contract Engineer, you will be responsible for overseeing the contractual aspects and requirements of the project throughout its lifecycle. You will play a key role in protecting the company's contractual interests, supporting project delivery, and ensuring compliance with client, subcontractor, and supplier agreements.

The position requires strong commercial awareness, excellent negotiation skills, and experience in managing contracts and contractual requirements within large-scale infrastructure or construction projects. You will work closely with project management, procurement, legal advisors, and operational teams to identify risks, manage claims, and ensure effective contract administration.

Key Responsibilities

    Manage and administer project contracts and contractual requirements throughout the project lifecycle.
    Review, interpret, and analyze contractual obligations, rights, and risks.
    Monitor compliance with contract requirements and project commitments.
    Identify contractual risks and develop mitigation strategies.
    Support project teams in contractual matters and provide guidance on contract interpretation.
    Manage correspondence related to contractual and requirement issues with clients, subcontractors, and suppliers.
    Prepare, review, and negotiate contract amendments, variations, and change orders.
    Support the preparation and assessment of claims, counterclaims, and dispute resolution processes.
    Maintain comprehensive contract records and documentation.
    Collaborate with procurement, commercial and legal teams during subcontractor and supplier engagements.
    Monitor key contractual milestones, notices, and deliverables.
    Participate in contract, requirement, commercial, and claims meetings and support strategic decision-making.
    Ensure contractual compliance with project requirements, company policies, and applicable regulations.



Your Profile

Requirements

    Degree in Law, Engineering, Construction Management, Quantity Surveying, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
    Minimum 7 years of experience in contract management, commercial management, or claims management within construction, infrastructure, or engineering projects.
    Experience working on large-scale infrastructure, civil engineering, railway, or industrial projects.
    Strong understanding of contract administration and commercial risk management.
    Experience with contract forms such as Design & Build, EPC, or similar contractual frameworks, especially AB04, ABT06, ABK09, ABU07, etc.
    Experience with AMA, MER, Swedish Construction Regulations and Standards, and Trafikverket’s Requirements such as TDOK, TMOL, etc.
    Strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
    Experience managing variations, claims, and dispute-related matters.
    Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
    Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary and international project teams.
    Proficiency in contract management and document control systems.
    Experience on Scandinavian infrastructure projects.
    Familiarity with Swedish construction law and contractual practices.
    Experience in claims preparation, administration, and negotiations.
    Understanding of procurement and subcontract management processes.
    Professional certifications related to contract or commercial management are considered an advantage.

Language Requirements

Fluency in English is required; Swedish and German language skills are highly desirable.

We Offer

    The opportunity to work on one of Sweden's largest and most complex infrastructure projects.
    An international working environment within a leading global construction company.
    Long-term project involvement with significant responsibility and influence.
    The chance to contribute to the development of critical rail infrastructure in Sweden.

Location

Vagnhärad, Sweden

Apply

If you have the qualifications, experience, and passion for creating a safe and successful construction environment, we would love to hear from you.

Get in touch with Nicole Granlund nicole.granlund@hochtief.se,

or apply directly at: https://hochtief.se/karriar/



Join HOCHTIEF and help build the infrastructure of tomorrow.

title: Geologist to Exploration department
description:
Step into a role where your curiosity meets purpose. Join our Field Exploration team and contribute to securing LKAB’s future in a workplace that values collaboration, innovation and long-term sustainability.

The sustainable transformation begins with us

We are facing our greatest challenge yet – ensuring that Sweden and Europe have what it takes to transform. So that we can live the lives we want, both today and tomorrow. In the same way that we strive to improve the future, we are committed to developing everyone who joins us on this journey, both personally and professionally.

Would you like to be part of laying the foundation for the way we live – and for the world around us?

Your role

We are now looking for geologists to our Field Exploration section in Malmberget and Kiruna. The Exploration department works to identify and investigate mineral deposits and secure LKAB’s future. Mineral resources and reserves are LKAB’s most important asset; therefore, our work is a prerequisite for a sustainable and long-term competitive LKAB.

As part of our team, you work in close collaboration with other geologists and technicians in an interesting workplace with challenging duties and good opportunities for further development.

For these roles the main tasks to start with will be collection and interpretation of geological data from field targets and drill core, with an expectation to grow into a geologist managing field projects.

The Field Exploration section is amongst other things responsible for:

    Delineating new exploration targets outside the current mining areas
    Executing field projects (field work, drilling)
    Drill core logging & sampling, including QAQC and validation of drill hole data
    Interpretation of a wide range of geological data and close collaboration with the geophysics group
    3D Modelling in Leapfrog

What you bring

We are looking for someone who is eager to apply their geological expertise while continuing to learn and grow. You enjoy collaborating in a multidisciplinary exploration team and understand how your contribution supports the success of each project. You are solution-oriented, responsible and committed to delivering high-quality work on time.

For this role, you should have:

    A university degree in geology (minimum B.Sc.)
    Practical experience in exploration is an advantage, but recent graduates are also encouraged to apply
    A valid driver’s license (equivalent to Swedish B driver’s license for manual transmission vehicles)
    Fluency in English, both spoken and written; Swedish is a plus, or a willingness to learn
    Knowledge of Fennoscandian geology, structural geology and working experience in the Arctic is a plus
    Proficiency in common softwares such as GIS, acQuire, ioGas and Leapfrog
    Strong collaboration skills and a responsible, flexible, and perceptive mindset

What we offer

In addition to the general benefits we offer — which you can find a bit further down — we can also offer the following to those who do not currently live in Sweden:

    Relocation support for you and your family.
    Excellent conditions for settling in. We guide you through the official procedures necessary to settle in the country if you come from outside Sweden. We also provide temporary accommodation for a reasonable period and help you find a permanent place to live according to your personal needs.
    LKAB helps you learn Swedish, a tool for a better understanding of Swedish culture.
    The Swedish vacation law entitles all employees to five weeks of vacation per year, and four consecutive weeks during June, July, or August. Your contract may include extra vacation days.

Additional information

We strive for a fair and objective recruitment process. Therefore, we usually do not request cover letters. Instead, we ask you to answer questions related to the specific position you are applying for. Your responses help us understand your skills and experience, so please take the time to answer as clearly and thoroughly as possible.

Start: According to agreement

Location: Kiruna, Gällivare (Malmberget)

Type of Employment: Permanent, full-time monday-friday

Contact: For more information about the position, please contact our hiring manager Laura Lauri Manager Field Exploration at laura.lauri@lkab.com. No CVs through email, please.

Please submit your application by date 15th November.

title: Social Sustainability Lead
description:
At Tetra Pak we commit to making food safe and available, everywhere; and we protect what's good – protecting food, protecting people, and protecting the planet. By doing so we touch millions of people's lives every day.

And we need people like you to make it happen.

We empower you to reach your potential with opportunities to make an impact to be proud of – for food, people and the planet.

Job Summary

An exciting opportunity opens within Corporate Sustainability. We are looking for a Social Sustainability Lead, who will have a key role in developing and implementing Tetra Pak's Social Sustainability Framework, anchored in our human rights due diligence process.



Tetra Pak commits to making food safe and available, everywhere. And we promise to protect what’s good: protecting food, people and the planet. Respecting human rights across our operations and value chain, by implementing the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights, is our means to deliver on this promise to protect people.



In Social Sustainability, we develop the human rights due diligence process, collaborating with multiple business areas and markets to assess risks to people across the value chain and to develop action plans to prevent and address issues. You will be one of Tetra Pak’s subject matter experts in business and human rights and contribute to the delivery of our integrated sustainability agenda.



The position is permanent, based in Lund, Sweden, or another Tetra Pak office, preferably in the EMEA time zone, and will include some travelling. You will be reporting to the Director, Circular Economy, Nature and Social Sustainability, in Corporate Sustainability.

What you will do

You will be part of the Tetra Pak central Corporate Sustainability organization, responsible for leading the development and deployment of the Social Sustainability Framework. As part of a newly established Circular Economy, Nature and Social Sustainability team, you will lead development of a robust human rights due diligence process to proactively identify and address risks to people across the value chain. You will be leading integration of social sustainability into our integrated sustainability approach in collaboration with colleagues across various business areas and markets, customers, suppliers and civil society stakeholders.

Focus areas:

•  Take the lead in developing and deploying Tetra Pak's Human Rights Due Diligence process in relevant business areas across the company and value chain.

•  Provide human rights expertise, insights and training to teams responsible for implementation of the human rights’ due diligence process.

•  Develop and deploy human rights risk assessment, action planning and KPI development.

•  Work with colleagues across Corporate Sustainability, Finance and Communications to inform reporting.

•  Build awareness and capacity to secure buy in and ownership of the Social Sustainability agenda in relevant functions, business areas and value chain.

•  Support stakeholders in mitigation and remedy of identified human rights issues.

•  Support the Sustainability Operations market teams in the global south in implementing human rights due diligence in informal waste collection sector and recycling of Liquid Packaging Cartons.

•  Undertake research on issues, contexts, suppliers, customers and other stakeholders' human rights processes and impacts in preparation for engagement on Social Sustainability challenges.

•  Develop relationships with external stakeholders that can support the implementation of Tetra Pak's Social Sustainability strategy.

We believe you have

•  A relevant university degree on Master level.

•  Minimum 5 years’ experience and knowledge in the implementation of the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights and/or specific human rights issues through your work in a business, consultancy, trade association, civil society organisation, Government or international institution.

•  Excellent written and verbal English skills are essential, since we operate on a global basis.

•  Track record of driving change and reaching targets in a multi stakeholder environment.

•  You are capable of working independently and of developing ideas, projects and tools.

•  You are good at building relationships with a variety of stakeholder groups across multiple geographies.

•  Desk and qualitative research skills will be important to you in this role, as will the ability to communicate complex ideas in clear, engaging and persuasive ways.



You will be motivated by the idea of strengthening the performance and resilience of Tetra Pak and its value chain through development and deployment of a strong social sustainability and human rights agenda.

We Offer You

    A variety of exciting challenges with ample opportunities for development and training in a truly global landscape
    A culture that pioneers a spirit of innovation where our industry experts drive visible results
    An equal opportunity employment experience that values diversity and inclusion
    Market competitive compensation and benefits with flexible working arrangements



Apply Now

If you are inspired to be part of our promise to protect what’s good; for food, people, and the planet, apply through our careers page at https://jobs.tetrapak.com/.

This job posting expires on 2026-11-02

title: Senior Accounting Consultant to bank
description:
Are you an experienced accounting expert with strong skills in regulatory reporting and IFRS within the banking sector? Are you ready for a high-impact consulting role in an international and highly regulated environment? If so, this might be your next opportunity!

About the position

Perido is looking for a Senior Accounting Consultant on behalf of our client, a major bank operating in an international environment. In this role, you will play a key part in financial and regulatory reporting activities, supporting both local and group reporting requirements.

The position is situated in the north of Stockholm with the possibility of working remotely two days a week.

Your daily tasks

As a Senior Accounting Consultant, you will operate in a dynamic, highly regulated financial environment and manage complex reporting processes with high accuracy.

Your key duties will include:

    Supporting and executing financial and regulatory reporting activities for both local and group requirements
    Managing reporting to the Swedish Financial Supervisory Authority (Finansinspektionen), the Riksbank, and Statistics Sweden (SCB)
    Applying IFRS standards practically within the banking environment
    Handling hedge accounting, including documentation, effectiveness testing, and ongoing reporting requirements
    Interpreting and implementing new regulatory and accounting requirements
    Managing accounting treatments for financial instruments and navigating complex group reporting and consolidation processes

Your characteristics

To succeed in this role, you are a self-motivated professional with strong analytical skills and a high commitment to accuracy and quality. You feel comfortable taking ownership of complex tasks independently while navigating an international, highly regulated group structure. You possess excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, allowing you to collaborate effectively across different teams and levels within the organization.

Are you the candidate we are looking for? We look forward to receiving your application! Please note we only accept applications in English!

Qualifications:

    Extensive experience in senior accounting and financial reporting roles within the banking sector
    Proven experience with regulatory reporting to Finansinspektionen
    Hands-on experience with reporting to the Riksbank and Statistics Sweden (SCB)
    Strong, practical knowledge of IFRS within a banking context
    Experience with hedge accounting (documentation, effectiveness testing, and reporting)
    Solid understanding of financial instruments and their accounting treatments
    Experience from an international group environment, including group reporting and consolidation processes
    Fluent in English (written and spoken

Meritorious:

    Experience supporting audits and interacting with external auditors
    Experience in regulatory change projects or implementing new reporting requirements
    Experience from dynamic and complex financial organizations

Contract type and hours

Full-time, consulting assignment until 2028-04-11. Start 2026-11-05.

Application

Please apply through our website at perido.se/lediga-jobb/. Simply click the "Apply" button in the job advertisement, fill in your details, and upload your CV. We recommend submitting your application as soon as possible, as the selection process is ongoing. Please note that some details about the assignment and/or client company may have been deliberately disclosed in the advertisement. If your profile matches what the client is looking for and you are contacted by a recruiter, you will receive all the information you need.

You can find answers to most questions or concerns at perido.se/vanliga-fragor/. If you still haven't found the answer you are looking for, you are most welcome to contact us at fraga@perido.se and one of our Recruitment Communicators will answer you. Always enter the reference number 36065 in the subject line. Please note that we only accept applications through our website and that we are unable to provide updates on your application status.

About Perido

Why is our company named Perido? The name comes from the Latin word Peridoneus, which means 'well-matched'. Perido is a consulting and recruitment company specializing in the white-collar sector, dedicated to helping you take the next step in your career. Our vision is to ensure that everyone thrives and feels engaged at work. We have grown steadily since our founding in 2003 and now have over 1,500 employees across the country, including around fifty internal staff at our headquarters in Stockholm and Gothenburg. As a Perido consultant, you’ll play a key role in our organization, growing alongside us while strengthening our clients' businesses with your skills. Please visit our website www.perido.se for more information.

title: CNC-Operatör
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. With cutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and construction equipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:  Vill du utvecklas inom CNC och bli en del av ett team där du får lära dig, utvecklas och successivt bredda din kompetens?

Bli en del av vårt team Välkommen till Hammarlinjen på Epiroc Drilling Tools. Här blir du en del av ett dedikerat skiftlag, som tillsammans strävar efter att upprätthålla en högkvalitativ produktion och en trygg arbetsmiljö.Vi lägger stor vikt vid inkluderande och mångfaldsfrämjande värderingar. Kommunikation, öppenhet, nytänkande och personligt ansvar är centrala delar i vår arbetskultur. Vi stöttar varandra i vårt gemensamma uppdrag – att skapa en säker, hållbar och effektiv produktion med fokus på kvalitet och ständiga förbättringar.



Ditt uppdrag I produktionen arbetar vi med avancerade CNC-maskiner, fina toleranser och montering. Din roll som CNC-operatör är att säkerställa ett effektivt produktionsflöde med hög kvalitet från början till slut. Du kommer producera i maskiner enligt ritningar/instruktioner och övervaka maskinerna för att se till att bearbetningen håller hög precision och kvalitet. Det ingår även underhåll av maskinerna som en viktig del av ditt arbete.



Din profil



Vi söker dig som trivs i en miljö där precision, problemlösning och samarbete är en naturlig del av vardagen. Du är noggrann, kvalitetsmedveten och trygg i att arbeta självständigt. Samtidigt uppskattar du att samarbeta med kollegor och bidra till ett öppet och hjälpsamt klimat. Du är engagerad, nyfiken och gillar att utveckla arbetssätt och metoder — alltid med säkerhet i fokus. Vi söker dig som har:




    En relevant utbildning inom området.
    Erfarenhet av CNC bearbetning.
    Goda kunskaper i ritningsläsning.
    Goda kunskaper i mätning och kontroll.
    Förmåga att fatta egna beslut i det dagliga arbetet.
    God samarbetsförmåga och kommunikation med andra funktioner.
    Truckkort är meriterande.



Placering och övrigt



Denna position är placerad i Fagersta. Arbetstiderna är kontinuerligt 2-skift.







Livet på Epiroc När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter.



Förutom att vi har en kultur som kännetecknas av utveckling i kombination med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, finns det några saker som gör oss lite extra stolta över att arbeta på Epiroc:




    Globala karriärmöjligheter.
    Epiroc University, för din egen kompetensutveckling.
    Samhällsengagemang.
    Förmånspaket, som bland annat inkluderar flexibel arbetstid och bonus.  



En hybrid arbetsplatsLivet på Epiroc kan innehålla möjligheten till en hybrid arbetsplats. Det är ett arbetssätt som erbjuder flexibilitet och delaktighet som möjliggör en bättre balans mellan arbete och privatliv, vilket också främjar välbefinnande. Det hybrida arbetssättet är en möjlighet om arbetet tillåter, utifrån din roll, ditt ansvar och dina individuella förutsättningar.



Ansökan och kontaktinformationVi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt, men senast den 2 November 2026. Ansökningar granskas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum



Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter.



För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta: Anställande chef, Stefan Jakobsson, stefan.jakobsson@epiroc.com. Rekryteringsspecialist, Susanne Kjellman, susanne.kjellman@external.epiroc.com







Vänligen observera att vi på grund av rådande regelverk inte kan hantera ansökningar som skickas in via e-post.

title: Tendering Engineer to a global company in Ludvika!
description:
About our client

Our client, who is a global and world leading company within their domain, strongly believes in the long-term sustainability of HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) technology. This technology facilitates energy transfer with direct current at high voltages, making it suitable for transmitting energy over long distances and connecting electricity networks with minimal losses. In addition to energy transfer, HVDC technology addresses electricity quality issues and contributes to the stabilization of connected power grids. For offshore wind power or long-distance underwater transmissions, direct current is the most realistic energy transmission alternative.

About the role

We are looking for an experienced and driven Tender Engineer to join our client's HVDC organization in Ludvika. In this role, you will play an important part in developing competitive technical proposals for complex HVDC and power transmission projects, contributing to the development and modernization of power grids worldwide.

As a Tender Engineer, you will be part of a dedicated tendering team of approximately ten colleagues, working closely with engineering, project management, supply chain and commercial functions. Your main focus will be to analyze customer requirements, evaluate technical solutions and prepare accurate and competitive tenders that meet both technical and commercial expectations.

The role combines technical expertise with coordination, problem-solving and communication. You will work in an international environment where English is the primary working language, while being based on-site in Ludvika alongside your team.

Key responsibilities

    

Review customer specifications and technical requirements to prepare accurate and competitive tenders

    

Develop technical proposals and quotations for HVDC and power transmission projects

    

Evaluate technical solutions and identify potential risks and opportunities

    

Collaborate with engineering, project management and commercial teams throughout the tendering process

    

Provide technical input for cost estimates, project planning and proposals

    

Prepare and review technical documentation for tenders

    

Participate in technical discussions with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders

Who are you?

We are looking for a technically skilled and self-driven engineer who enjoys combining analytical work with collaboration and communication. You have a solid background in electrical engineering, power systems or a related technical field, and feel confident interpreting technical specifications and translating complex requirements into practical solutions.

To succeed in this role, you are structured, analytical and comfortable taking ownership of your work. You have a proactive mindset, strong communication skills and enjoy working closely with colleagues across different disciplines in an international environment.

We are looking for someone who has:

    

At least 5 years of experience working as a Tender Engineer or in a similar role, with proven hands-on experience in technical tendering and proposal development

    

A technical educational background, preferably in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience

    

Good understanding of electrical power systems, power transmission or energy infrastructure

    

Experience reviewing and understanding technical specifications, engineering documents and customer requirements

    

Excellent communication skills and fluency in English, both written and spoken

It is considered an advantage if you also have:

    

Experience with HVDC, FACTS, STATCOM or similar power systems

    

Experience in technical project execution or customer-facing engineering roles

    

Experience working in international engineering projects

    

Swedish language skills

Practical information

Location: Ludvika, Sweden

Scope: Full-time

Start date: As agreed

A-hub is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse working environment. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.

By submitting your application for this job, you are consenting to A-hub using your personal information in accordance with our GDPR compliance policy.

title: Researcher
description:
Department of Forest Resource Management

We are looking for a person with expertise in remote sensing and data-driven approaches to forest ecosystems and biodiversity monitoring. Are you the person we are looking for to apply and develop methods for large-scale species and habitat mapping and contribute to European biodiversity assessments?

About the position

You will work with developing and applying remote sensing and data-driven methods for large-scale biodiversity and ecosystem monitoring. Your work will involve integrating forest disturbance information into forest structure Essential Biodiversity Variables and combining these with environmental and biodiversity data to produce pan-European species distribution and habitat maps. You will apply machine-learning methods with uncertainty estimation and validate the results using systematic biodiversity observation networks, spatial cross-validation, and independent national and regional datasets. You will also contribute to assessing species and habitat status, identifying high nature value forests and degraded habitats, and prioritising areas for conservation and restoration. Through this work, you will contribute to the development of scalable biodiversity monitoring and integrated European biodiversity assessments.

Your profile

We are looking for a researcher with expertise in forest remote sensing, forest disturbance dynamics, and landscape-scale ecological analysis.

Requirements:

    A doctoral degree in forest science, ecology, remote sensing, environmental science, or a related field.
    Expertise in forest remote sensing and forest ecosystem analysis.
    Experience working with satellite time series and remote sensing data.
    Experience integrating multispectral, LiDAR, and field data.
    Experience applying machine-learning methods to forest ecosystems, including species and habitat mapping.
    Ability to integrate remote sensing information into biodiversity indicators and monitoring frameworks.
    Experience with large-scale species and habitat mapping, uncertainty estimation, and validation using independent datasets.

Meritorious:

    A strong scientific publication record.
    Postdoctoral experience in a field relevant to the position
    Experience with biodiversity monitoring and ecological assessment.
    Experience in teaching and supervision.
    Experience of collaborative and interdisciplinary research.
    Experience working with large-scale or continental-scale environmental datasets.

About us

The Department of Forest Resource Management conducts education and research in the areas of forest planning, forest remote sensing, forest inventory and sampling, forest mathematical statistics and landscape studies. The department is also responsible for the implementation of the ongoing environmental monitoring programs the National Forest Inventory, National Inventory of the Landscape in Sweden, Terrestrial Habitat Monitoring and the Butterfly and Bumblebee Inventory. In total, we are about 120 employees.

For more information about the department or division visit: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/forest-resource-management/

Read more about our benefits and working at SLU by visiting: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/

Location:

Umeå

Form of employment:

Indefinite-term employment. SLU may use probationary employment.

Scope:

100%

Start date:

As agreed.

Application:

Please submit your application before deadline 2 November 2026. You can submit your application by clicking the button below.

Union representatives:

https://internt.slu.se/en/my-employment/employee-associations/kontaktpersoner-vid-rekrytering/





The Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences (SLU) has a key role in the development for sustainable life, based on science and education. Through our focus on the interaction between humans, animals and ecosystems and the responsible use of natural resources, we contribute to sustainable societal development and good living conditions on our planet. Our main campuses are located in Alnarp, Umeå and Uppsala, however, the university also operates at research stations, experimental forests and teaching sites throughout Sweden. SLU has around 4,000 employees, 6,000 students and doctoral students and a turnover of over SEK 4,5 billion. We are investing in attractive environments on all of our campuses. We strive to provide a work environment characterised by inclusivity and gender equality, where different experiences generate conversations between people and pave the way for science, creativity and development. Therefore, we welcome applications from people with diverse backgrounds and perspectives.

title: Personalansvarig Housekeeping Stockholm
description:
Personalansvarig Hotell – RA Hospitality, StockholmHar du haft ledande roller inom hotellverksamhet och är redo för nästa steg i karriären?

Du vet vad som krävs för att skapa kvalitet, leda medarbetare och få ett hotell att fungera – även när tempot är som högst. Nu har du möjlighet att använda din erfarenhet på ett nytt sätt.

Hos RA Hospitality får du fortsätta arbeta nära hotellbranschen, men i en roll där du utvecklar både människor och affärer. Här bygger du långsiktiga kundrelationer, leder våra konsulter och hjälper några av Sveriges främsta hotell att lyckas.

Om RA Hospitality

RA Hospitality är en av Nordens ledande specialister på bemanning, rekrytering, entreprenad och utbildning inom besöksnäringen. I över 25 år har vi hjälpt hotell, restauranger och andra verksamheter att hitta rätt kompetens. Med kontor i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Oslo och Bergen kombinerar vi branschkunskap med ett starkt engagemang för människor, kvalitet och långsiktiga relationer.

Om rollen

Du leder den dagliga driften, utvecklar kundrelationer och säkerställer hög kvalitet i våra leveranser.

stort eget ansvar och korta beslutsvägar

title: Solution Architect
description:
At Seco, we’re looking for a Solution Architect with a strong domain focus who connects business needs with scalable, secure, and future-ready technology solutions. In this position, you play a key role in shaping architecture within a specific business domain and ensuring that technology investments support strategic goals, operational excellence, and long-term growth.

About the job

As a Solution Architect, you design and guide the implementation of technology solutions within a dedicated business domain. Acting as a bridge between business stakeholders and IT, you translate strategic direction and business requirements into practical solution designs that align with enterprise architecture principles, technical standards, and business objectives. You report to the Director CIO Office.  

Job responsibilities

    Build a strong understanding of your assigned business domain and translating business requirements into scalable, reusable technology solutions.
    Define architecture visions, roadmaps, and high-level solution designs that support both current and future business needs.
    Evaluate applications, technologies, and solution alternatives to ensure the best fit for business requirements.
    Provide architectural guidance to development teams and ensure alignment with enterprise standards and best practices.
    Create and maintain architectural documentation, including blueprints, integration plans, and technology roadmaps.
    Support delivery teams, ensuring compliance with security, data, and governance requirements while managing risks and technical debt.

Location

While Fagersta is the primary location for this position, we’re open to candidates based in other locations across Sweden.

Your profile

You bring a combination of business understanding, architectural expertise, and strong stakeholder management skills. With experience from complex technology environments, you enjoy translating business challenges into practical and sustainable solutions while collaborating across organizational boundaries.

Your background includes:

    Experience working with architectural frameworks, such as TOGAF.
    Knowledge of cloud platforms, including Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud.
    Understanding of architecture domains such as integration, data, network, and security.
    Experience translating complex business requirements into solution designs and architectural blueprints.
    Familiarity with Agile and DevOps ways of working.

Experience with domain-driven design, product-centric organizations, enterprise architecture frameworks, cloud certifications, or domain-specific platforms such as ERP, CRM, or data platforms is considered an advantage.

Success in this position comes from combining strong analytical thinking with collaboration and communication. You’re comfortable navigating complex environments, building relationships across functions, and explaining technical concepts to a variety of audiences. A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and a drive to continuously improve help you create lasting impact.

Our Seco culture

At Seco, we're united by a spirit of collaboration and a shared curiosity to learn and grow. We take responsibility for our actions, stay focused on our customers, and believe in winning together. For us, it’s also clear that our diversities form an amazing foundation for achieving great results. Curious about our workplace and benefits? Read more on our website. You’re also welcome to visit our LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us and our products further.

title: Game Client Framework Developer
description:
About us

Hacksaw Studios is a Stockholm-based game studio focused on creating innovative, high-quality gaming experiences. With a focus on performance and precision, we bring ideas to life through technical expertise and creative collaboration. We have wide distribution, and our games are played by millions of people every month by players all over the world.

We’re now expanding our tech team and looking for skilled Framework Developers who want to help us build and refine the foundation that powers our games.

The Role

As a Framework Developer at Hacksaw Studios, you’ll work together with our game development teams to deliver the features and tools they rely on. The work includes both building new functionality and maintaining, refining and optimising existing code. You'll think holistically about each feature you implement, how it impacts long term developer productivity, usability and performance across memory, GPU and CPU.

The framework team is also responsible for areas such as CI pipelines, end-to-end tests and build scripts (including asset optimization and more). Depending on your interests and skillset there is a wide range of technologies you can dive into. We keep meetings to a minimum and there is a lot of freedom and responsibility in prioritising tasks and defining scopes, perfect for someone who communicates well, enjoys finding the right solution and likes having focused time to get things done.

Your key responsibilities include:

    Develop and maintain features, tools, and systems used by our game teams.
    Improve performance, usability, and reliability across our framework.
    Considering long-term implications of implmentations, including developer experience, usability and performance.
    Collaborate with developers and designers to identify and solve technical challenges.
    Participate in reviews and provide feedback on code and implementation.

What We’re Looking For:

    Experience with one or more programming languages suited for game development, such as C#, C++, TypeScript or Haxe.
    Experience with different game development frameworks with some understanding of their structure and how to handle rendering. Ideally with games targeting web.
    A proactive mindset with strong communication skills and a sense of ownership.

Nice-to-have:

    Experience developing modules used by other developers.
    Interest in performance optimization.
    Our tech stack includes git, TypeScript, Linux, bash, Bun, Docker, Cucumber, GitLab and AWS. Familiarity with any of those tools are beneficial but not required.
    A personal interest in games and an understanding of the gaming industry.

What We Offer

    A modern office in central Stockholm.
    Work with experienced, passionate colleagues in the gaming industry.
    The opportunity to create games with a global audience.
    Real influence, ownership, and personal growth opportunities.
    Wellbeing perks including wellness allowance and regular in-office massage.

Practical Details

    Unfortunately, we cannot assist with relocation or visa sponsorship.

Ready to Join the Game Makers?

Apply now! We review applications on a rolling basis.

title: Senior Client Platform Developer

What We Offer

    A modern office in central Stockholm.
    Work with experienced, passionate colleagues in the gaming industry.
    The opportunity to create games with a global audience.
    Real influence, ownership, and personal growth opportunities.
    Wellbeing perks including wellness allowance and regular in-office massage.

title: After Sales Contract Manager
description:
Make an impact in the renewable energy industry by combining commercial expertise with strong customer engagement. We are looking for a results-driven After Sales Contract Manager to join our team, preferably based in Malmö, where you will take ownership of negotiating, developing, and managing service agreements that create long-term value for both our customers and our business.

If you thrive in a commercial environment and are passionate about renewable energy, this could be the perfect opportunity for you.



Your role

As an After Sales Contract Manager you will play a crucial role in ensuring that all wind farms have a valid and profitable O&M contract during the operation period (negotiating new contract or adjustments for existing wind farms).  

You will work closely with our clients, After Sales Managers, Sales Managers and various internal teams to ensure contracts are negotiated and customer satisfaction is achieved. The mission is to ensure that customers continue to have ENERCON as the first choice partner for all operation and maintenance activities of wind turbines.



Your responsibilities

    Independently preparing service contract quotations for wind turbines, medium-voltage substations and transformer stations – including renegotiations, renewals, supplementary agreements, contract takeovers, and selected services and products
    Carrying out calculations using pricing tools
    Independently maintaining lists and systems, as well as monitoring defined KPIs (SAP, HCL Notes, DocuSign)
    Processing customer tenders for service contract portfolios
    Acting as a subject matter expert and first point of contact in the area of service contracts (sales support, after-sales managers, service, legal department, etc.)
    Commercial review of calculations
    Processing of service contract terminations, including review and confirmation



Your profile

    Experience and track record of successfully managing contracts within the renewable energy sector, preferably wind industry.
    Strong communication and negotiation skills, not only securing favorable terms but also maintaining positive relationships with partners, clients, and stakeholders.
    Ability to identify additional revenue opportunities in contracts as well as identifying potential issues or risks and developing strategies to mitigate them.
    Capable of taking ownership of projects, making decisions independently and managing workload effectively.



Other desired qualifications include:

    Bachelor degree in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Economics or a comparable qualification
    High level of internal motivation
    High organizational and problem solving skills
    Able to work in Swedish and English language (C2 equivalent)



Our Offer

At ENERCON, you will join an innovative company and a dedicated team working to drive the renewable energy transition. We support your professional development through training and growth opportunities, while offering flexible working hours and the possibility to partly work from home. We also provide competitive benefits, including a wellness allowance, company discounts and fitness membership schemes (depending on location).



Application

We review applications on an ongoing basis and therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact Team Lead After Sales COE Alexander Daynes at alexander.daynes@enercon.de.



About ENERCON

The Earth has unlimited resources in the form of sun, wind, and water. One of the most responsible tasks of our time is to harness these resources on a large scale, and we have embraced this challenge.

ENERCON is one of the world's leading wind energy companies. Dedicated employees and customers have contributed to ENERCON’s global success, with production facilities on multiple continents and market representation in more than 40 countries. Our Global Headquarters is located in northern Germany with Swedish and Nordics headquarters in Malmö, Sweden.

For more information, please visit: http://www.enercon.de/en.

Please note that due to the summer holiday period, there may be a longer response time during the recruitment process. We appreciate your patience and look forward to receiving your application.

title: Total Rewards Analyst
description:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $100M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

    We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
    

    We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
    We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

The role

As Total Rewards Analyst, you'll be the analytical backbone of Legora's reward function — turning data into insight across compensation, equity, benefits, and mobility. You'll work directly within the Total Rewards team, reporting to the VP of Total Rewards, and collaborate closely with the Total Rewards Manager.

This is a role for someone who is energised by making sense of complex data, building robust processes, and making sure every part of our reward engine runs smoothly and accurately.

What you will do

    Build and maintain reward reporting and dashboards covering compensation, equity, benefits, and mobility — enabling the team and leadership to make data-informed decisions.
    

    Support compensation benchmarking cycles: gather and clean market data, model scenarios, and present findings clearly.
    Analyse equity data to track grant activity, vesting milestones, and programme performance across regions.
    Build and improve People operations processes across the reward function — creating workflows and documentation that reduce manual effort and increase accuracy.
    Support the administration of benefits programmes across markets, coordinating with external vendors and ensuring data accuracy.
    Support the mobility programme operationally — coordinating documentation, timelines, and third-party providers.
    Help prepare materials for employee and manager communications on compensation, benefits, and equity topics, and contribute to reward-related compliance activities as needed.

Who you are

You love digging into data to find patterns and build clarity out of complexity. You're a natural problem-solver with a keen eye for process, accuracy, and making things run better.

We think you'll thrive here if you have:

    3+ years of experience in a People, Reward, Finance, or Operations analyst role — ideally in a high-growth or international environment.
    

    Strong analytical skills with experience handling complex datasets; proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets is essential, and experience with HRIS or reward tools is a plus.
    Familiarity with compensation frameworks, equity programmes, or benefits administration — even if not a specialist in all areas.
    High attention to detail and comfort working with sensitive, confidential data.
    A process-builder mindset: you don't just do the work, you look for ways to make the work better.
    Clear and confident communicator, able to present data and findings simply to a range of stakeholders.

Why Legora

This is an exceptional opportunity to grow within a reward function that's building from the ground up. You'll gain broad exposure across every dimension of total rewards — compensation, equity, benefits, and mobility — while working alongside experienced people leaders in a company with real momentum.

We value clarity, humility, and impact. Your work will directly support the team that shapes how every Legora employee is rewarded. We're just getting started.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Postdoctoral researcher in aerosol emissions from streams
description:
Department of Forest Ecology and Management  

Scientific background

Atmospheric aerosols are microscopic particles that influence weather and climate, contribute to biogeochemical cycling, and facilitate the dispersal of organisms. Aquatic systems can release aerosols into the atmosphere through processes such as bubble bursting, which have been studied extensively in oceans. However, whether and how these processes operate in streams remains poorly understood.

Streams differ from oceans in their hydrodynamics and water chemistry, potentially affecting how particles are captured by bubbles and potentially transferred to the atmosphere. Recent observations suggest that streams contain ice-nucleating particles that could become airborne, raising the possibility that boreal streams represent an overlooked source of atmospheric aerosols. The magnitude of these emissions, the mechanisms driving them, and the environmental factors controlling them remain largely unknown

About the position  

The postdoctoral researcher will investigate the hypothesis that streams emit aerosols to the atmosphere and identify the mechanisms and environmental conditions governing these emissions. A central task will be to develop a flux chamber to capture aerosols emitted from stream surfaces and quantify aerosol fluxes using online particle counters and air filtration for laboratory measurements of ice-nucleating particles. The chamber is planned to be deployed in both controlled experiments and field studies in natural boreal streams. The job also includes water sampling and measurements of physicochemical water and bubble properties.

The postdoctoral researcher will contribute to experimental design, data collection and analysis, manuscript preparation, scientific publication, and other forms of research communication. The position will be supervised by Associate Professor Marcus Klaus.

The successful candidate will be expected to work independently while collaborating closely with other members of the research team and external partners. The research environment will provide opportunities to develop scientific expertise, establish collaborations, and strengthen the candidate's professional development and academic career prospects.

Your profile

We are seeking a motivated and dedicated researcher with expertise at the interface of aquatic and atmospheric sciences and a strong interest in air–water exchange processes. Applicants must hold a PhD in atmospheric sciences, aquatic sciences, physics, environmental engineering, or a related discipline.

The applicant must have demonstrated experience in measurements of aerosols, suspended particles and/or air-water mass exchange (particles or gases) and experience conducting laboratory and/or fieldwork in aquatic and/or atmospheric systems. title: Senior Authorised Person | Sweden
description:

    To build your career by assisting in the delivery of ‘leading edge’ engineering projects.

About Kirby Group Engineering

Kirby Group Engineering is an international multi-disciplinary engineering services contractor and leading provider of high-value engineering services to a number of ‘blue chip’ companies. Operating across Ireland, the UK, Europe and South Africa, Kirby has become the engineering service provider of choice in growth segments such as pharmaceuticals, data centres and power transmission and distribution. Our culture is innovative, collaborative and performance focused. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow and develop in a company committed to developing talent and rewarding performance.

The Role

An exciting opportunity for a Senior Authorised Person has arisen for an energetic individual who would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment.  

Key Responsibilities:

    Engages from early in the project with Site Management team with the agreed Electrical Safe Systems of Work Procedure.
    Structured mentoring / Workshops with the testing & commissioning technicians in line with an agreed Commissioning plan with the Project manager.
    Ensures all Workplace personnel are aware of and are complying with the Electrical Safe Systems of Work.
    Issues and controls Permits for all Energised working activities under scope of work.

    To review and understand project specifications and drawings fully and extract the project specific requirements.

    Identifying and ensuring all the correct test equipment is available and calibrated for use.

Essential

    Electrical Trade Background with min 5 years’ experience.
    Excellent Understanding & Interpretation of Project Specifications, Drawings, SLD’s, Cable Solutions and Data Sheets.
    Excellent understanding of earthing arrangements and configurations.
    Excellent understanding of Busbar, busway systems including interlocking of secondary energy sources.

    Good Knowledge of FAT/SAT reporting for all Electrical Switchgear philosophy.
    Appreciation of Switchgear forms and separations and Type Testing.
    Good Knowledge of National Electrical Regulations
    Good Knowledge of control systems – Scada/BMS/EMS etc
    Good Knowledge of narrating LV/MV switching plans.
    Ability to Carry out switching and Isolating of Medium Voltage Systems.
    Mission Critical project experience / knowledge.
    Excellent Microsoft Office skills and Communication skills.
    Ability to integrate with specialist contractors for energisation of partial systems.
    Commissioning experience of Electrical systems/backup systems.
    Experience working on Live systems and managing energisation / start-up of Systems.
    Good Knowledge and understanding of control philosophies and switchgear systems.

To be considered you will:

Have:

    5+ Years’ experience in a similar role within an electrical contracting environment
    Relevant Level 8 Degree or an electrical trade with relevant training and experience
    Relevant experience in Commercial, Industrial, pharma, data centre type projects.
    Commercial Awareness
    The ability to multi-task and manage many priorities
    Experience with an M&E contractor in an Energy Marshall Role.
    Database / MS SharePoint experience, other database software.
    Experience of working on MV/HV systems. ‘Authorised Person’ experience.
    Electrical Testing & Verification with min 3 years’ experience.
    Construction experience / understanding required. Safety experience.

Be:

    Excellent communicator/strong interpersonal skills/communicates with impact
    Excellent record keeper and administration skills
    Drives for results
    Leads and influences others.
    Identifies and achieves commercial value.
    Innovates and leads in mechanical/technical activity and challenges.
    Plans and effectively manages projects.
    Solves problems analytically and acts decisively
    Is process driven and focuses on EHS and Quality Work Management Systems and Processes

The Opportunity

To build your career by assisting in the delivery of ‘leading edge’ engineering projects. To work with a vibrant, agile and multi-functional team in delivering projects on time, safely, to budget and to the required quality standards. To benefit from Kirby’s Career Development Programmes that will enhance your leadership capability. To work with the best.

For more information on this role, or other Construction / Engineering opportunities across Ireland, the UK, Europe, or South Africa please review our careers page (Vacancies – Kirby Group Careers) or contact the Talent Acquisition Team at Kirby Group in confidence on +353 (0)1 454 0411.

title: Area Sales Manager to ABB Motion
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

We are now looking for an Area Sales Manager to join our Motors and Generators sales team in Västerås. In this role, you’ll be part of our global sales team, working closely with assigned customers, markets, and applications. You are responsible for 2-3 countries and have your own sales budget. You are mainly working with offers in a technical context but still with commercial responsibility.

Key responsibilities include:

    Building strong relationships with customers and end users to secure orders and increase sales volume.
    Driving local sales team performance and Conduct market analysis and actively shape how we manage and develop customer leads.
    Preparing and negotiating both technical and commercial offers, contracts, and agreements.
    Developing sales strategies and marketing initiatives for your customers in assigned areas.

You will play a key role in promoting ABB’s large synchronous motors and generators, showcasing customer value and services, and driving market growth in collaboration with our global colleagues. The role is based in Västerås, Sweden.

Qualifications for the Role

    At least 5 years of experience in technical B2B sales, technical project management, or technical sales support.
    A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field.
    A collaborative mindset, with the ability to build strong relationships across teams and cultures.
    A structured, proactive, and flexible approach to your work, with a strong sense of responsibility.
    A customer-focused attitude and a willingness to travel as part of a global role.
    Fluent in English, both written and spoken. Swedish is a plus.

What’s in it for you?

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

More about us

ABB Motion High Power (MOHP) Division offers a comprehensive product portfolio of large AC motors and generators. From general purpose to highly customized designs, synchronous motors provide high efficiency, reliability and availability across all major industries and applications, including some in the toughest and most demanding environments. The division also has a long track record of designing and building generators for wide range of industries, including power generation, marine, oil and gas, mining, and data centers.

As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest. Syngenta has been ranked as a top employer by Science Magazine and it has been awarded with the -Friendly Work Space- label to all its Swiss sites.

Partner with FF&P manufacturing leaders to identify and build the capabilities required to drive transformation and optimize cost efficiency, innovation, quality, and production performance (processes, systems, and people). Ensure strong focus on execution, design, efficiency, and agility.

-Implement SPS aligned to strategy: Deliver successful implementation of the Syngenta Production System in line with the Global FF&P Manufacturing strategy, balancing site/customer requirements with SPS standards to support performance across sites.
-Deploy Manufacturing Excellence strategy: Translate business strategy into site Manufacturing Excellence roadmaps; build the capabilities needed to transform process, systems, and people, with focus on execution, design, efficiency, and agility.
-Drive long-term production performance: Partner with site leaders to deliver long-term production plans that improve availability, capacity, reliability, and cost efficiency.
-Deliver customer-focused outcomes: Collaborate with customers and site stakeholders to ensure reliable, cost-effective delivery and measurable operational impact.
-Lead and manage a globally distributed team of professionals
-Build a culture of excellence: Foster and role-model a Manufacturing Excellence mindset, acting as a trusted advisor to strengthen capabilities, improve performance, and mobilize sustainable change.
-Lead change and continuous improvement: Promote a change-management mindset grounded in continuous improvement; coach teams and individuals to embed new ways of working and accelerate adoption.
-Standardize and optimize operations: Oversee standard practices, capacity planning, and resource allocation; deploy change initiatives across sites to amplify performance and cost efficiency.
-Ensure tool/process discipline: Ensure consistent use of SPS tools and processes to optimize implementation, maintain smooth operations, and improve productivity, quality, and profitability.
-Develop talent and capabilities: Build the manufacturing talent pipeline and functional capabilities; role-model coaching and mentoring, and promote timely, constructive feedback.

Qualifications
-5+ years of experience in a relevant scientific or engineering field (e.g., production performance, Lean leadership), with demonstrated manufacturing experience.
-BS/MS in Industrial Engineering, Engineering, or Chemical Sciences (or a 5-year technical degree in a related discipline).

-Track record leading teams and building manufacturing capability.

-Functional expertise in production performance, maintenance, and Lean leadership.
-Information management: interpret, analyze, and present complex/conflicting data.
-Communication: strong listening; clear messaging; sound judgment in complex situations.
-Credibility & trust-building across all levels; able to remove blockers.
-Stakeholder influencing: drive alignment with Site Leadership Teams and key stakeholders.
-Fluent English; additional language a plus.
-Ability and flexibility to travel frequently, as the role may require travel up to 50% of the time

-A position that contributes to valuable and impactful work in a stimulating and international environment
-A superb working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce where new ideas are always welcome
-The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced colleagues to grow in scientific and technical excellence

Assistant/e de qualité et de processus
=======================================

**Avec son offre unique de prestations – prévention, assurance, réadaptation, la Suva propose à ses assurés une protection globale de la santé.** La mission principale des Cliniques Suva est la réadaptation des personnes accidentées. Outre les disciplines traditionnelles de la réadaptation neurologique et de l’appareil locomoteur, nos deux cliniques à Sion (CRR) et à Bellikon (RKB) offrent des prestations spécifiques pour la réadaptation des patients brûlés, l’orthopédie technique et la réadaptation professionnelle, la réadaptation précoces, des patients para/tétraplégiques.

Nous recherchons notre futur·e :

**Principales missions**

* Gestion administrative pour les deux cliniques en çais et en :
* Gestion des documents
* Gestion et surveillance des retours de clients, messages CIRS, etc.
* Support à la documentation des mesures d’amélioration et correctives
* Organisation des évaluations de satisfaction (patients, envoyeurs) et d’audits internes et externes
* Documentation des audits, cercles de qualité, groupes d’analyse des incidents, etc.
* Assistance aux contrôles de risques
* Gestion et analyse de statistiques
* Support à l’introduction des .s au management de qualité et des processus
* Support à l’élaboration et mise en œuvre de concepts relatifs à la qualité et de mesures d’amélioration avec les secteurs spécialisés (convention de qualité selon l’art. 58a LAMal)
* Support à la mise en œuvre et contrôle des prescriptions et normes de qualité internes et externes (p. ex. ANQ, Hplus)
* Collaboration aux projets (par ex. harmonisation du système de management)


**Nos attentes**

* Formation de base en administration et/ou dans une profession de santé
* Cours tels que gestionnaire de qualité dans le secteur sanitaire, gestionnaire de qualité et des processus, etc.
* Expérience dans le management de qualité, idéalement dans le secteur sanitaire
* Capacité d’organiser et de structurer
* Esprit et action en réseau alliés à la capacité de collaborer avec des personnes provenant de différents groupes professionnels / partenaires
* Capacité de communiquer oralement et par écrit en fonction de l’orientation services
* Aptitude à s’imposer
* Très bonnes connaissances des produits et applications MS Office et des systèmes de management intégrés (IMS)
* **Obligatoire :** Connaissance du français au niveau de la langue maternelle ainsi que très bonnes connaissances de l’allemand (bilingue) et disposition occasionnelle à voyager (Bellikon, Berne)




**Notre offre**

Notre collaboration au sein de l’équipe repose sur la bienveillance, la confiance, la fiabilité et l’orientation vers le service. description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Biberstein sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Hausverantwortung.

### Ihre Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Biberstein auf einen Blick

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Hausverantwortung

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Biberstein

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Biberstein liegt im Kanton Aargau und besticht durch seine zentrale Lage in der Nordwestschweiz. Sie profitieren von einer ausgezeichneten Verkehrsanbindung mit direktem Zugang zur Autobahn und guter Bahnverbindung ins Baselbiet. Die Region bietet Ihnen ein attraktives Arbeitsumfeld mit stabiler Infrastruktur, Nähe zu urbanen Zentren und gleichzeitig hoher Lebensqualität in der ländlichen Umgebung.

### Ihre Aufgaben als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Hausverantwortung in Biberstein

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Diese Qualifikationen bringen Sie mit

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Hausverantwortung

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Hausverantwortung in Biberstein verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Region Biberstein im Kanton Aargau verzeichnet eine hohe Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachfrauen und -männern mit Hausverantwortung, da Spitäler und Pflegeinstitutionen qualifiziertes Personal für Leitungsaufgaben dringend benötigen. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt, wo Ihre Qualifikation sehr gefragt ist und attraktive Positionen mit 80-100% Pensum verfügbar sind. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler durch fundierte Marktkenntnis, persönliche Beratung und direkte Kontakte zu renommierten Arbeitgebern in der Region, was Ihnen den Einstieg erheblich erleichtert.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Biberstein

- Bezahlte Kurse über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Hausverantwortung in Biberstein

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.
