title: Master's thesis in Reconstructing methanotrophic bacteria communities during the Holocene of an alpine lake
description:
Master's thesis in Reconstructing methanotrophic bacteria communities during the Holocene of an alpine lake (m/f/d)  


  











Master's thesis in Reconstructing methanotrophic bacteria communities during the Holocene of an alpine lake (m/f/d)
===================================================================================================================




  










 



Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Eawag conducts research, education and expert consulting to achieve the dual goals of meeting direct human needs for water and maintaining the function and integrity of aquatic ecosystems.





The Department of Surface Waters \- Research and Management ([SURF](/)), in Dübendorf (ZH), has a vacancy for a



Master's thesis in Reconstructing methanotrophic bacteria communities during the Holocene of an alpine lake (m/f/d)
===================================================================================================================





 **Background:** Methane\-oxidizing bacteria (MOB) plays a key role in regulating methane emissions from lakes, yet their past community dynamics under changing environmental and climate conditions remain poorly constrained. Our group studies MOB communities in alpine and peri\-alpine lakes using a combination of lipid biomarker analysis and molecular biology tools. We are now looking for a motivated master's student to apply this approach to a 12\-meter\-long sediment core retrieved from the alpine Lac de Taney (VS).



 **Project description:** This MSc project will reconstruct MOB community composition and dynamics in the Lac de Taney sediment record using specific bacterial lipid biomarkers known as bacteriohopanepolyols (BHP), alongside complementary proxies (e.g., TOC, XRF elemental abundances) and relate these findings to the broader evolution of the lake's biogeochemistry during the Holocene. The Sedimentology Group is part of the Department of Surface Waters and is headed by Prof. , Head of the Department of Surface Waters. The project offers the possibility to shape the specific research questions together, depending on the student's interests.



 **What you will do** 





* Process and subsample the Lac de Taney sediment core (\~50 samples)
* Extract and analyze lipid biomarkers via UHPLC\-Orbitrap\-HRMS
* Perform DNA extraction and prepare samples for 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing
* Interpret multi\-proxy data to reconstruct past microbial community dynamics
* Optionally join a fieldwork campaign at Lake Rotsee to see the full workflow of core retrieval firsthand in October 2026



 **You will gain** hands\-on laboratory experience across a full analytical pipeline spanning organic geochemistry and molecular biology. You will have access to state\-of\-the\-art instrumentation at Eawag Dübendorf, including UHPLC\-Orbitrap\-HRMS, and receive close supervision within an active research group.



 **We are looking for** a student enrolled in an MSc programme at ETH in geoscience, environmental science, biology, or a related field. You have an interest in biogeochemistry, (paleo)limnology, and/or microbial ecology and are willing to work with a range of analytical techniques. No prior experience with mass spectrometry or molecular biology is required.



 **At Eawag,** we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.



Do you have specific requirements regarding the application process or the position, or do you need additional information? Talk to us about it\-we will be happy to support you with possible flexible workplace, working hours, and job design solutions. For further information please visit our website about [Eawag](/) as well as our [conditions](/) of employment.



 **The project is scheduled to start** in the fall semester 2026 with the proposal phase (if required, e.g. D\-EAPS at ETH), followed by the project in the semester 2027\. The exact start date can be discussed. The project has a duration of 6 months. The supervisors are Lorenzo Cellino, PhD student, and Nora Richter, SNSF Ambizione Fellow.



 **Deadline for applications is 30 October 2026 or until the position is filled** and will therefore be evaluated on a rolling basis. Applications should include a very short cover letter (. one page) describing your interests and their relevance to this position, as well as a CV.



For more details on the position, please contact [Write an email](<>) or [Write an email](<>) by email.



 **We look forward to receiving your application.** Please send it through this webpage, as any other way of applying will not be considered. A click on the link below will take you directly to the application form.

title: Quality Manufacturing Manager
description:
Ref 2579795 \| Date: 18 Sept 2026

![LHH]( )

Quality Manufacturing Manager

Our client is a leading international high\-tech company operating in the semiconductor industry, with a strong focus on innovation, advanced manufacturing and quality excellence.

**Responsabilities:**

* Drive and promote a strong quality culture across the IC Front\-End manufacturing organization, in close collaboration with the Quality function, with a strong focus on zero\-defect objectives and compliance with applicable automotive and customer requirements.
* Ensure compliance with relevant quality standards, particularly IATF 16949, and lead quality task forces, alerts and critical manufacturing quality topics.
* Lead the process change management framework, ensuring that manufacturing changes are properly assessed, documented and implemented while minimizing risks to production performance, supply chain continuity and customer satisfaction.
* Drive the deployment and effective use of process control methodologies and quality tools, including MSA, SPC, automated monitoring, data analysis and manufacturing execution systems, with the objective of reducing non\-conformities, scrap and process variation.
* Lead non\-conformance management and ensure timely risk assessment, containment and disposition of quality events, while driving root\-cause analysis and sustainable corrective actions.
* Drive scrap analysis and continuous improvement initiatives in collaboration with manufacturing and process owners, ensuring effective problem solving and prevention of recurring issues.
* Lead manufacturing audit activities, coordinate the resolution of findings and ensure that major non\-conformities are addressed at both process and system level.
* Coordinate the resolution of customer complaints related to Front\-End manufacturing, ensuring appropriate risk assessment, root\-cause analysis, corrective actions and prevention of recurrence.
* Analyse quality performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement, leading cross\-functional projects and teams to improve manufacturing quality, yield and operational performance.
* Report quality performance, risks, audit findings and improvement actions to management and key internal stakeholders.




**Profile:**

* Engineering degree in Electronics, Microelectronics, Physics or a related technical field.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in a high\-tech industrial environment, including at least 5 years in a Quality Management role.
* Strong experience in semiconductor or IC manufacturing, with a good understanding of Front\-End production processes, quality tools, process development, failure analysis and manufacturing audits.
* Solid knowledge of quality management systems and industry standards, particularly ISO 9001, IATF 16949 and automotive core tools.
* Proven experience in Project Management, Continuous Improvement and cross\-functional team leadership.
* Six Sigma Black Belt and/or Lean experience is highly valued.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with a structured, proactive and results\-oriented approach.
* Ability to lead complex quality and continuous improvement initiatives in a multicultural and international environment.
* Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder management skills, with strong customer orientation.
* Fluent in both French and English, written and spoken.

Die Region besticht zudem durch ihre gute Infrastruktur und leistbare Mieten.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Lyss aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für Diplomierte Pflegefachfrauen und -männer HF/FH in der Langzeitpflege rund um Lyss ist derzeit sehr gefragt, da zahlreiche Institutionen Schwierigkeiten haben, ihre Stellen vollständig zu besetzen. Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

description:
Company Description
At Syngenta Crop Protection, we're pioneering solutions that safeguard global food security while championing sustainable agriculture. As a world market leader headquartered in Switzerland, we empower farmers with innovative crop protection technologies that defend against nature's toughest challenges. We unite advanced science with digital solutions to develop intelligent crop protection that maximizes yields while minimizing environmental impact. Join our mission of revolutionizing plant protection from seed to harvest. Syngenta has been ranked as a top employer by Science Magazine and it has been awarded with the -Friendly Work Space- label to all its Swiss sites.

Job Description
Purpose of the Role
-Lead and deploy the Manufacturing Excellence strategy—covering both process and people pillars within the Syngenta Production System (SPS)—to improve Formulation, Filling & Packing (FF&P) Manufacturing performance. Partner with FF&P manufacturing leaders to identify and build the capabilities required to drive transformation and optimize cost efficiency, innovation, quality, and production performance (processes, systems, and people). Ensure strong focus on execution, design, efficiency, and agility.

Accountabilities
-Implement SPS aligned to strategy: Deliver successful implementation of the Syngenta Production System in line with the Global FF&P Manufacturing strategy, balancing site/customer requirements with SPS standards to support performance across sites.
-Deploy Manufacturing Excellence strategy: Translate business strategy into site Manufacturing Excellence roadmaps; build the capabilities needed to transform process, systems, and people, with focus on execution, design, efficiency, and agility.
-Drive long-term production performance: Partner with site leaders to deliver long-term production plans that improve availability, capacity, reliability, and cost efficiency.
-Deliver customer-focused outcomes: Collaborate with customers and site stakeholders to ensure reliable, cost-effective delivery and measurable operational impact.
-Lead and manage a globally distributed team of professionals
-Build a culture of excellence: Foster and role-model a Manufacturing Excellence mindset, acting as a trusted advisor to strengthen capabilities, improve performance, and mobilize sustainable change.
-Lead change and continuous improvement: Promote a change-management mindset grounded in continuous improvement; coach teams and individuals to embed new ways of working and accelerate adoption.
-Standardize and optimize operations: Oversee standard practices, capacity planning, and resource allocation; deploy change initiatives across sites to amplify performance and cost efficiency.
-Ensure tool/process discipline: Ensure consistent use of SPS tools and processes to optimize implementation, maintain smooth operations, and improve productivity, quality, and profitability.
-Develop talent and capabilities: Build the manufacturing talent pipeline and functional capabilities; role-model coaching and mentoring, and promote timely, constructive feedback.

Qualifications
-5+ years of experience in a relevant scientific or engineering field (e.g., production performance, Lean leadership), with demonstrated manufacturing experience.
-BS/MS in Industrial Engineering, Engineering, or Chemical Sciences (or a 5-year technical degree in a related discipline).
-Manufacturing specialist with strong project/program management and change/operations management experience, confident leading large, complex initiatives with significant responsibility.
-Track record leading teams and building manufacturing capability.
-Ability to develop, coach, and teach others to deliver change.
-Functional expertise in production performance, maintenance, and Lean leadership.
-Information management: interpret, analyze, and present complex/conflicting data.
-Communication: strong listening; clear messaging; sound judgment in complex situations.
-Credibility & trust-building across all levels; able to remove blockers.
-Stakeholder influencing: drive alignment with Site Leadership Teams and key stakeholders.
-Fluent English; additional language a plus.
-Ability and flexibility to travel frequently, as the role may require travel up to 50% of the time

Additional Information
We offer a variety of financial and non-financial benefits including:
-A position that contributes to valuable and impactful work in a stimulating and international environment
-A superb working environment with an open culture and diverse workforce where new ideas are always welcome
-The opportunity to work with and learn from highly qualified and experienced colleagues to grow in scientific and technical excellence
-A strong learning culture (Together we Grow) with a wide range of training opportunities
-You will profit from a competitive pension fund plan, flexible working, attractive bonus system, onsite doctor, fitness room, canteen, and other benefits (Family friendly initiatives, Child and Family allowance…)

description:
Responsable Commerce International, Conformité et Développement Maghreb
MPC Mélanges Produits Chimiques Sàrl
Le Mont-sur-Lausanne
Type de contrat : Durée indéterminée
Taux d’activité : 80% - 100%
Lieu de travail : Chemin de Budron H 9 1052 Le Mont-sur-Lausanne
Langue : français (Langue maternelle)
Salaire : Le salaire ne sera pas affiché

MISSION GÉNÉRALE
MPC Mélanges Produits Chimiques Sàrl recherche un(e) Responsable Commerce International, Conformité et Développement Maghreb chargé(e) de coordonner et développer les opérations commerciales, réglementaires, documentaires et administratives de l’entreprise entre l’Europe et les marchés d’Afrique du Nord.
Le poste implique une coordination permanente entre les partenaires industriels, logistiques, bancaires, réglementaires et commerciaux situés notamment en Suisse, Belgique, France, Algérie, Libye et autres pays du Maghreb.

Le titulaire du poste contribue au développement des activités de MPC, à la sécurisation des opérations internationales et à la conformité des flux commerciaux transfrontaliers.

MISSIONS PRINCIPALES
Développement commercial international
•    Participer au développement des activités de MPC sur les marchés du Maghreb.
•    Assurer l’interface opérationnelle entre les partenaires européens et nord-africains.
•    Participer à l’identification et à la structuration de nouveaux partenariats commerciaux.
•    Accompagner le développement des activités de l’entreprise sur les marchés internationaux.
•    Participer à la mise en œuvre des projets de croissance et d’expansion régionale.
Commerce extérieur & conformité réglementaire
•    Superviser la conformité documentaire des opérations internationales.
•    Assurer le suivi des factures commerciales, packing lists, certificats, fiches de données de sécurité (FDS) et documents douaniers.
•    Garantir le respect des réglementations applicables aux opérations de commerce extérieur.
•    Veiller à la conformité des flux avec les réglementations ADR, CLP et autres exigences réglementaires applicables.
•    Coordonner les partenaires juridiques, fiduciaires, assureurs et organismes de contrôle.
Coordination bancaire et opérations internationales
•    Assurer la relation avec les établissements bancaires intervenant dans les opérations internationales.
•    Participer au suivi des dossiers de domiciliation bancaire, paiements internationaux et opérations documentaires.
•    Contribuer à la sécurisation financière et réglementaire des opérations de commerce extérieur.
•    Assurer l’interface entre les partenaires commerciaux, bancaires et logistiques.
Coordination logistique internationale
•    Superviser les flux logistiques entre l’Europe et les marchés du Maghreb.
•    Coordonner les opérations avec les transitaires, transporteurs et partenaires logistiques.
•    Participer à l’optimisation des schémas de transport et des flux documentaires.
•    Assurer le suivi des opérations d’approvisionnement et de distribution.
•    Contribuer à la performance globale des opérations internationales.

EXIGENCES OBLIGATOIRES
•    Formation universitaire ou équivalente dans les domaines de la gestion, de la finance, de l’audit, du commerce international, du droit des affaires ou domaine apparenté.
•    Minimum 15 années d’expérience professionnelle dans des fonctions de gestion, finance, audit, conformité réglementaire, commerce extérieur ou coordination d’opérations internationales.
•    Expérience confirmée dans la gestion ou la coordination d’activités impliquant plusieurs partenaires et plusieurs juridictions.
•    Solide connaissance des flux commerciaux entre l’Europe et le Maghreb.
•    Connaissance approfondie des procédures administratives, bancaires, douanières et réglementaires liées aux opérations de commerce extérieur avec l’Algérie.
•    Expérience confirmée dans la gestion documentaire et administrative d’opérations internationales.
•    Excellente maîtrise écrite et orale du français et de l’arabe.
•    Anglais professionnel.
•    Capacité démontrée à coordonner simultanément plusieurs partenaires internationaux.
•    Solide compréhension de l’environnement économique et réglementaire des pays du Maghreb.
•    Disponibilité pour des déplacements professionnels réguliers en Suisse, en Europe et dans les pays du Maghreb.
Atouts
•    Expérience dans le secteur des produits techniques, industriels ou chimiques.
•    Connaissance des réglementations ADR, CLP et transport de marchandises réglementées.
•    Expérience des opérations impliquant des partenaires industriels du secteur énergétique.
•    Expérience du développement commercial sur les marchés nord-africains.

title: Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer
description:

![MEGGITT SA]( )

**Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer**

**Are you ready to shape a brighter future?**



Did you know that every second, an aircraft takes off somewhere in the world, and that 90% of them are equipped with a component produced in Fribourg? We are Parker Hannifin, a global leader in motion and control technologies, with more than 58,000 team members across 44 countries. Our Parker Business Unit in Fribourg, Switzerland, part of the Motion, Power, and Sensing division, is a technological and manufacturing center of excellence specializing in the development and production of measurement, control, and protection solutions for the aerospace and energy sectors. With around 400 employees, we design, qualify, and manufacture high\-performance sensors, electronic systems, and software monitoring solutions for critical and extreme environments. We are proud to work with passion, to enable engineering breakthrough and innovation. Joining Parker Fribourg means contributing to high\-value international technology projects, growing in a collaborative and innovative environment, and developing your full professional and personal potential.







**Your responsibilities**



*      Take technical ownership of the IT infrastructure of an aerospace manufacturing site

*      Lead or co\-lead complex and/or global digital infrastructure and IT projects

*      Develop and maintain complex infrastructure systems, including virtualization, storage and backup.

*      Maintain, backup, migrate and consolidate databases accross multiple technologies

*      Map dependencies between applications, servers and industrial endpoints.

*      Implement, troubleshoot and sustain network segmentation between corporate IT, OT and IoT environments.

*      Ensure infrastructure compliance with corporate security, patching and lifecycle requirements.

*      Act as the technical escalation point for 3rd level support

*      Coordinate with external IT and service vendors for infrastructure services, technical changes and projects

*      Ensure knowledge transfer and operational hand\-over to other team members

*      Act as deputy for the Support Lead when required, taking responsibility for day\-to\-day support operations

*      Available to provide after\-hours support for critical infrastructure operations

*      Maximum one day of home office allowed







**Who we are looking for**



*      Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems or equivalent professional experience

*      8\+ years of IT infrastructure experience supporting complex environments preferably within an industrial field.

*      At least 4 years’ experience leading complex projects

*      Broad technical expertise across virtulization, storage, databass, identity management, and Windows and Linux systems

*      Strong skills in structured troubleshooting, root cause analysis and corrective action implementation

*      Extensive experience in backup, recovery and continuity planning (DRP/BCP)

*      Excellent written and verbal communication and collaboration skills in both French and English

*      Highly organised with the ability to work autonomously while managing multiple priorities effectively

*      Solution\-oriented and able to build strong working relationships at all levels of the organisation

*      Demonstrated technical leadership, adaptability, learning agility and ability to mentor junior team members







**What we offer**



*      Solid employer on the market for over 100 years, we manage the full product lifecycle and support leading aerospace and energy companies worldwide

*      Career growth, opportunities and training: we hire from within!

*      Collaborative and empowered work environment where team spirit is at the center of our success.

*      Company values that encourage trust, respect, collaboration and professional growth.

*      Open environment: we are excited to hear your ideas!

*      Attractive compensation packages designed to hire and retain the best talents in the industry.

*      Company restaurant and other benefits







**If you don’t find yourself in all points, apply anyways,** because all competencies are valued!







**Have we sparked your interest?**



We look forward to getting to know you!



Please apply with your complete application documents directly online.







If you are selected for a first interview, we will arrange a meeting on Teams.



Some stages of the recruiting process will include professional situational exercises.



Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted for the next steps in the recruitment process.











*Parker is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on grounds of age, race, religion, ethnic origin, gender, sexual orientation or disability in relation to recruitment and employment*.



*Parker Hannifin EMEA Sàrl (“PHEMEA”), based in Etoy, Switzerland, is the Principal Operating Company for Parker in the EMEA region. It is supported by a network of Parker Manufacturing Divisions and Sales Company Entities. The Aerospace Group EMEA is a strategic business Group within PHEMEA, and its Motion, Power, and Sensing Division is a key service provider to PHEMEA.*

title: Principal Process Engineering Specialist (H/F/N)
employer: Syngenta Crop Protection AG Production Chimique
description:
Company Description

At Syngenta Group, we're a global community of 56,000 innovators across 90 countries, united by a 250-year legacy of agricultural excellence. As the world's most local agricultural technology partner, we create tailor-made solutions that transform farming while protecting our planet, driven by our commitment to innovation, ethics, and integrity. Through our inclusive environment and diverse perspectives, we pioneer breakthrough solutions for farmers, society, and future generations. Join our worldwide teams of agricultural pioneers in creating a more resilient and equitable food system for all.


Job Description

As a Principal Process Engineer Specialist, you will provide technical leadership for chemical processes supporting the development, scale-up, introduction and ongoing improvement of intermediates and active ingredients at industrial scale.

You will hold and develop process know-how for assigned chemical steps, ensuring that processes are safe, compliant, robust, sustainable and fit for Supply Chain needs. You will work closely with production, project teams, chemists and global technical networks to solve complex technical challenges, improve performance and support strategic initiatives.

Accountabilities:

Lead the technical development, scale-up and implementation of new or improved chemical processes for intermediates and active ingredients.
Define and agree development programmes with relevant stakeholders; plan, oversee and, when needed, carry out laboratory, pilot and full-scale plant trials.
Provide technical leadership for complex process-engineering projects, including process simulation, design, sizing and equipment specification
Act as a key technical contact for project teams, providing expertise in process engineering and chemical process development.
Support the commissioning and technical start-up of new or modified plants, ensuring design intent is met and production is established safely and effectively.
Provide expert technical support to manufacturing teams, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and continuous process improvement.
Define key process parameters and control strategies to ensure safe, reliable and compliant operations.
Identify and lead initiatives to improve capacity, product quality, manufacturing costs, waste generation and energy consumption.
Support process transfer and relocation projects to external partners or other Syngenta sites, in collaboration with Technology & Sourcing and Supply Chain teams.
Provide technical input to Process Risk Assessments and ensure process design meets internal and external HSEQ and regulatory requirements.
Coach and develop less experienced process engineers, sharing technical knowledge and local ways of working.
Build and maintain strong connections with internal technical networks and contribute to the identification and implementation of innovative technologies.

Qualifications

Master’s degree or PhD in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or a related discipline.
At least 8–10 years of relevant industrial experience, ideally within the chemical industry; experience in active ingredient or intermediate manufacturing would be a strong advantage.
Demonstrated expertise in chemical process development, process design, scale-up and industrial manufacturing support.
Practical experience in process simulation and modelling.
Experience with Aspen Plus is preferred. Experience with other process simulation and modelling tools, such as Aspen HYSYS, gPROMS, Pro/II or CHEMCAD will also be considered.
Practical experience with laboratory work, pilot trials and/or full-scale plant trials.
Strong knowledge of process safety, reaction hazards, HSEQ requirements, Management of Change and regulatory constraints in an industrial chemical environment.
Experience in commissioning new or modified processes and supporting technical start-up activities, including participation in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and collaboration with automation and process-control teams
Ability to work autonomously on technically complex projects with significant business impact, while collaborating effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder-management skills.
Experience in coaching or mentoring junior colleagues is an advantage.
This is a senior individual contributor role focused on technical leadership and expertise. It does not include direct people-management responsibility.
Professional fluency in English is required. Knowledge of French is an asset, and support will be provided to candidates who wish to further develop their French language skills

Additional information

What We Offer

A competitive salary
A profit-sharing bonus (option to invest in a company savings plan with employer matching)
Works Council benefits
Health insurance with 60% employer coverage
A supplementary retirement plan (option to contribute unused RTT and vacation days)
Career opportunities as well as possibilities for individual development and continuous training
Special attention to your work-life balance with flexible working conditions and flexible hours
A work environment that promotes agility, diversity and teamwork
Responsible and varied work in a forward-thinking company
On-site company restaurant
Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

Subcontracts Administrator  


  











Subcontracts Administrator
==========================




  








 **Department:** **Procurement and Subcontracts Management**



 **Reports to:** **Business Manager / Construction Manager**



 **Responsible for:** **Effective subcontract formation / administration / closeout; implementation of the project’s subcontract management procedures.**



 **Location:** **Construction site office in Beringen**



 **Start Date:**  



 **Employment Type:** **Full time / On\-Site**



ENKA Investment AG is seeking a Subcontracts Administrator for its planned data center project in Beringen, Schaffhausen. You will manage subcontractors across their full lifecycle, working closely with the Swiss project organization and ENKA’s headquarters in Istanbul.



  ***Required Knowledge and Qualifications***



* 5\-7\+ years experience in subcontracts/procurement administration
* Experience on major construction or infrastructure projects; mission\-critical or data\-center experience an advantage
* Fluency in Turkish and English or German
* Sound understanding of construction industry and of subcontract formation, administration and closeout
* Experience and good command of ENKA’s company document control system EDMS
* Strong negotiation skills and commercial/claims awareness
* Understanding and use of proper business ethics
* Proactive rather than reactive; positive attitude; able to guide junior administrators
* International work experience preferred

* Subcontract formation: review service requisitions for completeness, prepare bidder lists, compile and issue ITB packages, process all ITB correspondence, complete commercial and combined bid evaluations, present recommendations to Project Management, and hand over formation files to assigned administrator

title: Manager / Senior Manager SAP S/4HANA Technical Transformation, Integration and Clean Core
description:
We are looking for a senior SAP technical transformation leader with deep hands on S/4HANA solution design, integration, data replication and Clean Core experience. In this role, you will shape and deliver complex SAP transformation programs across multinational ERP landscapes, bridging business, functional and technical teams while guiding global delivery teams from assessment and planning through implementation and stabilization.

You will act as a trusted advisor to senior clients, helping them define robust SAP S/4HANA landscapes, make sound architecture and integration decisions, improve development quality, and deliver measurable transformation outcomes with practical use of SAP BTP, cloud, automation, analytics and AI enabled SAP capabilities.

Role Focus
SAP S/4HANA technical transformation, integration architecture, Clean Core, SAP BTP and GenAI/Joule enabled innovation.

Your Impact
- Lead S/4HANA technical transformation and upgrade programs: Own technical assessments, readiness checks, impact analysis, retrofit strategy, risk strategy, test planning, cutover support and delivery governance for SAP S/4HANA implementations and upgrades.
- Shape complex integration and data replication solutions: Design integration concepts between SAP and non SAP systems, including Central Finance, MDG, BW or BW/4HANA, external finance, tax, planning, reporting and CRM applications, using technologies such as SLT, SAP CPI, SAP PO, MuleSoft, IDoc, RFC, AIF and related middleware.
- Drive Clean Core and extensibility decisions: Define pragmatic Clean Core approaches for custom code, RICEFW, Fiori, CDS views, AMDP, ABAP developments, SAP BTP extensions, integration patterns and code remediation.
- Lead finance transformation technology streams: Support S/4HANA Finance and Central Finance programs across Record to Report, Procure to Pay, Project to Delivery, tax, group reporting, central payments, reconciliation and financial close topics.
- Manage global teams and delivery quality: Lead multidisciplinary teams of consultants, developers, architects, client IT and technology partners, including offshore and nearshore delivery models. Establish code guidelines, review processes, quality gates and performance tuning practices.
- Bridge stakeholders across business and IT: Align enterprise architects, process owners, functional leads, system owners and program leadership across multiple ERP landscapes and geographies. Create clear decision materials and drive structured issue and escalation management.
- Bring innovation into practical SAP delivery: Assess and prototype useful applications of SAP BTP, SAP Business AI, Joule, automation, analytics and data services in real transformation contexts.
- Contribute to commercial growth: Lead or support solution shaping, effort estimation, proposal preparation, sales materials, client presentations and commercial discussions for complex SAP opportunities.
- Strengthen thought leadership and talent: Develop reusable assets, points of view, technical accelerators, training material and mentoring approaches for SAP technical transformation topics.

Your Skill Set
- This opportunity is aimed at hands on senior SAP transformation professionals who combine deep technical architecture expertise, consulting leadership and delivery ownership. The profile is suitable for Manager and Senior Manager level candidates who have already led large SAP S/4HANA technical and integration streams in complex client environments.

Expected Qualifications
- Education: Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business Informatics, Business Administration with technology focus, or a related field.
- SAP technical transformation experience: 10 or more years of experience in SAP technical solution design, S/4HANA implementation, S/4HANA upgrade, ERP modernization, enterprise application advisory or SAP enabled business transformation.
- S/4HANA track record: Experience across multiple SAP S/4HANA implementations, upgrades or conversion programs, ideally covering several S/4HANA releases and recent releases such as 2021, 2023 or 2025.
- Technical solution design depth: Strong SAP ABAP, RICEFW, CDS, AMDP, Fiori, HANA, performance tuning and debugging expertise, with the ability to review solution quality, guide development teams and define technical standards.
- Integration and replication expertise: Proven experience with SAP and non SAP integration, data replication and technical connectivity using SLT, SAP CPI, SAP PO, MuleSoft, IDoc, RFC, AIF, BODS, Information Steward or comparable tools.
- Central Finance and finance process exposure: Strong experience in S/4HANA Finance or Central Finance, including FI and CO replication, reconciliation, central payments, tax reporting, group reporting, FSCM or related finance transformation topics.
- Clean Core, BTP and cloud mindset: Practical knowledge of Clean Core principles, SAP BTP capabilities, extensibility, cloud adoption and AI enabled SAP innovation.
- Large program leadership: Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, ideally including 20 or more consultants, across geographies, workstreams and delivery partners.
- Stakeholder and consulting maturity: Experience managing senior client stakeholders, system owners, architects, functional leads and delivery partners, with clear communication, storytelling, estimation and presentation skills.
- Commercial and proposal experience: Ability to support RfPs, solutioning, effort estimates, commercials, client presentations and account growth.
- Language skills: Excellent written and spoken English.

Desirable Qualifications
- SAP certifications such as ABAP, SAP Enterprise Architecture, SAP BTP, SAP Integration Suite, S/4HANA Finance or comparable credentials.
- Experience with S/4HANA Public Cloud, SAP Business AI, Joule, SAP Activate and agile delivery approaches.
- Experience in multinational SAP landscapes with multiple ERP source systems, ideally more than 10 source ERPs and several countries.
- Experience integrating SAP with applications such as Ariba, Salesforce, ONESOURCE, Longview, Bloomberg, CRM, tax reporting or financial consolidation platforms.
- Experience in manufacturing, pharma, construction, real estate, finance or complex industrial environments.
- German or French skills are a strong plus.
- MBA, advanced technology degree or equivalent advisory leadership experience is beneficial.

What We Offer
- A platform to lead technical transformation in large SAP S/4HANA programs with leading organizations.
- The opportunity to shape integration, Clean Core, Central Finance, SAP BTP and AI enabled SAP outcomes.
- A collaborative environment with access to SAP, cloud, data, AI and business transformation expertise across PwC.
- A role with clear client impact, team leadership responsibility, mentoring opportunities, asset development and contribution to market growth.

title: Health Safety Environment Manager / Deputy Health and Safety Manager
description:
Health Safety Environment Manager / Deputy Health and Safety Manager  


  











Health Safety Environment Manager / Deputy Health and Safety Manager
====================================================================




  








 **Department:** **HSE Management**



 **Reports to:** **Project Manager / Deputy Project Manager**



 **Responsible for:** **providing professional and technical HSE expertise, direction and guidance to the project**



 **Location:** **Construction site office in Beringen**



 **Start Date:**  



 **Employment: Type** **Full time / On\-Site**



ENKA Investment AG is seeking an HSE Manager for its planned data center project in Beringen, Schaffhausen. You will lead site health, safety, and environmental management across construction and commissioning, working closely with local project leadership, subcontractors and ENKA’s headquarters HSE team in Istanbul.



  ***Required Knowledge and Qualifications***



* A degree or recognized professional diploma in occupational health and safety, engineering or a related field.
* At least 10 years of construction HSE experience, including at least 3 years in a leadership role managing HSE personnel and coordinating multiple subcontractors on a major project.
* Experience in energization or commissioning while construction activities were still in progress. A clear understanding of the transition from construction to live systems is essential.
* A working understanding of Civil, Structural and Architectural (CSA) and Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) construction risks, risk assessment, work permits and hazardous energy controls.
* Proven ability to lead investigations, challenge unsafe practices constructively and secure corrective action from project teams and subcontractors under programme pressure
* Professional working proficiency in English and Turkish, spoken and written. (German is a plus for local site coordination), English the international project team, and Turkish daily meetings and reporting with Istanbul headquarters.
* Strong reporting and document management skills, with experience using digital HSE systems and practical performance measures. A site\-based approach and the ability to coach a multicultural workforce are essential.


  ***Main Duties and Responsibilities***



* Lead the project Health, Safety and Environment programme from site mobilization and civil works through mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) installation, energization, commissioning and handover, working with project leadership and ENKA’s headquarters HSE team.
* Develop and maintain the site HSE plan, responsibilities, risk registers and assurance arrangements in line with Swiss requirements, project procedures and applicable client obligations.
* Work with the Design Manager and construction leads to review design and sequencing risks, temporary works interfaces and safe access for installation and maintenance.
* Coordinate subcontractor HSE plans, competence checks, inductions and method statements. Verify that each party controls its own activities and that interfaces between trades are addressed before work starts.
* Monitor high risk construction activities, including excavations, temporary works, lifting operations, work at height, floor openings, steel and façade erection, hot works and confined space entry where applicable.
* Work with electrical and commissioning leads on permit to work, hazardous energy control, lockout/tagout, access restrictions and the separation of live systems from ongoing construction.
* Check that safety arrangements cover heavy plant installation, generators, UPS and battery systems, cooling equipment, pressure testing and associated fuel or hazardous substances, as applicable to the design.
* Maintain a strong site presence through inspections, audits and workforce engagement. Stop unsafe work, escalate significant risks and verify effective corrective action before authorized work resumption.
* Lead incident and near miss investigations, identify underlying causes and track corrective actions to closure. Maintain reliable records and report trends that support prevention and open reporting.
* Coordinate occupational health controls, welfare arrangements and environmental measures, including dust, noise, heat, waste, site water, spill prevention and relevant permit conditions.
* Develop emergency arrangements with site teams and relevant local services; organise drills and confirm that plans remain suitable as construction and commissioning conditions change.
* Coach HSE personnel and subcontractor supervisors, deliver practical briefings and ensure that safety instructions are understood across a multilingual workforce.
* Attend daily coordination meetings with ENKA’s Istanbul headquarters HSE team in Turkish and provide daily risk and action updates, together with regular project performance reports.

title: Data Center Design Manager
description:
Data Center Design Manager  


  











Data Center Design Manager
==========================




  








 **Department:** **Design Group**



 **Reports to:** **Project Manager/Construction Manager**



 **Responsible for:** **Design Coordination and Development throughout the Project including Coordination of shop drawings**



 **Location:** **Construction site office in Beringen**



 **Start Date:**  



 **Employment Type:** **Full time / On Site**



ENKA Investment AG is seeking a Data Center Design Manager for its planned data center project in Beringen, Schaffhausen. You will lead coordinated design delivery across the building and its critical systems, working closely with the Swiss project organization and ENKA’s headquarters design and procurement team in Istanbul.



 **Data Center Design Manager**



The role combines technical leadership, design delivery management and close support to procurement, construction and commissioning.



  ***Required Knowledge and Qualifications***



* A degree in electrical, mechanical, civil, or building services engineering, architecture or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional competence
* At least 10 years of relevant design or construction experience, with proven responsibility for leading multidisciplinary design delivery, including detailed design, construction, commissioning and handover
* Strong knowledge of CSA and critical MEP interfaces, power and cooling resilience, and practical construction requirements.
* Demonstrated ability to lead consultants and specialist designers, manage design deliverables and approvals, and resolve complex interfaces in an international EPC, main contractor or comparable project environment.
* Practical BIM coordination, model review and document control experience, using Navisworks or Solibri, Revit/IFC models and common data environment such as ACC, Aconex or equivalent.
* Commercial and programme awareness, including design scope, procurement interfaces and change control. Sound judgment, clear reporting and the ability to close decisions under construction deadlines.
* Professional fluency spoken and written Turkish, English are essential. Turkish is required for daily technical meetings and reporting with ENKA’s Istanbul headquarters; (German is a plus for local coordination); English for the international project team and technical documentation.


  ***Main Duties and Responsibilities***



* Lead civil structural, architectural and MEP design delivery from the current design stage through procurement, construction, commissioning and handover, coordinating ENKA’s consultants and specialist designers.
* Work daily with ENKA’s headquarters design team in Istanbul. Lead technical meetings in Turkish and provide daily reports on progress, outstanding decisions, design risks and actions.
* Maintain the design management plan, responsibility matrix, deliverables register and programme. Align releases with procurement lead times, construction sequencing and the integrated project schedule.
* Coordinate excavation, temporary works interfaces, foundations and piling where required, concrete, steel, architecture, façades and roofing with equipment loads, installation sequences and building services.
* Integrate critical power and cooling systems, including utility interfaces, transformers, generators, UPS, distribution, cooling plant, pumps and CRAH/CRAC units, together with controls, fire protection, security and ICT pathways.
* Close interfaces for openings, sleeves, shafts, plinths, embedded items, support and fire stopping before construction release. Coordinate structural approvals, maintenance access and equipment replacement routes.
* Lead multidisciplinary reviews and BIM coordination. Resolve technical and spatial issues, record decisions and maintain controlled models, drawings and specifications in the common data environment.
* Manage consultant scopes, technical submittals, RFIs and review comments. Coordinate approved construction information and track overdue inputs, revisions and approvals.
* Integrate vendor and subcontractor design, including employer supplied equipment where applicable. Coordinate technical procurement inputs, long lead equipment interfaces and vendor changes.
* Coordinate compliance reviews and permit submissions with Swiss consultants, authorities and utilities, addressing applicable SIA standards, fire safety requirements and project obligations.
* Assess changes and value engineering with Commercial and Project Controls teams, identifying effects on cost, programme, resilience, safety and operating performance before approval.
* Support side teams with buildability and design issue resolution. Manage design risks, safe access, construction interfaces and incorporation of approved site changes.
* Coordinate with commissioning and operations teams on testability and maintainability. Close design issues arising from factory and site acceptance tests and integrated systems testing.
* Track completion of as\-built records and operation and maintenance documentation. Report design progress, unresolved risks and required decisions through handover.

Berufsbeiständin / Berufsbeistand 80 %
=======================================

**Spannende Aufgaben für Sie**

* Sie führen eigenverantwortlich Mandate im Kinder\- und Erwachsenenschutz im Auftrag der KESB gemäss den gesetzlichen Vorgaben des Zivilgesetzbuches.
* Sie führen fundierte Abklärungen im Kinder\- und Erwachsenenschutz durch und erstellen Abklärungsberichte, Anträge sowie weitere Berichte, die als Grundlage für Entscheide und Massnahmen der KESB dienen.
* Sie vertreten in der eigenständigen Fallführung die Interessen von verbeiständeten Personen in rechtlicher, finanzieller und persönlicher Hinsicht und fördern dabei deren Selbstbestimmung und Lebensqualität unter Einhaltung der gesetzlichen Vorgaben und der fachlichen Grundlagen.
* Sie koordinieren Hilfs\- und Unterstützungsangebote und begleiten die Umsetzung geeigneter Massnahmen im Lebensumfeld der Klient\*innen.
* Sie pflegen einen professionellen Kontakt zur Klientel und deren Umfeld und handeln ressourcen\- und lösungsorientiert.
* Sie leisten einen aktiven Beitrag zur Weiterentwicklung unseres Kindes\- und Erwachsenenschutzdienstes (KESD) und bringen Ihre Fachkompetenz in den kollegialen Austausch ein.
* Sie arbeiten in einem interdisziplinären Umfeld eng mit internen und externen Fachpersonen sowie Fachstellen wie der Sozialhilfe, der KESB, Schulen, medizinischen Fachpersonen, sozialen Institutionen und weiteren Netzwerkpartnern zusammen.


 

**Damit bringen Sie uns weiter**

* Sie bringen einen Tertiärabschluss in sozialer Arbeit oder in einem ähnlichen Bereich (Recht, Pädagogik oder Psychologie) mit.
* Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in der Sozialberatung und/oder Mandatsführung oder die Bereitschaft sich spezifisch weiterzubilden.
* Sie haben Freude an Verantwortung und komplexen Situationen.
* Sie sind belastbar und teamfähig.
* Sie arbeiten gerne selbstständig und exakt.
* Sie verfügen über Administrationsflair und gute IT\-Kenntnisse.
* Sie besitzen eine gut dosierte Portion Humor, um in diesem Arbeitsfeld immer wieder mit Leichtigkeit den intensiven Arbeitsalltag bewältigen zu können.


 

**Was Sie davon haben?**

* Der Kindes\- und Erwachsenenschutzdienst der Gemeinde Wettingen erbringt im Auftrag der Kindes\- und Erwachsenenschutzbehörde professionelle Dienstleistungen für die Bevölkerung von Wettingen.
* Die Sozialen Dienste mit rund 30 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter in drei verschiedenen Bereichen erbringen anspruchsvolle, abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem spannenden Arbeitsalltag und gehen die aktuellen Herausforderungen als Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter der Gemeinde Wettingen aktiv an.
* Wir leben Weiterbildung und beteiligen uns mit finanziellen und/oder zeitlichen Beiträgen.
* Nur wer mit allen relevanten Informationen versorgt ist, kann seine Aufgaben zielgerichtet erbringen. Deshalb informieren wir nicht nur in der Abteilung, sondern auch in der ganzen Verwaltung regelmässig und transparent.

**About the Company**

We are an internationally focused Swiss asset management company based in the Canton of Schwyz. As an asset manager within the meaning of the Swiss Financial Institutions Act (FinIA), we provide our clients with asset management, financial advisory and related financial services.

We operate in an international environment and act both on our own account and on behalf of third parties. In doing so, we combine financial expertise with an entrepreneurial approach to identifying and developing investment opportunities.

As we enter the next phase of our corporate development, we are seeking an accomplished and internationally experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead the company, strengthen the existing business and drive strategic expansion into new markets and investment sectors, with a primary focus on Life Sciences (particularly artificial intelligence) and international markets – with an emphasis on the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe.

**Your Role**

As CEO, you will have overall responsibility for the strategic, operational and commercial development of the company. Working closely with the Board of Directors, shareholders and other senior stakeholders, you will define and implement the corporate strategy and lead the continued development of the company as an internationally focused Swiss asset manager.

You will combine strong leadership and investment expertise with entrepreneurial thinking, extensive transaction experience and a deep understanding of international financial markets.

**How You Will Contribute to Our Success**

\- Assume overall responsibility for the strategic, operational and commercial management of the company and translate its long\-term vision into measurable business objectives.

\- Identify, assess and develop new markets, with a focus on the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe, as well as investment opportunities and strategic partnerships in the Life Sciences sector (particularly artificial intelligence).

\- Drive fundraising initiatives and further expand the company’s international investor and business network, particularly in the United Kingdom, Asia and Eastern Europe, within the aforementioned financial sectors.

\- Lead and oversee investment activities across asset and portfolio management, corporate finance, M\&A, private equity and fundraising.

\- Lead, develop and support the management team and employees, while establishing a culture of excellence, accountability, integrity and entrepreneurial thinking.

**Requirements**

As a Principal Process Engineer Specialist, you will provide technical leadership for chemical processes supporting the development, scale-up, introduction and ongoing improvement of intermediates and active ingredients at industrial scale.

You will hold and develop process know-how for assigned chemical steps, ensuring that processes are safe, compliant, robust, sustainable and fit for Supply Chain needs. Lead the technical development, scale-up and implementation of new or improved chemical processes for intermediates and active ingredients.
Define and agree development programmes with relevant stakeholders; plan, oversee and, when needed, carry out laboratory, pilot and full-scale plant trials.
Provide technical leadership for complex process-engineering projects, including process simulation, design, sizing and equipment specification
Act as a key technical contact for project teams, providing expertise in process engineering and chemical process development.
Support the commissioning and technical start-up of new or modified plants, ensuring design intent is met and production is established safely and effectively.
Provide expert technical support to manufacturing teams, including troubleshooting, root-cause analysis and continuous process improvement.
Define key process parameters and control strategies to ensure safe, reliable and compliant operations.
Identify and lead initiatives to improve capacity, product quality, manufacturing costs, waste generation and energy consumption.
Support process transfer and relocation projects to external partners or other Syngenta sites, in collaboration with Technology & Sourcing and Supply Chain teams.
Provide technical input to Process Risk Assessments and ensure process design meets internal and external HSEQ and regulatory requirements.
Coach and develop less experienced process engineers, sharing technical knowledge and local ways of working.
Build and maintain strong connections with internal technical networks and contribute to the identification and implementation of innovative technologies.

Master’s degree or PhD in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry or a related discipline.
At least 8–10 years of relevant industrial experience, ideally within the chemical industry; experience in active ingredient or intermediate manufacturing would be a strong advantage.
Demonstrated expertise in chemical process development, process design, scale-up and industrial manufacturing support.

Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder-management skills.

Chief of Staff (a) (80\-100%)
=============================




**Technology \& Leadership – dafür steht Consult \& Pepper. Als spezialisierte Personalberatung besetzen wir seit über 25 Jahren anspruchsvolle Fach\- und Führungspositionen. Dabei arbeiten wir branchenagnostisch mit Start\-Ups, KMUs und internationalen Grosskonzernen zusammen.**

**Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von einem familiären Miteinander, offener und manchmal etwas sehr direkter Kommunikation sowie einem starken Teamgeist. Kollegiale Unterstützung, kurze Entscheidungswege und gemeinsame Events sorgen dafür, dass Arbeit bei uns nicht nur erfolgreich, sondern auch menschlich ist.**

**Zur Unterstützung unserer beiden Co\-CEOs suchen wir ein neugieriges, lernfähiges und umsetzungsstarkes Organisationstalent mit hoher Technologieaffinität als « Chief of Staff».**




**Deine Herausforderung**

Du stehst kurz vor deinem Studienabschluss oder hast diesen gerade hinter dir – und suchst keinen klassischen Einstiegsjob? Du möchtest nicht in einem Traineeprogramm eine Station von vielen durchlaufen, sondern direkt erleben, wie ein Unternehmen geführt wird?  
In dieser vielseitigen Stabsrolle erhältst du Einblick in nahezu alle Bereiche eines KMUs, unterstützt die Geschäftsleitung im operativen Tagesgeschäft und übernimmst zunehmend eigene Projekte und Verantwortungsbereiche.

Deine Aufgabenschwerpunkte sehen wie folgt aus – wobei sich deine im Laufe der Zeit verändern und weiterentwickeln wird.

* **Management Support \& Business Operations (\~40%)**
    + Du unterstützt unsere beiden Co\-CEOs im operativen Tagesgeschäft und hältst ihnen bei administrativen und organisatorischen Aufgaben den Rücken frei
    + Du bereitest Präsentationen, Auswertungen, Controllings und Entscheidungsgrundlagen auf
    + Du koordinierst zentrale interne Abläufe und entwickelst bestehende Instrumente und Prozesse weiter
    + Du bist Anlaufstelle für unsere Mitarbeitenden bei organisatorischen und administrativen Fragestellungen
* **Provider Management \& Infrastruktur (\~15%)**
    + Du koordinierst schrittweise unsere externen Partner und Dienstleister, insbesondere in den Bereichen IT, LinkedIn und Jobplattformen
    + Du verwaltest zentrale Firmenaccounts, Lizenzen und Verträge und behältst Kosten, Laufzeiten und Leistungen im Blick
    + Du stellst gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern sicher, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden über eine funktionierende und zeitgemässe Arbeitsumgebung verfügen
* **Marketing \& Kommunikation (\~20%)**
    + Du gestaltest unseren Unternehmensauftritt auf LinkedIn sowie weitere zentrale Kommunikationskanäle mit
    + Du verantwortest unser Newslettering und unterstützt bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer Website
    + Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Team Marketing\- und Kundenaktivitäten
* **Digitalisierung, AI \& Projekte (\~25%)**
    + Du treibst Projekte in den Bereichen AI, Digitalisierung und Business Development voran
    + Du beobachtest technologische Entwicklungen und prüfst, wie neue Tools und AI\-Anwendungen bei C\&P sinnvoll eingesetzt werden können
    + Du unterstützt die Co\-CEOs bei konzeptionellen und strategischen Projekten und bringst diese in die Umsetzung



**Deine Qualitäten und Begabungen**

* Du hast dein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik oder BWL (Uni/FH) abgeschlossen oder stehst kurz davor
* Du besitzt relevante Praxiserfahrung, die du während oder nach deinem Studium \- z.B. via Praktika, Teilzeittätigkeit oder im Rahmen einer Festanstellung \- sammeln durftest
* Du hast eine ausgeprägte Affinität für Technologie, Digitalisierung und AI und freust dich daran, neue Tools auszuprobieren. Dabei denkst du realistisch und weisst, dass wir keine Luftschlösser bauen und dass der konkrete Nutzen gegeben sein muss
* Du wendest die Microsoft 365 Tools gut und gerne an \- insbesondere PowerPoint und Excel
* Du magst Zahlen, bist zuverlässig und gehst die Dinge strukturiert an
* Du bist ein Organisationstalent oder willst und kannst eines werden. So oder so hast du eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe und die Fähigkeit, dich rasch in neue Themen einzuarbeiten.
* Du willst, dass deine Marketingaktivitäten Wirkung im Ziel haben. Das Look \& Feel ist dir dabei aber nicht egal.
* Du bist keine Diva und dir nicht zu schade, dir auch mal die schmutzig zu machen und in einem KMU Aufgaben zu erledigen, die eigentlich nicht in deinem Stellenbeschrieb stehen
* Du sprichst fliessend Deutsch und hast gute Englischkenntnisse
* Du bist so humorvoll, dass du zuweilen auch mal über dich selber lachen kannst



**Wir suchen kein fertiges Profil. Wir suchen jemanden am Anfang seiner oder ihrer Karriere, dem wir zutrauen, sehr schnell zu lernen und Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Dabei arbeitest du direkt mit den beiden Eigentümern und Co\-CEOs von Consult \& Pepper zusammen und erlebst aus nächster Nähe, wie ein KMU geführt und weiterentwickelt wird.**  
**Du wirst dabei nicht nur an konzeptionellen und strategischen Themen arbeiten. Zu einem KMU gehören genauso administrative Aufgaben und ganz pragmatische Probleme, die gelöst werden müssen. Genau diese Mischung macht die aus.**

**Möchtest du Unternehmertum nicht nur aus dem Studium kennen, sondern im Alltag erleben und mitgestalten?**

Dann freuen sich  **und Saia** über deine Bewerbungsunterlagen oder deinen Anruf (\+ ).

Housekeeper \- Permanent position \- 100% to start asap
=======================================================

Established and recognized for more than 40 years, Multi Personnel is a leading recruitment agency specializing in the placement of administrative professionals and executives, both on a temporary and permanent basis, across a wide range of industries, including banking, financial services, multinational corporations, NGOs, SMEs, and local institutions.  

We are looking to recruit a Housekeeper – Permanent position – 100% to start asap

**Responsabilities :**
----------------------

Our client is looking for an experienced full\-time housekeeper for their luxury home in the Valais. They want someone with a background in high\-end private residences or luxury hotels who will take full responsibility for the home every day, whether the family is there or away. The ideal person is meticulous, discreet, organised and proactive, and has a warm personality that is pleasant to have around:

* Keep the whole residence to luxury\-hotel standards of cleanliness and presentation, always ready for the family or guests.
* Run the household day to day on their own initiative, anticipating needs and keeping simple routines in place for cleaning, supplies and records.
* Care for fine furnishings, artwork and delicate materials with the right techniques.
* Handle laundry and ironing, and liaise with the dry cleaner.
* Unpack when the family arrives and help pack when they leave, including luggage and garment care.
* Help the chef serve and clear up at dinners when needed.
* Check the sauna and pool areas daily: fresh towels, refills, and a tidy, ready space.
* Buy groceries and household items to the family’s preferences, and keep supplies and inventory stocked.
* Prepare the home before the family arrives.
* Receive deliveries and post, let in contractors and service providers and supervise them, and report maintenance issues to the person responsible.
* Look after the cat, and a dog in future: feeding, care, and walking if needed.
* Follow security routines while the property is empty.
* Work alongside the other staff and service providers.
* Keep complete confidentiality about the family and the property.


**Profile :**
-------------

* Proven experience in high\-end private residences or luxury hotels.
* Excellent attention to detail and knowledge of caring for luxury homes.
* Independent and reliable, able to work with little supervision.
* Warm, pleasant and trustworthy, with excellent discretion.
* A reasonable understanding of English is ideal; French is also fine.
* A driving licence is valuable but not essential. As the property is outside the village centre, it would be a big plus.
* Preferably holds a valid Swiss work permit or EU citizenship, so a work permit doesn’t have to be arranged.
* Comfortable with pets.
* Excellent references.

description:
Health Safety Environment Manager / Deputy Health and Safety Manager  


  











Health Safety Environment Manager / Deputy Health and Safety Manager
====================================================================




  








 **Department:** **HSE Management**



 **Reports to:** **Project Manager / Deputy Project Manager**



 **Responsible for:** **providing professional and technical HSE expertise, direction and guidance to the project**



 **Location:** **Construction site office in Beringen**



 **Start Date:**  



 **Employment: Type** **Full time / On\-Site**



ENKA Investment AG is seeking an HSE Manager for its planned data center project in Beringen, Schaffhausen. You will lead site health, safety, and environmental management across construction and commissioning, working closely with local project leadership, subcontractors and ENKA’s headquarters HSE team in Istanbul.



  ***Required Knowledge and Qualifications***



* A degree or recognized professional diploma in occupational health and safety, engineering or a related field.
* At least 10 years of construction HSE experience, including at least 3 years in a leadership role managing HSE personnel and coordinating multiple subcontractors on a major project.
* Experience in energization or commissioning while construction activities were still in progress. A clear understanding of the transition from construction to live systems is essential.
* A working understanding of Civil, Structural and Architectural (CSA) and Mechanical, Electrical and Plumbing (MEP) construction risks, risk assessment, work permits and hazardous energy controls.
* Proven ability to lead investigations, challenge unsafe practices constructively and secure corrective action from project teams and subcontractors under programme pressure
* Professional working proficiency in English and Turkish, spoken and written. (German is a plus for local site coordination), English the international project team, and Turkish daily meetings and reporting with Istanbul headquarters.
* Strong reporting and document management skills, with experience using digital HSE systems and practical performance measures. A site\-based approach and the ability to coach a multicultural workforce are essential.


  ***Main Duties and Responsibilities***



* Lead the project Health, Safety and Environment programme from site mobilization and civil works through mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) installation, energization, commissioning and handover, working with project leadership and ENKA’s headquarters HSE team.
* Develop and maintain the site HSE plan, responsibilities, risk registers and assurance arrangements in line with Swiss requirements, project procedures and applicable client obligations.
* Work with the Design Manager and construction leads to review design and sequencing risks, temporary works interfaces and safe access for installation and maintenance.
* Coordinate subcontractor HSE plans, competence checks, inductions and method statements. Verify that each party controls its own activities and that interfaces between trades are addressed before work starts.
* Monitor high risk construction activities, including excavations, temporary works, lifting operations, work at height, floor openings, steel and façade erection, hot works and confined space entry where applicable.
* Work with electrical and commissioning leads on permit to work, hazardous energy control, lockout/tagout, access restrictions and the separation of live systems from ongoing construction.
* Check that safety arrangements cover heavy plant installation, generators, UPS and battery systems, cooling equipment, pressure testing and associated fuel or hazardous substances, as applicable to the design.
* Maintain a strong site presence through inspections, audits and workforce engagement. Stop unsafe work, escalate significant risks and verify effective corrective action before authorized work resumption.
* Lead incident and near miss investigations, identify underlying causes and track corrective actions to closure. Maintain reliable records and report trends that support prevention and open reporting.
* Coordinate occupational health controls, welfare arrangements and environmental measures, including dust, noise, heat, waste, site water, spill prevention and relevant permit conditions.
* Develop emergency arrangements with site teams and relevant local services; organise drills and confirm that plans remain suitable as construction and commissioning conditions change.
* Coach HSE personnel and subcontractor supervisors, deliver practical briefings and ensure that safety instructions are understood across a multilingual workforce.
* Attend daily coordination meetings with ENKA’s Istanbul headquarters HSE team in Turkish and provide daily risk and action updates, together with regular project performance reports.

ENKA Investment AG is seeking a Data Center Design Manager for its planned data center project in Beringen, Schaffhausen.  **Data Center Design Manager**



The role combines technical leadership, design delivery management and close support to procurement, construction and commissioning.



  ***Required Knowledge and Qualifications***



* A degree in electrical, mechanical, civil, or building services engineering, architecture or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrable professional competence
* At least 10 years of relevant design or construction experience, with proven responsibility for leading multidisciplinary design delivery, including detailed design, construction, commissioning and handover
* Strong knowledge of CSA and critical MEP interfaces, power and cooling resilience, and practical construction requirements.

* Professional fluency spoken and written Turkish, English are essential. Turkish is required for daily technical meetings and reporting with ENKA’s Istanbul headquarters; (German is a plus for local coordination); English for the international project team and technical documentation.

description:
